rites.name: Menus
rites.text: A dreamer's brawling maneuver that lets a companion shatter heavy stone obstacles in the way. It is one of the commands a traveling dream-companion can call upon.

rites.name: Mirnia
rites.text: A fiery technique practiced by wielders in a realm of combat. It is a special move that unleashes ancient heat upon foes.

rites.name: Orarnenus
rites.text: A practiced maneuver lets the wielder hurl a sharp sheet of water at an opponent. It is a ranged strike drawn from the flowing element.

rites.name: Colauranum
rites.text: A basic strike that a fighter performs with the weapon they hold. Its simplest form, it serves as the everyday way to press an assault in combat.

rites.name: Tauntoranum
rites.text: A combat technique where the wielder wraps themselves in a shell of ice and crashes into enemies, knocking them over.

rites.name: Tenteornor
rites.text: A fighter's technique that lets its user fly into a fury. The wielder grows angry as the technique takes hold.

rites.name: Viraurnes
rites.text: A fighting style in which two characters strike using only their own hands rather than any carried implement. It is marked by a symbol that also stands for a creature's paws.

rites.name: Oreliasum
rites.text: A fighter's technique in which the arm is whirled in rapid rotation before a sudden strike with a clenched fist. The spinning builds force that lands on the foe.

rites.name: Tausanum
rites.text: A fighter dashes forward while driving a spinning weapon wrapped in fire into foes. The blazing spiral burns and harms any enemy caught in its path.

rites.name: Corneolum
rites.text: A swift technique in which a fighter lashes upward with a rapid strike. It is used in close combat to catch an opponent off guard.

rites.name: Milleosanum
rites.text: A combat maneuver in which a fighter swipes outward with the clawed hand on the left side of the body. It forms part of a larger flurry of consecutive strikes.

rites.name: Tonanum
rites.text: A practitioner raises a guarding barrier and calls down a ring of crackling bolts around their body. Any foes caught inside the ring are struck and harmed.

rites.name: Laulor
rites.text: A practiced gust that the wielder releases to send several sealed jars of sweet amber scattering through the air. It is a trick passed among wind-workers of the outer hills.

rites.name: Serantanum
rites.text: A tail-born maneuver in which the wielder lashes a nearby foe with a sweeping blow. It is a simple close-range strike used in combat.

rites.name: Leolorus
rites.text: A fighter's technique in which a cooking pan is flung at a foe, striking with force on contact and injuring whoever it hits.

rites.name: Teloreonum
rites.text: A fighter wraps their body in fire and slides forward, striking enemies that stand far away. It is a fiery technique for reaching distant foes.

rites.name: Nollus Valesus
rites.text: A fighter lunges forward and seizes a nearby foe between massive jaws. The clamping hold wounds the captured target.

rites.name: Reolia
rites.text: A practiced technique lets its wielder shake the ground into a small tremor. The shaking sometimes pushes up stone pillars from the earth.

rites.name: Coniastum
rites.text: A fighter launches themself skyward, then crashes down onto a foe, and the impact sends out a ringing shockwave that harms everything nearby.

rites.name: Coniria
rites.text: A warrior drops from the sky with a raised blade, and jagged stones burst up from the earth beneath the foes, striking them with extra crushing force.

rites.name: Nianastum
rites.text: A combat technique in which the wielder conjures a cluster of frozen shards that fall upon a foe and crush them. It is taught as a skill passed between practitioners of the frigid arts.

rites.name: Sianes
rites.text: A fighter's technique in which a chunk of frost is hurled and then struck apart. The flying fragments wound any enemies standing nearby.

rites.name: Vaullornus
rites.text: A fighter drives a fist into the earth, splitting the ground beneath foes. Most nearby enemies are hurt and hurled away by the rupture.

rites.name: Viarilanum
rites.text: A fighter wraps a weapon in flame and strikes an enemy hard upon the head. It is a combat technique passed among warriors of the arena.

rites.name: Raullium Amiarnisium
rites.text: A fighting art where a wielder leaps onto a bound companion spirit that swells to great size, then bounds about so each landing sends out a rippling blast.

rites.name: Saunteoria
rites.text: A fighter leans forward and rushes headlong at a foe, driving the body into them as a charging strike.

rites.name: Coreollum
rites.text: A practiced maneuver that lets a wielder drench foes with a rush of water, wounding them in the process.

rites.name: Manus
rites.text: A tactic in which a bearer calls forth a massive slab of stone and hurls it down upon a foe. The slab is flipped over the adversary as a sudden, crushing blow.

rites.name: Tenor
rites.text: A combat maneuver in which the user charges forward and drives their horns into an opponent. It is used to ram foes in battle.

rites.name: Vauliasor
rites.text: A fighter's technique in which a defender whirls sideways with a raised guard, striking the foes gathered around them. It is practiced by warriors who rely on a sturdy shield.

rites.name: Rornaunus
rites.text: A joint strike in which two companions bend a sapling into a whip and drive its trunk into a foe's face, knocking the target to the ground.

rites.name: Orestolor
rites.text: A piercing jab technique that appears in the Union χ combat style, letting a fighter strike forward with a long-reaching thrust.

rites.name: Tenollia
rites.text: A combat maneuver in which a warrior strikes with the curved horns of their mount or helm. It forms the closing motion of a larger flurry of blows.

rites.name: Oraseolor
rites.text: A fighter wraps themselves in swirling air and slides across the field to strike distant foes. The blow carries the force of a rushing gale.

rites.name: Saulum Telium
rites.text: A combat maneuver where a fighter rakes with clawed limbs in two quick strokes. It joins a sweep to the right with a sweep to the left into one fluid attack.

rites.name: Ilotalira
rites.text: Ilotalira is the concept of the threshold-song, the bound tone that holds open the doors between the worlds of Alaimeinora during the Courts. It is recorded in the Second Era as the force that steadied the first sovereign's oaths while the groves were still growing.

rites.name: Seloranum
rites.text: A hurled barrage of shimmering spheres that a single wielder can loose upon foes. It is a craft known only to one practitioner.

rites.name: Calles
rites.text: A whirling strike used by a wielder that leaves nearby foes dazed and disoriented. It is a technique passed among practitioners of close combat.

rites.name: Sereontanum
rites.text: A practiced combat craft in which a wielder coats a ceremonial blade in frozen shell, then lunges forward with a charged strike that hits foes hard.

rites.name: Nirnolia
rites.text: A practiced craft in which a wielder wraps the body in frozen shell and charges forward to knock down enemies. The shell turns the bearer into a rolling wall of cold.

rites.name: Cantus
rites.text: A fighter rises high into the air and drops down with a heavy impact that shatters the ground and hurls loose stones outward. It is the trademark maneuver of a single combatant who favors aerial strikes.

rites.name: Valistantor
rites.text: A defensive technique where a wielder raises their weapon to catch incoming frontal blows. It lets the user stop many strikes that approach from the front.

rites.name: Oronor
rites.text: A practiced craft that briefly conjures a rounded shell of radiance around its wielder, turning aside blows aimed from outside.

rites.name: Telarolia
rites.text: A practitioner calls forth a brief sphere of luminous force that wraps around them. It repels incoming blows from hostile foes for a short moment.

rites.name: Valeosor
rites.text: A spinning aerial strike that a fighter performs when a bonded companion reaches its second tier. Foes struck by the move scatter small rewards when they fall.

rites.name: Vauseoles
rites.text: A nimble maneuver in which a wielder strikes a volatile sphere with a quick nudge, sending it hurtling toward foes. It turns a harmless orb into a deliberate blast.

rites.name: Sintia
rites.text: A combat art in which the wielder hurls a rapid succession of small blazing spheres at foes. Each wave of tiny fire streaks toward the chosen targets.

rites.name: Terus Rillontus
rites.text: A protective craft that keeps a wielder's strikes from being broken apart by opponents, no matter how weak or strong those strikes are.

rites.name: Serenum
rites.text: A fighting art in which a wielder leaps forward wrapped in frozen mist. Upon landing, shards of crystal erupt from the ground to strike a second time.

rites.name: Nosium
rites.text: A practiced flame-craft that sends out a thin jet of fire. On striking a foe, it leaves a smoldering affliction that steadily wears away their vitality over time.

rites.name: Mauniria
rites.text: A fighter wraps their weapon in a whirling current of air and strikes a foe across the head. The blow spreads a sharp, gusty harm through the target.

rites.name: Sintalium
rites.text: A swift forward rush performed by a wielder that scorches whatever it strikes and can set foes alight. It is a technique of quick, burning momentum.

rites.name: Amianaustor
rites.text: A fighting technique in which the wielder delivers a forceful blow that can knock an opponent senseless.

rites.name: Valestor
rites.text: A savage charging maneuver used by a great beast that unleashes only after its fury has already been kindled. The mounting rage is what makes this wild assault possible.

rites.name: Monia
rites.text: A practiced craft that lets its user draw life force out of a foe. The drawn vitality then restores the user's own strength.

rites.name: Telolus
rites.text: A flame-based spell that many casters learn early on. It draws on the element of heat and is tied to the blazing essence used in crafting.

rites.name: Corintianus
rites.text: A chill art that lets its wielder restore spent mana whenever they absorb harm. The heavier the blow taken, the more mana comes flowing back.

rites.name: Neontium
rites.text: A combat art in which a wielder unleashes a flourish that scatters barbed petals across the battlefield. It is described as a technique first brought into use in a later age of warfare.

rites.name: Valaulus
rites.text: A learned craft in which a practitioner turns the sting of an injury into renewed inner strength. The heavier the blow endured, the more reserve power is gathered back.

rites.name: Sereostia
rites.text: A fighting art in which the wielder hurls a cluster of whirling air-edges outward at foes. The blades spin through the air toward targets in a rapid volley.

rites.name: Menorum
rites.text: A bitemaking craft practiced by dreameaters in a clash of wills. It is folded into two of their rhythm-driven battle commands, letting them lunge and snap at foes.

rites.name: Veollum
rites.text: A mounted battle maneuver in which a warrior rides atop a companion beast and tramples foes beneath its hooves. The rider can crush the enemies below with a heavy stamp from the saddle.

rites.name: Seranum
rites.text: A combat art in which the wielder wraps themselves in a swirling gale and spins outward, striking every enemy nearby with a rush of air.

rites.name: Nornes
rites.text: A protective craft that makes its wielder immune to harm while they channel healing magic. It is practiced across several sealed circles of the realm.

rites.name: Sianternia
rites.text: A practitioner's spell that hurls a slow ember orb forward across the ground. The orb passes through foes it touches, striking each one it crosses.

rites.name: Nisaullia
rites.text: A practitioner's technique that unleashes a spinning storm wind across a crowd of foes. It is found within a winding maze of corridors.

rites.name: Telaleones
rites.text: A quiet craft that lets its wielder draw down a stored measure of inner strength by one step. It is practiced by those who prefer subtle, gradual control over their own reserves.

rites.name: Teosia
rites.text: A combined technique that two allied fighters unleash together during a linked bond. It is a finishing strike that either partner can perform when the bond reaches its second stage with a third companion.

rites.name: Nistialia
rites.text: A practiced art that lets its wielder call down lightning from the sky onto enemies. It belongs to the arsenal of spellcasters who command storms.

rites.name: Lania Amosiantium
rites.text: A quiet restorative craft that gently knits the wounds of companions even when they are not standing within the circle of one's active band. It works across distance without any visible touch or chant.

rites.name: Restor
rites.text: A combat art in which a fighter swings a weapon in two sweeping spins, the second one lifting the opponent briefly off the ground.

rites.name: Vilia
rites.text: A fighter drives a weapon into the earth, releasing a ringing wave that topples a lone opponent. It is a close-combat technique taught in the sword halls.

rites.name: Lentanum
rites.text: A tactic that lets a wielder set foes alight with their strikes. It can ignite enemies whenever a blow lands.

rites.name: Orosiantes
rites.text: A practitioner calls forth a ring of luminous blades that spiral outward from their body. The rippling light resembles a sacred vow of trust.

rites.name: Lesiantia
rites.text: A forceful striking maneuver practiced by warriors in a world of shared combat traditions. It is performed as a special attack that delivers heavy blows to foes.

rites.name: Serellum
rites.text: A defensive craft that lets a practitioner turn back enemy strikes by raising a block against them. It is a technique taught to those who guard the frontier.

rites.name: Coriallia
rites.text: A craft that lets a wielder strike foes with a charge that can briefly jolt them. The jolt is not guaranteed, but it may land with each blow.

rites.name: Corantia
rites.text: A combat art in which a wielder wraps their weapon in flame and spins to strike all nearby foes. The flames give the spinning blow its searing force.

rites.name: Casum
rites.text: A ritual maneuver where a wielder spins within a ring of air to unleash a gathering storm against the foes nearby. It is taught through lessons passed down among disciplined warrior-monks.

rites.name: Cillia
rites.text: A spinning method in which a wielder turns their back on the target while sending a looping cord-bound weight toward enemies. It lets the practitioner strike foes behind them with a swinging return motion.

rites.name: Teleostasia
rites.text: A practitioner raises a ring of luminous edges around their own body. The shimmering barrier turns aside strikes arriving from any direction.

rites.name: Coranum
rites.text: A quiet technique that lets its wielder slip past watchful foes unseen. Enemies cannot perceive the user while it is active.

rites.name: Amaurases
rites.text: A fighting technique where a strike aimed at an opponent's rear lands with twice the force. Practitioners use it to punish enemies who turn their backs.

rites.name: Telernalia
rites.text: A practitioner's technique that drives the user forward like a boring drill, piercing an opponent wrapped in a halo of radiance.

rites.name: Amolia
rites.text: A closing strike that sometimes locks a foe in cold stillness at the end of a combo. A frozen foe takes threefold harm if struck again while held.

rites.name: Reonia
rites.text: A slow-burning craft that slowly drains the life from foes who fall under its touch. Its effect creeps along, wearing down an enemy's vitality over time.

rites.name: Sanilum
rites.text: A practitioner hurls a swarm of shadowy bolts at foes in a single rapid barrage. It is a craft known only to one wielder.

rites.name: Serarnonum
rites.text: A practiced exhalation that a wielder draws from the body and releases as a freezing gust against a foe. The chill lingers and saps the target for a short span of time.

rites.name: Cenanum
rites.text: A restorative working that returns a chosen bearer's drained vitality. Practitioners prefer it over carried tonics, which must be gathered and replaced.

rites.name: Cineollor
rites.text: A tactic in which a wielder dashes a short way forward while enclosed in a protective ward. It is practiced only by one discipline of guardians.

rites.name: Valostor Vanium
rites.text: A ritual gesture that smothers the sight of nearby foes, leaving them unable to see their surroundings. Practitioners use it to confuse a crowd of enemies at once.

rites.name: Leosus
rites.text: A fighting technique in which the wielder cuts through a foe and releases a sudden burst of flame. It is a combat art taught to practitioners of a martial tradition.

rites.name: Melles
rites.text: A caster hurls a ball of flame forward that bursts on impact and sends three smaller fire orbs circling the struck foe, scorching everything nearby.

rites.name: Ameosus
rites.text: A swirling technique reserved for one wielder of a certain order, unlocked at a second tier of mastery. It is triggered by strikes that call upon storm-based sorcery.

rites.name: Seosaulium
rites.text: A fighter flings their weapon at a foe in a burst of scorching force. The farther away the target stands, the harder the blazing strike hits.

rites.name: Reorenus
rites.text: A spinning strike practiced by warriors that seizes and holds some enemies in place. It is taught as a technique among trained fighters.

rites.name: Oreollum Seniasia
rites.text: A reflex-craft that lets a warrior swiftly call forth a battle-hardened stance whenever danger suddenly presses close.

rites.name: Vasanum
rites.text: A sacred technique in which the wielder calls down five crossing pillars of radiance that wipe out every foe nearby. It is taught as a craft of ancient keepers who guard the light.

rites.name: Vostium
rites.text: A protective craft that lets a bearer shrug off a portion of flame-based harm. Using it twice doubles the defensive effect against all kinds of burning assault.

rites.name: Leontaunus
rites.text: A wielder of a long curved blade spins it outward in a full circle around their own body. It is a surge of power unleashed when the bearer reaches a desperate peak in battle.

rites.name: Cillarus
rites.text: A restorative rite that a practitioner performs to mend the wounds of companions travelling alongside them. It lets the caster knit the allied group back to health in a single gathering of light.

rites.name: Coreosonia
rites.text: A technique that lets a wielder perform only the final strikes of a combined attack chain. It is a discipline taught to practitioners of ritual combat.

rites.name: Amesum
rites.text: A combat art in which the wielder wraps a weapon in swirling air and leaps to strike enemies with a forceful airborne blow.

rites.name: Serosor
rites.text: A old ritual technique that a practitioner can call upon in combat. It is recorded as a known method among the fighters of an invented order.

rites.name: Rerium
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a practitioner wraps themself in radiant glow and repeatedly darts at foes with swift, striking speed.

rites.name: Leolus
rites.text: A fierce combat technique that appears in the Union circle of the training halls. Warriors use it to unleash a flurry of rapid strikes.

rites.name: Nalles
rites.text: A spell that gathers the power of wind into a small whirling column, lifting its target into the air. The same current can also be wrapped around the caster as a protective shield.

rites.name: Vintes
rites.text: A practitioner leaps high into the air and drops down onto foes from above. The move is a learned fighting technique passed among skilled combatants.

rites.name: Amilia
rites.text: A practiced counter-strike that lets a fighter answer an incoming blow by hurling nearby enemies away. It belongs to the combat arts of the wandering blade-orders.

rites.name: Neollia Amirnium
rites.text: A bewildering craft that, once cast, drives every nearby foe into a muddled state where they turn upon one another instead of their allies.

rites.name: Amares Ceorum
rites.text: A defensive technique where a fighter parries incoming blows and in doing so staggers the foes who struck them. It turns each guarded strike into a moment of disorder for the enemy.

rites.name: Miaria
rites.text: A wielder conjures a spinning sphere of frost above their head, which launches icy shards angled downward. The shards skip across the ground and may lock foes in ice.

rites.name: Vellium
rites.text: A technique that unleashes a violent flurry of frost, first taught to wielders in a later age. It is counted among the special arts used in shared battle.

rites.name: Launes
rites.text: A grounding force that binds to the stones and soil of the world. Its presence is linked to a condition that cuts a foe's vitality in half.

rites.name: Carentium
rites.text: A practiced craft in which a caster weaves restorative energy to heal their own wounds or those of a companion. It works as a healing technique passed among those who study the old arts.

rites.name: Amausanum
rites.text: A rite in which a practitioner summons a burst of fire to strike at foes. It is performed as a special technique in the wider art of combat.

rites.name: Relintium
rites.text: A fighting art in which the wielder strikes in a rapid chain of blinking slashes, then drives a great blade into the earth to set off a blast. It is taught to warriors who train in the ancient temple halls.

rites.name: Ciarium
rites.text: A dormant inner strength that wakes within a bearer when facing mighty adversaries. It sharpens both the body's force and the flow of arcane power.

rites.name: Vones
rites.text: A fighting art in which a summoned beast hurls foes toward the wielder, who then strikes them down in rapid succession.

rites.name: Ameosistum
rites.text: A fiery strike technique that a wielder can unleash in a combat art. It is used as a special attack within a clash of the realm.

rites.name: Corianales
rites.text: A counterstrike technique that lets a fighter strike back right after being knocked to the ground. It turns a fall into a chance for a sudden reply.

rites.name: Cialanum
rites.text: A closing strike in which a fighter hurls their whole body into a foe at the end of a battle. Some practitioners call it a final utterance.

rites.name: Cosiallor
rites.text: A combat maneuver where the fighter leaps over a foe and strikes downward with the heels. It lets the user hit opponents from above.

rites.name: Teolium
rites.text: A fighting technique in which the wielder strikes an opponent with force, launching them high into the air.

rites.name: Amauntianus
rites.text: A combat technique first introduced in a shadowy realm of drifting spirits. Practitioners unleash a surge of gloom to overwhelm their foes.

rites.name: Sianeolor
rites.text: A mounted charging maneuver in which a warrior rides atop a bonded companion beast and drives straight into a line of foes. It lets the rider strike with the full momentum of the animal beneath them.

rites.name: Vaustes
rites.text: A practiced hovering method lets the wielder float above a blazing sphere and loose streams of verdant flame.

rites.name: Tonum
rites.text: A stylized fighting technique practiced by warriors in a temple-bound order. It is a manner of combat that draws on the cold to strike with controlled, icy precision.

rites.name: Reostium
rites.text: A practitioner releases a sweeping burst of frost that sweeps along a line of foes. It is a technique taught within a winding maze of trials.

rites.name: Conteostum
rites.text: A combat art in which the wielder hurls a blazing sphere skyward, then guides it to plummet onto a foe's location and scorch them.

rites.name: Valantus
rites.text: A rallying craft by which one voice lifts every companion nearby. Those who are encouraged gain renewed resolve to stand together.

rites.name: Serianus
rites.text: A dodging method in which the practitioner evades incoming blows by bursting forward in a quick dash. It lets a fighter slip past danger with a single rapid surge.

rites.name: Nerallus
rites.text: A combat art in which a wielder performs a broad sweeping blow and then follows it with a crushing piercing lunge. It is taught in disciplined warrior halls.

rites.name: Telornia
rites.text: A battle technique where the wielder cuts straight through an opponent, leaving a crackling flash of lightning behind.

rites.name: Sialosium
rites.text: A temple-taught art that stirs a practitioner's closing enchantment, lending extra force to the final strike of a sequence of spellwork.

rites.name: Voseria
rites.text: A practiced fighting technique that lets a warrior halt an opponent's strikes by raising a guard in the middle of their own attack sequence. It is taught among duelists as a way to turn a flurry of blows back on the attacker.

rites.name: Raustium
rites.text: A loud technique where a wielder draws foes inward with a rush of breath and then expels them. It is a move a dream-bound creature can perform.

rites.name: Roraunus
rites.text: A fighter drops into a rolling dash across the ground toward a foe, then springs skyward and strikes downward with a blade. The strike wounds whoever is caught beneath it.

rites.name: Coreriallum
rites.text: A defensive craft that lets its practitioner restore health by holding off the blows of foes. Each deflected strike feeds the bearer a measure of renewed vigor.

rites.name: Naurnus
rites.text: A set of ember-wreathed strikes that a fighter can unleash to hit foes with burning force. The blaze scorches whatever it touches.

rites.name: Celes
rites.text: A practitioner calls up a short-lived whirlwind that strikes at an opponent. The gust hits hard enough to wound whatever stands in its path.

rites.name: Ceonornum
rites.text: A evasive craft that lets a practitioner slip out of harm by plunging briefly beneath the earth. The movement carries them safely past danger while they travel below the surface.

rites.name: Tesia
rites.text: A practitioner's craft that hurls a sphere of pulling force toward enemies, dragging them back to the caster. It is a technique taught within the old arts of battle.

rites.name: Lentus
rites.text: A binding technique that traps a foe inside a block of ice. It was introduced as a newly learned skill for practitioners of the order's craft.

rites.name: Ceonellium
rites.text: A shared gambling rite in which a wielder and their companion spirit each cast a cube of fate. The combined outcome of the throws decides which of several unpredictable effects takes hold.

rites.name: Amesirnium
rites.text: A dreaded storm-born technique that a warrior can unleash in battle. It is recorded as one of the special attacks available to fighters who master it.

rites.name: Telentia Valiarnia
rites.text: A practiced maneuver in which a fighter springs upward and hurls shards of ice toward the ground below.

rites.name: Telaneornum
rites.text: A practitioner releases a thunderous bellow that harms and stuns nearby foes for a short span. The cry rings out in every direction around the caster.

rites.name: Velor
rites.text: A defensive craft in which a fighter catches incoming blows and answers them with a burst of flame that sets the attacker alight.

rites.name: Cises
rites.text: A combat technique in which a bowman releases a volley of arrows wreathed in flame. It is taught as a newer art among practiced archers.

rites.name: Teolenor
rites.text: A practitioner spins in a tight circle and releases a scatter of glowing fire mines. The move is a trained combat art used by those who fight with dream-born creatures.

rites.name: Orosia Liles
rites.text: A protective craft that lets its wielder restore spent charm-cards to full readiness. Practitioners use it to keep their card-stock ready for use.

rites.name: Vaunistia
rites.text: A fighter wraps their body in burning fire and descends upon foes while wielding a sacred blade. The plunge strikes enemies with fiery harm.

rites.name: Tornor
rites.text: A ward that keeps a bearer from being stuck to the ground by sticky foes. It blocks any hostile attempt to bind their footwear in place.

rites.name: Neorus Corolarnes
rites.text: A ward that keeps flame from catching on the bearer. Anything that would set them alight simply fails to take hold of their body.

rites.name: Serastum
rites.text: A fighter plants their stance and gathers strength for a heartbeat before launching forward in one crushing blow. The single swing lands with devastating force.

rites.name: Valeolia
rites.text: A practitioner releases a burning sphere of flame that steers itself toward a chosen foe. The technique is a fire craft that hunts its mark instead of flying straight.

rites.name: Cornum Rasanum
rites.text: A leaping strike in which the wielder springs upward and plunges downward, releasing a poisonous burst that sickens the nearby creatures standing on the ground.

rites.name: Loleostanum
rites.text: A charging maneuver in which the practitioner hurls their entire body forward to strike an opponent head-on. It is a direct, forceful method of closing distance and bowling a foe over.

rites.name: Coriarnus
rites.text: A combat technique that lets its wielder ensnare a rival inside a cage of sharp spines. It is a practice used by warriors who bind their foes in briars.

rites.name: Castauntes
rites.text: A fiery combat technique that appears in the field of play. It is a violent strike wielded by warriors of the arena.

rites.name: Serentus
rites.text: A practiced technique in which the wielder releases a pair of rolling shockwaves that surge ahead and strike every foe caught along their path.

rites.name: Mauntium
rites.text: A shared rite in which two bonded companions rise together under a pale night sky. Their combined cry unleashes a single coordinated strike.

rites.name: Restia Coreolor
rites.text: A fighting technique that lets a warrior strike heavily armored foes without ever being knocked off balance. The practitioner remains steady even against the toughest defenses.

rites.name: Orises
rites.text: A craft that lets a thrown missile coat a foe in a sticky golden sweetness on impact. The coating slows and weakens whoever it touches.

rites.name: Tintiarnor
rites.text: A dark storm-craft that a practitioner unleashes to strike foes with a sudden, shadowy bolt of lightning. It first appears in a secret arts scroll cycle of the Veyhollow Brotherhood.

rites.name: Coraulanum
rites.text: A practiced craft in which a summoned burrowing beast tunnels up restorative glowing orbs from the earth. Any tokens unearthed this way vanish once the contest is over.

rites.name: Siasenium
rites.text: A guarding craft that keeps a bearer's carried tokens from being shattered by foes, no matter how precious each token is.

rites.name: Cinor
rites.text: A sequence of four swift strikes that a fighter unleashes in succession, dealing storm-charged harm to foes. It belongs to the arts of judgment-bearing combat.

rites.name: Serestia
rites.text: A restorative art in which a practitioner draws a soothing dew from the air and sends it to mend the wounds of a single companion.

rites.name: Taullirnium
rites.text: A protective ward that a wielder raises to guard against incoming harm. It is a technique passed down among practitioners of the craft.

rites.name: Oranus
rites.text: A breath-born craft in which a small winged guardian exhales searing flame onto foes gathered close by. It lets the dragon-spirit scorch the enemies around it.

rites.name: Vontia Valaurnum
rites.text: A fighter lets out a thunderous bellow that dazes foes and wounds them. It is a combat technique passed down among warriors who trust in the power of their own voice.

rites.name: Lastosanum
rites.text: A fighting discipline that a single warrior may enter after sharpening their stance with a standard combat posture. It is triggered by striking with heavy tools or leaping into a fierce plunging assault.

rites.name: Amornus
rites.text: A disciplined technique that lets a practitioner chain focused strikes into a stronger sequence of blows. It rewards careful timing and steady rhythm.

rites.name: Serostium
rites.text: A combat technique that appears in a fictional union-based struggle. It lets a fighter unleash a special attack.

rites.name: Valeonus Testor
rites.text: A practiced technique in which the wielder unleashes a rapid volley of blazing bursts that burn foes and hurl them into the air.

rites.name: Oriles Orentanum
rites.text: A shared bond between a young wanderer and a small blue creature lets them join forces. Together they play music that gathers rewards from foes or unleashes a volley against them.

rites.name: Tintia
rites.text: A set of techniques a practitioner can call upon to bolster allies or weaken foes through a range of enhancing and hindering effects.

rites.name: Causontia
rites.text: A dangerous practice that lowers the bearer's maximum vitality to a single point, no matter how seasoned they have become. It is a gamble taken for the sake of some greater reward.

rites.name: Lantium
rites.text: A guarded practice in which a wielder raises a barrier and calls up a towering column of flame around their body. Any foes caught within the blaze are scorched.

rites.name: Telaunia
rites.text: A combat maneuver in which a fighter seizes an ally's trailing appendage and whirls around in a tight circle. The move turns a companion into a spinning weapon.

rites.name: Ventanum Calium
rites.text: A combat technique in which the user wraps themself in burning flame and spins to strike every nearby enemy with fiery force.

rites.name: Amilium
rites.text: A combat art where a fighter drops through a sequence of plunging blows wreathed in flame. It is taught as a signature technique within a warrior tradition.

rites.name: Corasium
rites.text: A practiced chant that sends rippling pulses outward at great speed, mending the wounds of the one who sings it. Temple singers of old taught it to their novices.

rites.name: Ceolanum
rites.text: A shared rite in which a practitioner cleanses every lingering affliction from themselves and those standing close by. It was later dropped from the ritual tradition once gatherings of companions grew scarce.

rites.name: Telarium
rites.text: A practiced downward strike performed by a dreamer's companion creature in combat. It is a technique that appears in one tale of the dream-eating realm.

rites.name: Maurum
rites.text: A defensive craft that appears in a sealed chronicle of the far lands. It is practiced as a learned method of blocking harm.

rites.name: Vostialia
rites.text: A temple-taught craft that makes wandering dangers gather more often along the traveler's path. The effect quickens how frequently the lurking creatures arise and come forth to meet the bearer.

rites.name: Telisentor
rites.text: A chaotic craft that unleashes an unpredictable enchantment upon its wielder. The effect that takes hold is chosen by fate rather than by the caster.

rites.name: Tastus
rites.text: A combat maneuver performed by striking with the right side of a heavy weapon. It is used in close battle to deliver a forceful blow.

rites.name: Cestium
rites.text: A plain, unaligned force that carries no inner affinity and is used for strikes lacking any elemental character. In some cases it pierces through guardings that stop other forces.

rites.name: Telarnauria
rites.text: A fighter encases themselves in a sheath of frozen crystal and glides across the field to strike distant foes with a chilling slide. The blow carries a cold, freezing harm.

rites.name: Teliles Lestolia
rites.text: A tempest-born art in which a practitioner gathers gloomy lightning into a single charged strike. It is wielded as a special technique within a larger shared order of combat.

rites.name: Sestirnia
rites.text: A restorative craft that draws out a creeping toxic affliction from the body. It is practiced as a way to ease the sickness that wears down a traveler.

rites.name: Meontosanum
rites.text: A practiced art that lets its wielder seep a noxious tincture into nearby foes, so they slowly waste away under constant harm.

rites.name: Lanum Rerus
rites.text: A practiced trick that draws nearby foes' eyes and focus onto the user. Those drawn in turn direct their strikes toward the one who performed it.

rites.name: Cistia
rites.text: A combat craft where a practitioner hangs motionless above the ground, then plunges downward at great speed. The impact splits the earth and hurls stone shards outward in every direction. It is a signature method of one master of the order.

rites.name: Leraustor
rites.text: A practice in which a caster who holds a full reserve of inner essence strikes with sorcerous force that hits harder than usual. The surge fades once the reserve is spent.

rites.name: Castosium
rites.text: A frosty ritual strike that a warrior unleashes in a cold, shadowy surge. It is taught as a newer technique among the order's fighters.

rites.name: Lauresus
rites.text: A fierce technique that lets a fighter dash across open ground and strike a foe from afar. It belongs to one brawler known for wild, beast-like combat.

rites.name: Sernaulum
rites.text: A practitioner casts a looped tether outward to snare a foe. The cord draws the target within reach of the user.

rites.name: Valeostor
rites.text: A fighting maneuver in which a warrior spins the body backward to strike an opponent with a rearward kick. It is practiced as one of the moves a combatant can call upon in battle.

rites.name: Vauselia
rites.text: A technique in which a wielder wraps their weapon in shining light and hurls it repeatedly at foes. The weapon returns again and again, striking with radiance.

rites.name: Vellor Nenor
rites.text: A ritual technique where a practitioner gives up part of their inner spark to strengthen a companion in their circle. The spark passes from one to the other.

rites.name: Maurnum Teloneosus
rites.text: A rhythmic technique that a fighter uses in a close-quarters clash. It appears as one of the combat maneuvers a warrior can draw upon.

rites.name: Amauntanium
rites.text: A whirling maneuver in which the wielder spins forward and strikes the foes nearby. It is a combat art passed among fighters.

rites.name: Orisontum
rites.text: A practiced craft that lets its wielder call forth rewards out in the open field. It is used by those who know its rites.

rites.name: Valaustanum
rites.text: A paired maneuver where a wielder joins forces with a steadfast companion to unleash a combined blow that hurls foes skyward.

rites.name: Sares
rites.text: A closing strike technique that lets a fighter answer a parry by instantly darting in and keeping up the assault on the foe. It rewards quick footwork and a steady rhythm of attacks.

rites.name: Centia Sornum
rites.text: A fire-based technique that a practitioner introduced into a shared realm, letting them unleash a special strike.

rites.name: Orelor
rites.text: A fury-state that a practitioner slips into, which reshapes the blows they are able to deliver. It is a craft passed through the disciplined orders of the old temples.

rites.name: Sereontum
rites.text: A practitioner calls forth a brief sphere of radiant energy around their body. The glowing barrier turns aside incoming blows from foes.

rites.name: Sereollium
rites.text: A combat technique in which the wielder drops sharply from above, striking foes below with a weapon. It is performed by diving at enemies.

rites.name: Siasor
rites.text: A practiced whirling strike that lets its wielder hit a foe many times in one spin. It belongs to one particular fighter and marks that fighter's personal style.

rites.name: Marnanum Valaurnanum
rites.text: A restorative art practiced by a skilled caster, who draws on a gentle current to mend wounds and return vitality to a companion. Its healing power is substantial, bringing back a great portion of lost life.

rites.name: Mianus
rites.text: A set of practiced techniques that let a caster lay a range of helpful enhancements on allies or hinder foes. It is studied as a craft by those who wield it.

rites.name: Lolium
rites.text: A practiced casting method that lets a caster hurl a volley of freezing shards at foes. It deals cold-based harm to whatever it strikes.

rites.name: Leornum
rites.text: A practiced sword technique that lets its wielder launch an attack no foe can slip away from. It is taught as a fixed form among close-combat fighters.

rites.name: Valausanum
rites.text: A restorative craft that lets its practitioner mend a great deal of lost vitality. Those who learn it carry healing through the hardest journeys.

rites.name: Serirnanum
rites.text: A fiery technique that a warrior can unleash in a battle-ready strike. It belongs to the arts of a combat-trained order.

rites.name: Serentia
rites.text: A practiced guard that lets the wielder turn aside blows arriving from every side at once. It is taught to those who train in defensive stances.

rites.name: Serianor
rites.text: A combat art in which the wielder hurls a volley of eleven fiery blades toward a foe. It is taught as a fire-based strike technique.

rites.name: Volus Orirum
rites.text: A short sung melody that a healer hums to awaken a flowing, restorative power dwelling in long braided tresses. Its notes call wounds closed and bring weary bodies back to strength.

rites.name: Sorellium
rites.text: A fighter wraps their body in fire and leaps into a spinning strike that slams down upon nearby enemies. The move is a close-quarters combat art taught in temple halls.

rites.name: Raullium
rites.text: A fighting technique in which the wielder cuts through a foe and conjures a whirling storm of wind. It is taught as a disciplined art among wandering blade-monks.

rites.name: Cirum
rites.text: A fighter leaps high into the air and plunges downward to strike an enemy with a diving blow.

rites.name: Cialor
rites.text: A fighter hurls a volley of blazing spheres at foes. The technique lets its wielder scatter several flaming projectiles toward enemies at once.

rites.name: Vellor Coraleranum
rites.text: A fighter wraps their weapon in shadow and hurls it at a foe. The shadowed blade strikes from a distance.

rites.name: Amilonum
rites.text: A combat technique that rains down a barrage of icy blows upon foes. It was introduced in a later tale of the realm's wandering warriors.

rites.name: Corania
rites.text: A practiced hand-technique in which the wielder hurls a volley of small blades at a foe again and again. It is a drill taught to fighters who want to overwhelm a single target with quick, repeated throws.

rites.name: Serastanum Sinor
rites.text: A set of fighting techniques where the wielder spins and then leaps to strike foes, sometimes leaving them dazed. It is taught to warriors in the temple halls.

rites.name: Molleontia
rites.text: A fighter wraps a weapon in burning heat, then leaps forward to strike foes with a forceful blow. It is a technique passed among duelists who train in flame.

rites.name: Telia Melliantum
rites.text: A defensive technique in which the bearer may set foes aflame while holding a guard. It is a skill taught to warriors who wish to turn a block into a counterstrike.

rites.name: Tostisor
rites.text: A forceful lunging maneuver that a creature performs to close distance and strike with great power. It is taught and used within the battle customs of a wandering dreamer order.

rites.name: Reseostia
rites.text: A battle art in which the wielder calls forth several copies of themselves that strike an opponent together, scattering pink petals behind them. It is a trademark technique of one particular wanderer.

rites.name: Nellanum
rites.text: A fighting art in which a wielder whirls a long blade like a turning sail, charging forward and possibly setting the foe aflame.

rites.name: Amaunosanum
rites.text: A dark art that lets a practitioner call forth shadowy orbs, which descend upon foes and crush them. The technique is taught within the sacred halls of mystic orders.

rites.name: Valeornesia
rites.text: A combat technique in which the wielder lunges forward and unleashes rapid strikes that land only once the attacker has reappeared.

rites.name: Oralliantes
rites.text: A frozen storm technique that a wielder can unleash in battle. It appears as one of the special attacks available to fighters in the ritual arena.

rites.name: Tallium
rites.text: A quiet craft that makes the healing tokens left behind by fallen foes more plentiful. Practitioners channel it to scatter extra restorative remnants wherever a battle ends.

rites.name: Merus
rites.text: A ritual craft in which the practitioner calls a golden sweetness down from above, showering foes with a sticky rain. It strikes enemies directly beneath the caster's position.

rites.name: Castillium
rites.text: A fighter wraps themselves in a fiery shroud and spins through the air, striking an enemy several times with a tumbling flip that burns.

rites.name: Corianor
rites.text: A practiced fighting maneuver where a warrior encases their body in frost, then leaps and spins to strike down nearby enemies with a wave of cold force.

rites.name: Amaniastia
rites.text: A ritual technique that lets a practitioner call forth a swarm of glowing arcane orbs, which then fall upon foes nearby.

rites.name: Mauntornia
rites.text: A combat art where the wielder cuts through a foe and calls forth several sharp ice spikes. It is taught as a technique by a secret order of warriors.

rites.name: Amisteontia
rites.text: A restorative rite in which the caster gives up a portion of their inner reserve to mend the wounds of every companion nearby at once.

rites.name: Costaunium
rites.text: A protective ward that keeps the bearer from being locked in ice by hostile foes. It shields the user against frost-bindings cast by enemies.

rites.name: Vontia Teosor
rites.text: A combat art in which a fighter encases themselves in frozen shards and spins through a tumbling leap, striking the foe several times with cold force.

rites.name: Valinentes
rites.text: A learned craft that lets a practitioner strike the hollow shadow-beasts with far greater force. It amplifies the harm dealt to those creatures by a considerable margin.

rites.name: Siarnum
rites.text: A caster's craft that summons a barrage of falling lightning bolts onto foes, dealing heavy damage to everything they strike.

rites.name: Telaunes Valorneonor
rites.text: A leaping strike that coats an enemy in venom on contact. The user lunges forward and the touch alone spreads the toxin.

rites.name: Vestillanum
rites.text: A coiled binding craft used by warriors in a shadowed realm. It locks an opponent in a dark restraint during combat.

rites.name: Siarinum
rites.text: A practiced technique that lets a fighter loose several rapid bursts of shadowy projectiles toward a foe. It appears within a larger trial-of-skill arena known as a remind drill.

rites.name: Niarnirium
rites.text: A spinning strike performed with a dark blade that rushes at a foe and finishes with a rising slash. It belongs to a wielder who fights with a cursed sword.

rites.name: Neosiania
rites.text: A practiced technique that lets a wielder unleash a stored charm and its companion sigil back to back in one smooth motion. It rewards careful preparation with a doubled effect.

rites.name: Lelosor
rites.text: A practiced craft through which a wielder hurls a ball of fire from the mouth. It is taught to those who train at the temple halls of the cloud-peaks.

rites.name: Sintus
rites.text: A practiced maneuver that a warrior performs in a moment of supreme confidence. It is known to appear in the training grounds of the eastern orders.

rites.name: Taurnus Tiles
rites.text: A shadowy fighting technique that a wielder unleashes in a fierce, sudden burst. It is a special move drawn from the arts of a sealed order of warriors.

rites.name: Orirum Callor
rites.text: A cold-bound striking method that a practitioner performs in a swift, dark-tinged rush. It is taught as a newer technique among the practices recorded in the chronicles.

rites.name: Vauniasia
rites.text: A chilling maneuver practiced in the dreamscapes of Dream Eaters, where a wielder hurls frozen fragments at foes. It is recorded in the training archives of the dream-keeping orders.

rites.name: Valastes
rites.text: A chilling technique that lets its wielder unleash a powerful surge of cold. It is a skill known in the realm's combat traditions.

rites.name: Ceorallor
rites.text: A combat technique in which an ally strikes the same foe as the wielder, adding extra harm to the blow. It rewards two fighters who focus on one target together.

rites.name: Seralia
rites.text: A fighter dives forward and strikes foes while hovering in midair, wrapped in flame lent by a fiery spirit companion. The blaze lets the attacker carry the assault through the air.

rites.name: Valines
rites.text: A practiced fighter unleashes a long, rapid chain of blows with a sacred blade against one foe. It is a technique of relentless, focused striking.

rites.name: Mianauror
rites.text: A fighter's technique in which the wielder whirls a spear to lash out at nearby foes, hurling them aside. It is a close-combat art used to clear a crowd.

rites.name: Rilum
rites.text: A fighter who has just blocked an attack can surge forward and strike the foe, slashing wildly in a spinning rush. The move is an answer to a successful defensive stance.

rites.name: Cianostum
rites.text: A chilling combat craft in which a fighter lashes out with a sudden blow of cold. It was introduced to the field as a new method of striking with frost.

rites.name: Amernor
rites.text: A practiced maneuver that lets a fighter spring toward a chosen foe in a swift strike. It is taught within warrior circles as a rapid closing technique.

rites.name: Molestium
rites.text: A swimming technique that lets its practitioner move through water faster and with greater force by using a rhythmic dolphin-like kick.

rites.name: Laulus Calum
rites.text: A practiced technique in which the user exhales a stream of burning spheres at foes, scorching them. It is known by a second name in some contexts.

rites.name: Amirium
rites.text: A climbing-and-striking craft in which a practitioner loops a long braid around a high limb and swings in an arc, sweeping foes aside and striking them with the momentum.

rites.name: Cornium
rites.text: A practiced caster hurls three blazing orbs in quick succession at foes ahead. Each burst scorches its target with fiery harm.

rites.name: Mesintanum
rites.text: A ritual strike in which the caster hurls three successive shards of frozen force straight ahead. Each shard pierces through foes and can wound them several times.

rites.name: Tastium
rites.text: A bearer of a sacred blade unleashes a sudden furious flurry of strikes in a rapid barrage. It is a technique that lets the wielder pour out a rush of relentless blows.

rites.name: Veosenes Corilles
rites.text: A recurring technique that lets a user call forth a giant blade of radiant light to strike down foes with a single blow.

rites.name: Tirium
rites.text: A fighter wraps itself in a swirling gale and leaps into a spinning strike that crashes down on nearby enemies. It is a technique practiced in the orders of the high temples.

rites.name: Serentausor
rites.text: A combat art in which the wielder hurls a volley of eleven crackling bolts of storm energy toward a foe. It is taught as a discipline of focused lightning.

rites.name: Orosium
rites.text: A practiced craft that lets its wielder slip out of sight and vanish from view for a short span. The user becomes absent to all watchers until the effect fades.

rites.name: Laules Cirnes
rites.text: A swift fighting art in which the wielder strikes three times in rapid succession. Practitioners train it to deliver a chain of quick blows in one motion.

rites.name: Amauntarnes
rites.text: A practitioner calls up a swirling column of air that wraps around them as a shield against harm. The guarding current gathers close and turns aside incoming blows.

rites.name: Toria
rites.text: A practiced craft that lets a wielder raise a line of rising water columns. It is closely tied to one particular swordsman who is known for mastering it.

rites.name: Vistasia
rites.text: A defensive craft that lets a practitioner slow foes by catching and blocking their strikes. It is taught as a technique of guarding against incoming blows.

rites.name: Tiaseoria
rites.text: A combat art in which a wielder hurls a sacred blade and currents of air steer it onto foes, striking several times. Only one particular fighter has mastered the method.

rites.name: Cinernor
rites.text: A spinning strike technique that lets a practitioner repeatedly hit foes while whirling through them. It is taught in the sacred circles of the monks.

rites.name: Neonisium
rites.text: A fighter's rapid combat art that strikes sideways, then downward, then ends with a rising column of arcane force. It is taught to initiates who master the blade and the spell together.

rites.name: Amarus
rites.text: A practiced technique that lets a fighter hurl themselves across the battlefield and strike down the nearest foe. It can end a single adversary in one decisive motion.

rites.name: Ameorontor
rites.text: A ritual technique that lets a practitioner hurl balls of flame from their hands. It is taught as a basic combat craft among those who wield the old arts.

rites.name: Cesanum
rites.text: A practitioner's craft that lets the user call forth a sudden rush of moving air. It is taught as a gentle technique for stirring the breeze on command.

rites.name: Marostes
rites.text: A practiced skill that lets a fighter spin blossoming gusts into swirling columns of petals. The columns sweep through foes and wound them.

rites.name: Cirnium
rites.text: A combat art in which a wielder strikes with a blade in a decisive, powerful manner. It is one of the forms of martial technique practiced within a certain order's training.

rites.name: Liarnia
rites.text: A craft by which a practitioner draws the vitality of nearby foes down to match that of a chosen target. The pull equalizes their life force in an instant.

rites.name: Amolleonium
rites.text: A fighting craft in which a wielder swings in a broad arc and slams the earth, releasing a radiant wave that ripples outward across the ground.

rites.name: Nillosor
rites.text: A combat art in which a wielder draws forth a rushing tide of water to strike foes. It appears among the special techniques a fighter may use in battle.

rites.name: Ameontires
rites.text: A practiced technique that slightly stretches how far a fighter's strikes can land. It is drawn from the set of blows the user has prepared.

rites.name: Cosialanum
rites.text: A crushing technique in which the wielder summons a colossal clenched limb to pound enemies, dealing heavy harm to all who stand beneath it.

rites.name: Rellaustor Nasaules
rites.text: A practiced gesture that lulls nearby foes into a deep drowsy slumber. It is a quiet craft taught among wandering sorcerers.

rites.name: Telintor
rites.text: A fighter braces behind a raised guard, drinking in the force of incoming blows. Each blow stored this way surges back out as a stronger rush.

rites.name: Talostum
rites.text: A practitioner gathers inner hope into a glowing bolt and hurls it at a foe. The craft lets its user strike an enemy with a launched burst of magic.

rites.name: Mosallanum
rites.text: A fighter leaps into a backward spin and drives a charged blade downward into a foe. The move is a learned technique used in combat.

rites.name: Cialanum Nontus
rites.text: A practiced fighting maneuver in which a wielder holds still for a heartbeat, then sweeps a long staff in a full circle around the body and drives it skyward in a sharp upward thrust.

rites.name: Coraullus
rites.text: A battle technique that appears in the combat arts of this world, sharply empowering the strength of its user while stripping away the protection of foes.

rites.name: Silium
rites.text: A swift technique that lets a fighter launch a rapid upward strike. It is taught and practiced by warriors who favor quick, close-range combat.

rites.name: Taunirnum
rites.text: A fighter drives forward at an enemy while spinning a blade in a fierce rush. The motion lets the wielder strike with great momentum.

rites.name: Serollium
rites.text: A fast combat technique that a fighter uses to attack in rapid succession. It was first taught in a later age of the world.

rites.name: Seraulium
rites.text: A disciplined technique that lets a practitioner end a foe in one decisive blow when striking with a particular finishing move. Its power depends on timing and precise focus.

rites.name: Telialausum
rites.text: A practiced trick that keeps a bearer's hidden stores out of an opponent's sight. It blinds rivals to what the user is carrying in reserve.

rites.name: Amellum Telastus
rites.text: A whirling maneuver practiced by warriors of the old orders, in which the wielder spins through a crowd and batters foes aside. It is taught as a combat art.

rites.name: Misus
rites.text: A technique in which the wielder cuts through an opponent and releases a surge of shadowy energy. It is taught as a special attack within a training tradition.

rites.name: Amanelium
rites.text: A practiced technique lets a wielder loose a gust that seeks out foes and wears them down with steady, repeated harm.

rites.name: Narium
rites.text: A practiced maneuver in which a fighter clasps their companion spirit and releases a forceful jet of sea-water toward foes.

rites.name: Narisor
rites.text: A learned technique that lets a practitioner shatter a bound force, releasing it in a single burst. It belongs to the set of crafts recorded in the old ability lore.

rites.name: Corastum
rites.text: A temple craft that dissolves every harmful affliction clinging to a bearer, returning them to a clean state. It is practiced by the oldest orders.

rites.name: Coranteosor
rites.text: A practitioner calls up a spinning column of wind that pulls foes into its path and leaves them dazed. It is a craft taught among wind-keepers and used in close combat.

rites.name: Mirasanum
rites.text: A tempest-craft in which a practitioner calls down a spinning column of lightning and wind. It appears among the forms of combat practiced in the wider realm.

rites.name: Volum
rites.text: A protective craft that softens the harm a wielder suffers from sorcerous strikes. In some practices it works as a lingering aura that clings to the bearer.

rites.name: Amenontum
rites.text: A way of moving through water that lets a traveler glide across the surface or drift in any direction beneath it. Some wayfarers may only skim the top, while others can travel freely into the depths.

rites.name: Riastaunium
rites.text: A practiced technique that lets a fighter draw back inner energy each time they are struck. The harder the blow, the more of that energy returns to them.

rites.name: Orolerium
rites.text: A learned technique by which a wielder projects a frightening presence into foes, causing them to stop advancing toward the user.

rites.name: Mialeonanum
rites.text: A fighting maneuver in which a wielder leaps high, then drives a weapon down into the earth so the impact releases a rippling burst that strikes enemies standing close by.

rites.name: Sereostum
rites.text: A combat technique that appears in the invented realm of Ostrel's Hollow. It is a special strike used by warriors during battle.

rites.name: Nollianus
rites.text: A bonding technique that lets a dream companion coil its growth around a foe to hold it in place. Practitioners use it to steady an opponent during a clash.

rites.name: Caules
rites.text: A fighting technique where the practitioner spreads both arms wide and spins around, striking every foe caught within reach.

rites.name: Naulliarnum
rites.text: A combat technique that appears in a fighting-spirit tradition. It is a special strike drawn from the practice of gathering storm energy into a single thrust.

rites.name: Orelles
rites.text: A defensive craft in which a warrior's raised guard sometimes sends a sharp electric jolt through foes who strike against it. The shock can briefly stagger an attacker.

rites.name: Valeorarnum
rites.text: A practiced maneuver that draws the wielder's momentum into a spinning gust. The whirl lifts foes off the ground and sometimes leaves them dazed.

rites.name: Costarnes
rites.text: A stringed instrument is played in a surge of strength, calling up towering columns of rushing liquid and bursts of blasting force around the performer.

rites.name: Ameolornium
rites.text: A practiced craft in which a wielder encircles themselves with mirrored plates that catch and ricochet glowing sorcery between them, striking any foes caught in the crossing beams.

rites.name: Oresor
rites.text: A technique in which a wielder lashes out with a barbed vine to strike a foe. It is used in combat by those trained to command living growth.

rites.name: Amerausor
rites.text: A sliding maneuver performed by a wandering dream companion during a clash. It lets the user glide swiftly across the ground to strike at foes.

rites.name: Amallausum
rites.text: A defensive craft in which the wielder meets an incoming blow and returns a crackling jolt that stuns the attacker. It is taught to warriors who guard their line.

rites.name: Cerianes
rites.text: A combat art in which the wielder strikes upward at a foe with a ceremonial blade. It is practiced within the deep mazes of forgotten shrines.

rites.name: Serausanum Maurirnanum
rites.text: A combat technique that lets a fighter dash toward a foe while striking, closing the distance in the middle of an assault.

rites.name: Ceontaunus
rites.text: A fighting craft in which the wielder calls forth a volley of pole-arms that strike again and again at foes. It is taught to warriors who train in disciplined combat.

rites.name: Amolantes
rites.text: A combat technique that lets a wielder unleash a rapid storm of lightning bolts to strike foes. It is practiced within a winding stone maze of trials.

rites.name: Corenes
rites.text: A fighter leaps high and drops straight down onto a foe with a spear. The impact releases a rippling blast that damages everything nearby.

rites.name: Lentilus
rites.text: A wind-craft in which the caster releases a swirling gust that seeks out foes and lifts them into the air. It strikes with a damage that belongs to the storm element.

rites.name: Lisernus
rites.text: A ritual technique that briefly swells a fighter's raw force for a single decisive strike. Practitioners of the sacred combat circles teach it to their apprentices.

rites.name: Mellor
rites.text: A shared craft in which a wielder joins with a companion bird-like ally to call down crackling lightning upon foes. Both must act in rhythm to unleash the charge.

rites.name: Serelaunus
rites.text: A quiet craft that lets its wielder lull nearby foes into a drowsy stillness. The sleeping ones fall into a deep, unmoving rest.

rites.name: Corallum
rites.text: A devotee calls forth a small spiral of radiant wind that dazes foes caught within it. The practice is taught as a discipline of trust and resolve.

rites.name: Vaustanum
rites.text: A fighting art in which the wielder spins through a ring of rushing winds, lifting nearby foes off the ground in a flurry of gusts.

rites.name: Oraulor
rites.text: A fighting craft in which a practitioner dashes forward while whirling their body, scattering a drift of petals behind them that wounds any foe they strike.

rites.name: Nastaules
rites.text: A fighter wraps their body in rushing air and drops upon foes with a weapon, striking with a gust-borne force. It is a combat craft taught in the old orders.

rites.name: Linanum Telisium
rites.text: A practitioner releases one dark sphere at a foe, dealing light harm. The strike leaves the caster weakened by a lingering burden.

rites.name: Teliria
rites.text: A craft by which a wielder can coax foes into releasing the goods they carry. Each strike holds a chance to shake loose a dropped treasure from the struck foe.

rites.name: Cilaustes
rites.text: A protective craft that hardens its wielder against strikes of storm and lightning. It can be layered several times over to strengthen its guard.

rites.name: Sasintor
rites.text: A cantrip-like craft that lets its practitioner unleash a rolling array of arcane strikes upon foes. It is taught within ritual circles of spellwrights who favor flourish over brute force.

rites.name: Amostor
rites.text: A swift combat art in which a warrior unleashes a flurry of rapid strikes that cut down many foes at once. It is a surge of power drawn from a moment of peak resolve.

rites.name: Varornum
rites.text: A coiling wind-craft that practitioners draw on in a special attack. It appears within a shared-world battle system where allies combine their gifts.

rites.name: Lyaneirleth
rites.text: Lyaneirleth is the concept of the Weave as it was planted in Alaimeinora's Seeding, a lattice of quiet power that the makers laid down before the first sundering. In the Age of Sundering it became the thread that landfall tore apart, scattering old bonds across the shifting shores.

rites.name: Niantales
rites.text: A technique that appears in a fantasy realm's combat traditions, drawing on hidden shadowy forces. It is one of the special attacks practiced there.

rites.name: Valintoles
rites.text: A reflex technique in which a fighter answers an incoming blow with a counterstrike launched while still airborne. It turns the attacker's own force back against them mid-leap.

rites.name: Castanum
rites.text: A fighter launches a foe skyward with a rising strike, then spins through the air to deliver a finishing blow. Only one warrior in this world knows the maneuver.

rites.name: Selia
rites.text: A fighting art in which a wielder unleashes a rapid storm of strikes that overwhelms enemies. It is used to crush opponents beneath a sudden flurry of blows.

rites.name: Rilanum
rites.text: A transformation technique that reshapes a bearer's weapon into a pair of twin hooked claws. The bearer then tears through foes with rapid, slashing strikes.

rites.name: Neornia
rites.text: A craft by which a practitioner gathers inner force and then releases it outward in every direction at once. It is a technique taught to those who master the flow of their own power.

rites.name: Orellastes
rites.text: A devastating final technique that only one specific warrior is able to unleash. It sits at the highest tier of a fighter's ultimate arts and is recorded in the training of two separate editions of the tale.

rites.name: Visaurnium
rites.text: A practiced fighting method in which a wielder unleashes a rapid chain of blows against foes. It lets the striker press an opponent with a flurry of successive hits.

rites.name: Maulontium
rites.text: A fighting stance that a few trained wanderers may adopt, unlocked through sequences of fiery hand gestures. Once triggered, it lets the user unleash a roaring blaze in combat.

rites.name: Telonirnus
rites.text: A fighter encases a weapon in a sheet of frost and brings it down hard on an opponent's skull. The blow carries a cold, icy force that wounds the target.

rites.name: Orirnanum
rites.text: A protective craft that halves the harm a bearer takes while their life force sinks into the danger zone. It reduces incoming injury only during that critical stretch.

rites.name: Teosilium
rites.text: A learned craft that lets a practitioner pass restoring remedies and gentle charms to companions in their party. It lets allies be mended by the one who travels beside them.

rites.name: Teleostes
rites.text: A combat craft in which the wielder hurls a volley of arcane bolts alongside duplicate spirit-figures conjured through a shifting ritual. The bolts strike foes together with the conjured doubles.

rites.name: Tiarnanum
rites.text: A battle craft that lets a wounded fighter land decisive strikes more often as their strength wanes. The lower their vitality falls, the likelier each blow finds a crippling mark.

rites.name: Oroneontus
rites.text: A practiced maneuver in which the wielder releases a cluster of luminous, whirling edges that fly outward toward chosen foes. It is taught as a fighter's signature finishing sequence.

rites.name: Contilus
rites.text: A practitioner calls down a storm of sky-fire upon enemies below. The strike rains lightning onto those who stand against them.

rites.name: Lisauror
rites.text: A fighting technique that a wielder unlocks through a special gift. It lets the user strike with a particular boldness in combat.

rites.name: Nases
rites.text: A practiced technique that lets a fighter leap upward the instant they have stopped a blow. It turns a defensive guard directly into a launch into the air.

rites.name: Amollor
rites.text: A technique that lets a wielder raise a shield-like barrier to deflect blows from every direction. When it succeeds, nearby foes are left bewildered and disoriented.

rites.name: Amolarnus
rites.text: A fighter's technique that lets the user strike back at once after turning aside an opponent's blow. The counter follows directly from a successful block.

rites.name: Serillor
rites.text: A violent martial technique practiced by fighters who wield great blades. It is performed in combat to unleash a rapid, blood-red surge of strikes.

rites.name: Orilium
rites.text: A bearer hurls a dark blade toward a foe in a volley of force. The strike flies forward from the wielder's hand to reach distant enemies.

rites.name: Talines
rites.text: A reactive bond that wakes when a trusted ally stands near. It lets the bearer answer a threat at once, drawing strength from the companion beside them.

rites.name: Ranelia
rites.text: A fiery technique that appears in the wider lore of a shadowed realm. It is performed as a special attack by practitioners who draw on both flame and gloom.

rites.name: Vaurnus
rites.text: A whirling strike technique reserved for one fighter alone. It hits harder when the wielder is wounded and close to falling.

rites.name: Lenalanum
rites.text: A protective skill that shields its bearer from the lingering scorch of flame. Anyone who carries it cannot be left smoldering after a blaze passes over them.

rites.name: Veosium
rites.text: A defensive stance adopted by certain foes in battle. While it holds, their life is replaced by a blue shell of plating that grants added guarding power.

rites.name: Valiasus
rites.text: A reflexive technique that lets a wielder swiftly enter a heightened inner mode when cornered. It lets the user respond quickly in urgent moments.

rites.name: Saneornum
rites.text: A practiced reflex that lets a fighter answer a blow immediately after parrying it. The strike that follows turns a defensive stance into a swift counter.

rites.name: Saurnor Oraurnoses
rites.text: A zigzagging volley of projectiles that strikes foes and leaves them dazed and confused. It is a fighting art practiced by warriors who favor unpredictable strikes.

rites.name: Vaullinanum
rites.text: A learned defensive art that restores a wielder's inner reserve each time they successfully hold back an enemy's blow. It turns the moment of shielding into a source of renewed strength.

rites.name: Leria
rites.text: A defensive craft that lets the wielder occasionally freeze an attacker in place while holding a guard. It turns a simple block into a chance to bind the foe.

rites.name: Coralleones
rites.text: A defensive craft that lets a warrior hold a guard and, now and then, hurl an opponent upward into the air. It is practiced in the sundered lands.

rites.name: Molliarnum
rites.text: A slow combat art that strikes many times in quick succession, leaping between foes and sometimes binding or blinding them.

rites.name: Teleorus
rites.text: A practiced knack that lets a wielder fill their inner timekeeping gauge faster whenever their life force falls to a quarter of its strength.

rites.name: Orireoles
rites.text: A combat art in which a fighter sharpens their offensive power while surrendering some of their protection. It is a deliberate trade of guard for fury.

rites.name: Amianor
rites.text: A kindling technique that heightens the harm dealt by blazing strikes. It can be bound into a fighter's repertoire and sustained for a short span of battle.

rites.name: Tanialium
rites.text: A defensive technique that lets a wielder hold off an attack coming from the front. It can be sharpened through linked modifiers and is triggered either by a button press or automatically.

rites.name: Nisteores
rites.text: A forceful technique that a fighter draws upon in battle to strike with overwhelming weight. It belongs to the repertoire of special attacks used by combatants in the wider order.

rites.name: Teleontor
rites.text: A combat technique that appears in the struggles of a fictional realm. It is a special maneuver used in fierce close-quarters fighting.

rites.name: Sarniarum
rites.text: A ritual technique that drives away a hovering lunar presence. It is practiced by wielders who channel silvered energy into a single sweeping strike.

rites.name: Coranontium
rites.text: A bellowing war-shout that a shapeshifted fighter releases at the end of a strike sequence. It batters every enemy standing close around the wielder.

rites.name: Valirnolia
rites.text: A guarded stance that a fighter can call upon to harden their defenses for a short moment. It is one of the techniques taught among combatants in this world.

rites.name: Tiasum
rites.text: A practitioner releases a sudden burst of enchanted light that hurls nearby enemies backward through the air.

rites.name: Nornes Amausaror
rites.text: A leaping strike where a wielder springs upward at a floating foe and batters it with a raised guard. It is a trademark move of a hulking, loyal warrior.

rites.name: Rostum
rites.text: A learned bodily art that lets a practitioner take on a hollow, shifting likeness of another form. The shape worn is a mask of motion rather than flesh.

rites.name: Leosentium
rites.text: A practiced casting craft lets a caster hurl a large blazing sphere of flame. The sphere curves through the air to chase down foes.

rites.name: Riastium
rites.text: A dark-tinged pull technique that bends weight and force against foes. It appears in the combat arts of a sundered realm.

rites.name: Coriantes
rites.text: A practiced maneuver in which a wielder whirls twin ringed blades before them while airborne, striking one foe with the spin.

rites.name: Neosia
rites.text: A rider mounts a companion spirit and sweeps across the battlefield while exhaling a torrent of flame. The move lets the fighter attack from high above the ground.

rites.name: Seraures
rites.text: A practitioner gathers ignited force and releases it as a powerful blast directed straight ahead of them. The surge bursts outward in a violent eruption before the user.

rites.name: Vornum
rites.text: A combat technique that two allied fighters perform together in a shared battle. It is one of the special strikes used within the arena contests of the realm.

rites.name: Valesum
rites.text: A fiery binding technique used by a single named fighter to trap foes inside a ring of blazing heat. It belongs to one warrior's personal repertoire.

rites.name: Telaniantum
rites.text: A combat art in which a wielder unleashes a sudden burst of bitter chill. It serves as one of the special strikes practiced by warriors in this realm.

rites.name: Telantus
rites.text: A rising technique of wondrous force that surges upward through its user's stance. It is practiced as one of the special arts within the combat disciplines of the realm.

rites.name: Teleneostum
rites.text: A furious discharge of storm-fire that a warrior can call upon in a fight. It appears among the battle arts of the sword-and-shield order.

rites.name: Oriaranum
rites.text: A shadowy technique that a fighter unleashes in a single slashing strike. It is introduced as a newly learned move within a combat art.

rites.name: Amornes
rites.text: A combat technique that heightens the wielder's striking strength when particular circumstances are met. It is a learned skill drawn on by fighters during battle.

rites.name: Nauliantia
rites.text: A bracing discipline that hardens the bearer's guard against blows. It lets the wielder take harder hits before harm reaches them.

rites.name: Taurnia
rites.text: A combat technique in which a fighter hurls an opponent downward toward the earth while in the middle of a sequence of strikes. It lets the attacker drive foes into the ground during a flurry.

rites.name: Oriseontum
rites.text: A shadowed double-practice introduced in the Union Chi tradition, a technique in which two wielders draw on dark power together. It is recorded as a rite of that cycle.

rites.name: Vonium
rites.text: A charged technique in which a wielder releases a crackling bolt of storm energy after first gathering a stored lightning surge. It is a combat art of quick, sharp discharge.

rites.name: Oriles
rites.text: A protective craft that keeps a warrior's guard from being broken by foes. Its wielder's shielding stays intact against enemy blows.

rites.name: Raulonanum
rites.text: A practitioner calls forth a violent spinning gale that sweeps across the battlefield. The technique is taught as a formal martial art within its community.

rites.name: Lausum
rites.text: A paired technique that a fighter performs in a shared strike. It appears among the special moves used in battle.

rites.name: Rinauranum
rites.text: A fiery combat technique that a warrior can unleash in a rushing blaze. It is known under several alternate names and appears in a single fighting system.

rites.name: Ristiasium
rites.text: A shield-bearer hurls their full weight forward in a rushing strike, slamming foes with a raised guard. It belongs to one wandering warrior and is known as their trademark move.

rites.name: Telor
rites.text: A practitioner can call forth a towering crystal of frozen light from the ground. The technique draws on cold power to produce the massive ice form.

rites.name: Casillum
rites.text: A tactic that appears among the sworn companions of a far-off realm. It is a special maneuver unleashed in the heat of combat by those who wield it.

rites.name: Ceoranum
rites.text: A practitioner's craft lets them shift their form into a small restorative flask. The disguise hides the user within a healing vessel.

rites.name: Lanum
rites.text: A learned craft that strengthens the healing effect of restorative draughts. Those who practice it mend wounds more fully when they apply their remedies.

rites.name: Serosium
rites.text: A violent whirlwind technique that appears in the world of the Union. It is a special attack used by fighters in combat.

rites.name: Rellaustor
rites.text: A practiced maneuver in which a fighter leaps skyward and then plummets back down, calling forth columns of radiant light that strike foes below.

rites.name: Ciallistium
rites.text: A ward that transforms every restorative bead into a stronger one. Each transformed bead restores five points of vitality to whoever gathers it.

rites.name: Telaulus
