rites.text: A combat craft in which a fighter channels raw bodily force into a single decisive blow. It is one of the special strikes a warrior can call upon during battle.

rites.name: Telarinium
rites.text: A quiet craft that lifts a bearer's inner measures by one step each time it is invoked. It is practiced by those who wish to steady their own strength gradually.

rites.name: Veolus
rites.text: A tactic that appears in the Ostrel Union, in which a fighter keeps an opponent suspended in the air through a flurry of successive strikes.

rites.name: Varus
rites.text: A swimmer's technique in which a single forward kick is followed by a backward somersault while moving through water. It is a learned skill that a practitioner can use during swimming.

rites.name: Lirniasum
rites.text: A practice that lets its wielder amplify the power of their spells. It refines the strength of sorcery already in use.

rites.name: Sirnonum
rites.text: A technique that unleashes a sudden flare of shadowy force, first recorded in the newer chronicles of the realm. Practitioners draw on it as a special strike within the wider craft of combat.

rites.name: Mintialum
rites.text: A defensive technique in which a fighter braces against an incoming strike and, if timed well, stops it cold while also striking back at the foe. It is a craft used in close combat.

rites.name: Amelus
rites.text: A hurled gourd-strike technique first recorded in a later age of wandering warriors. It is practiced as a special attack among those who train in the lineage of the Union circle.

rites.name: Castia Rosor
rites.text: A combat technique that appears in a fictional realm of heroes and keyblades. It is a special strike used by wielders in battle.

rites.name: Amirnor
rites.text: A protective craft that keeps foes from hurling the user skyward. It guards its bearer against being lifted and tossed through the air.

rites.name: Liastes
rites.text: A borrowed craft that duplicates the working of a rival's marked token whenever one stands in play across the table. The copy takes on the rival's effect for its bearer.

rites.name: Caulor
rites.text: A spectral fire technique that a wielder can summon in battle. It belongs to the arsenal of special attacks used by fighters in this world.

rites.name: Ameornor
rites.text: A combat technique in which a wielder drives a long weapon forward in a single swift motion. It appears among the special attacks used in battle.

rites.name: Serillia
rites.text: A spinning craft that lets its wielder summon grand battle commands without first fulfilling the usual conditions. It bends the rules of readiness, letting a user act before the proper signs have gathered.

rites.name: Corosium
rites.text: A wind-driven technique that hurls a flurry of frozen shards across a battlefield. It is a newly learned art among practitioners of the craft of combat.

rites.name: Volus
rites.text: A combat technique that keeps a wielder's blows from being turned aside by a foe's guard. Strikes made this way cannot be deflected.

rites.name: Telenantium
rites.text: A practitioner leaps high into the air and drives their weapon into the ground. The impact releases a shockwave that scatters nearby foes.

rites.name: Orinornus
rites.text: A protective craft that keeps foes from turning back the hands of a bearer's time. It guards the wielder against any attempt to reverse their clock.

rites.name: Liarnium
rites.text: A practiced craft that lets its user take on a new shape, becoming a solitary wanderer. It is recorded in the annals of the Mirror Scholars.

rites.name: Meoresium
rites.text: A siphoning craft that lets its wielder draw life force out of foes. The stolen vitality flows back into the practitioner's own body.

rites.name: Caustor
rites.text: A practiced casting method that lets a caster call down several bolts of lightning across the ground around them. The strikes spread outward to hit everything nearby.

rites.name: Amentarnium
rites.text: A healing surge that a wielder releases in a sudden rush, mending wounds and restoring strength to allies nearby.

rites.name: Valeres Telolia
rites.text: A practiced fighting art in which a wielder unleashes a rushing deluge of fire upon foes, searing them with a wall of burning heat.

rites.name: Corelium
rites.text: A cold-binding craft that a wielder can call forth in combat as a special strike. It appears among the arts of the ice-wielding practitioners.

rites.name: Coriantes Amirnontus
rites.text: A furious shadow-craft that a wielder unleashes in a single violent burst. It belongs to a set of combat techniques practiced in the wider world.

rites.name: Meonor
rites.text: A ward-craft that keeps foes from upending the bearer's footing. It holds the wearer steady against any attempt to knock their stance askew.

rites.name: Taulernus
rites.text: A force that strikes a foe for a share of their remaining vitality rather than a fixed amount. It is reserved for overwhelming blows, and certain sorcery of weight and pull draws on it most often.

rites.name: Nallus
rites.text: A wandering hero takes on the body of a great savanna beast when entering a sun-scorched grassland realm. The transformation is a shapeshifting form tied to that particular land.

rites.name: Valosarnes
rites.text: A technique that appears in the world of Vorelum, unleashing a burst of arcane force. It is a special form of attack drawn from the practice of spellcraft.

rites.name: Rastes Monteoses
rites.text: A combat maneuver used by warriors in a cold-forged tradition, where a fighter unleashes a surge of icy fury. It is listed among the special strikes available to those who train in this art.

rites.name: Coreorollum
rites.text: A fiery technique that a wielder unleashes in battle. It belongs to a set of special strikes used by fighters in the arena.

rites.name: Corestium
rites.text: A devastating strike that a lone cult-leader uses as his personal trademark. It delivers a final verdict upon an enemy, sealing their fate in a single blow.

rites.name: Coraulium
rites.text: A protective craft that halves the harm a wielder suffers once their life force has fallen to a quarter of its strength. It only stirs when the bearer is pressed near collapse.

rites.name: Oriastenus
rites.text: A surge of strength that a warrior gains when striking back against an attacker. It makes each counterblow hit considerably harder.

rites.name: Sarnauntus
rites.text: A pale, silent force that drifts through the world and binds itself to a quiet dimming of sound and speech in those it touches.

rites.name: Caurnollor
rites.text: A recurring elemental force that flows through the world and grants its wielders the strength to strike with raw, bodily blows.

rites.name: Valaneosor
rites.text: A counterstrike technique where a fighter recovers from being airborne and immediately lashes out at a foe. It lets the user answer an opponent's attack right after returning from a midair dodge.

rites.name: Tiarneonia
rites.text: A fighter braces upon their guard and hurls their bulwark forward into foes. The charge wounds whatever it strikes.

rites.name: Niantium
rites.text: A protective craft that keeps its wielder from being knocked off balance by foes. It shields the user against being jolted by enemy strikes.

rites.name: Tiarnanum Toles
rites.text: A practitioner's craft that turns harm received into restored inner reserves. The sharper the injury taken, the more of that reserve is refilled.

rites.name: Amornia
rites.text: A bracing craft that appears in a fictional world of shifting tides. It grants a fighter greater strength and sturdier guard.

rites.name: Teliasenes
rites.text: A fighter spins two rods of their weapon in a whirl and hurls a pair of looping bolts, one golden and one violet. The bolts burst into blinding light when they strike a foe.

rites.name: Releosus
rites.text: A fighting art where a warrior waits to be struck and sent flying, then turns the blow into a fierce counter-cut against the foe.

rites.name: Maurnus
rites.text: A combat technique in which a wielder releases a sudden burst of frozen force. It appears among the special attacks available to fighters in a battle-focused setting.

rites.name: Calus
rites.text: A technique that is introduced in the story of its world as a special attack used in combat. It brings a sudden gloom down upon the battlefield.

rites.name: Calor
rites.text: A bright inner technique that gathers a wielder's resolve into a single powerful strike. It appears as a newly introduced practice among the wielders of its world.

rites.name: Orantianor
rites.text: A practitioner's craft that lets the wielder take on the form of a swelling, buoyant sphere. It is a technique drawn from a shared bond between companions.

rites.name: Sastia
rites.text: A technique introduced in a fictional world that lets a user conjure a volley of frozen spikes. It is considered a special attack in that world's combat arts.

rites.name: Vaunteorium
rites.text: A joint technique in which a wielder strikes alongside three companions at once. The move lets the user combine their attack with allies.

rites.name: Sereneosia
rites.text: A fighter flings their staff at a foe, and some opponents spill out sealed chests of rewards. A jingling chime sounds while the staff spins through the air, much like a close relative of this maneuver.

rites.name: Lirnium
rites.text: A dark chant that sounds through a rival warrior's battles, its tune tying him to his foes. It accompanies the moment when a shadowed champion's strength is revealed.

rites.name: Linanum Lontirus
rites.text: A deceptive craft that lets a practitioner sometimes mend their wounds by spending their reserve of magical energy. It turns the cost of spellwork into a chance at restoration.

rites.name: Rillanum
rites.text: A fighter wraps their weapon in crackling storm energy, then lunges forward with a charging strike that hits foes hard with electric force.

rites.name: Teolor Nauntia
rites.text: A fiery technique that appears in the realm of Tharokai's arena trials. It is a special maneuver practiced by warriors in the mysterious ruling halls.

rites.name: Solles
rites.text: A protective skill that lets its bearer resist attacks carried by flowing currents of liquid. Several of these wards can be stacked together to strengthen the defense further.

rites.name: Oreornanum
rites.text: A practitioner's craft that lets the wielder restore inner reserves of power whenever they suffer harm. The heavier the wound taken, the more of that reserve is refilled.

rites.name: Niasarnes
rites.text: A binding craft that holds certain practiced maneuvers ready so the wielder can call them again. It keeps those moves on hand for repeated use.

rites.name: Rinum
rites.text: A combat maneuver in which a fighter cloaks the body in crackling storm-light, then spins through a tumbling leap that strikes the foe several times in quick succession.

rites.name: Coreonor Sentirnor
rites.text: A coordinated practice in which a wielder joins two companions and strikes foes with radiant beams. It lets the group hurt enemies together through shared light.

rites.name: Nintes
rites.text: A fighter who blocks a blow successfully may answer it at once with a decisive finishing strike. The riposte turns a defensive moment into a deadly counter.

rites.name: Telornus
rites.text: A fighting art that a practitioner performs in a flowing sequence of spinning strikes. It first appeared among the combat techniques taught in a recent training circle.

rites.name: Cilia Vania
rites.text: A shared fighting method in which a companion joins the wielder to perform a chain of rushing strikes. It is most commonly practiced by a steadfast shield-bearer named Brovin.

rites.name: Meornus
rites.text: A fierce, uncontrolled battle art drawn from a wielder's inner fire. It belongs to one particular fighter who channels it in combat.

rites.name: Maria Aminalia
rites.text: A protective craft that fully shields its wielder from lingering afflictions. It keeps the bearer untouched by any effect that would slow, weaken, or hinder them.

rites.name: Naunolia
rites.text: A practitioner calls down a small rain cloud that hurls crackling bolts of lightning at foes beneath it. It is a finishing art of the skilled.

rites.name: Tiallor
rites.text: A battle craft that lets every ally begin a fight with their full vitality restored. The user of the craft ensures the whole company enters each clash unwounded.

rites.name: Viraurnum
rites.text: A protective craft that fully shields its wielder from lingering afflictions. It keeps the user untouched by such effects while the craft holds.

rites.name: Telianeorus
rites.text: A fighting art in which the practitioner drives forward through a crowd of foes while striking each one along the way. It lets a warrior hit enemies as they pass straight through them.

rites.name: Siania
rites.text: A combat craft in which the wielder hurls three crackling orbs of lightning at an opponent, striking them with harm. It is taught among spellcasters who favor rapid bursts of storm energy.

rites.name: Caunanum
rites.text: A combined strike in which the wielder jabs with the horns and then slashes across the same motion. It joins two earlier maneuvers into a single attack.

rites.name: Lastanum
rites.text: A harmful surge of force that a fighter can unleash in a special strike. It appears among the moves a wielder of the craft may call upon in combat.

rites.name: Amanauntes Coreonesium
rites.text: A fiery combat craft used by warriors in a shadowed realm. It is practiced as a technique that unleashes scorching flames upon foes.

rites.name: Oreolanum
rites.text: A battle technique that appears within a mythic cross-world conflict. It is wielded as a special maneuver by a fighter who draws on its power in combat.

rites.name: Mernostium
rites.text: A combined flame craft that lets a wielder join forces with a feathered companion to scorch foes. Two allies channel their fire together to burn their enemies.

rites.name: Tilium
rites.text: A dazing force that strikes foes with harm and leaves them briefly senseless. In later eras it works as a lingering condition clinging to a target rather than a force of its own.

rites.name: Vialor Saulor
rites.text: A combat technique that lets a fighter strike much harder with ordinary blows, but every strike drains a little of the fighter's own vitality.

rites.name: Amiseontum
rites.text: A wielder unlocks the full potential of a sacred weapon, releasing a devastating final strike. The technique draws out hidden power held within the weapon.

rites.name: Serolisum
rites.text: A fierce close-quarters maneuver in which a wielder unleashes a flurry of rapid blades. It is performed in the style of a practiced duelist's technique.

rites.name: Lyenora
rites.text: Lyenora is the concept of the broken lamp: the idea that a light split apart can still be carried by those who gather its shards. In the Holy Age, the Arcane Orders took it as the teaching behind the Pact sworn after the Sundering, binding flame to vow. It was never a being but a principle that moved through temples and oaths.

rites.name: Oriases
rites.text: A practiced fighter wraps a weapon in swirling air and lunges forward with a charged blow. The rush of wind carries damage into foes.

rites.name: Saullor
rites.text: A practiced maneuver in which a wielder hurls bursts of bright sparks at foes. The sparks scatter across the air like celebratory lights.

rites.name: Seriallanum
rites.text: A practiced skill that lets a defender sometimes draw out restorative tokens of vitality while holding their guard against an incoming strike.

rites.name: Teontaullia
rites.text: A learned technique that heightens the force of a fighter's closing strikes in a sequence. It can be layered several times over to deliver still heavier blows.

rites.name: Serallanum
rites.text: A reflexive technique that lets a wielder instantly enter a heightened combat state when their vitality runs low. It is a quick-triggered surge meant for desperate moments.

rites.name: Rirnium
rites.text: A fighter wraps himself in a shroud of shadow and rushes toward distant foes. Those struck may be marked with a swift and certain doom.

rites.name: Ameoseror
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a wielder grips a weapon by its tether and whirls it in wide arcs while gathering force. The spinning motion turns aside incoming blows from foes.

rites.name: Serauntor
rites.text: A dark technique that appears among the special attacks used in a certain realm of combat. It is a single named maneuver recorded in the field's catalog of forceful abilities.

rites.name: Cinelia
rites.text: A protective craft that fully shields its bearer from lingering afflictions and harmful conditions. It keeps the user's body and spirit steady against any effect that would weaken or alter them.

rites.name: Vauntor
rites.text: A technique that lets a wielder's strikes slow down the foes they hit. The effect may arise with each blow, passing a sluggish weight into the target.

rites.name: Nenus
rites.text: A chill-born craft that sharpens the bite of frozen strikes. It can be drawn from a single card or fitted into a wearer's gear, and its effect lasts only briefly.

rites.name: Cinium
rites.text: A fierce combat technique unlocked by repeatedly striking with swift, simple moves. Once awakened, the fighter's strikes grow far stronger, much like a warrior who swells in power under pressure.

rites.name: Tareoses
rites.text: A shifting craft that reshapes a bearer's sacred blade into a pair of frozen claws. The bearer then rends foes with rapid, slashing strikes.

rites.name: Tistor
rites.text: A fighter learns a rhythmic technique of rapid side-to-side strikes with a long bladed staff. Performed while leaping through open air, it dazes foes and wears down their strength when sustained.

rites.name: Castia
rites.text: A lingering bond grants a traveler twice the learning gained from each deed. Its strength grows when paired with a second gift that also enlarges what one earns.

rites.name: Nistantia
rites.text: A fighter leaps high into the air and drops straight down while spinning, striking foes below with a rotating blow. It is a sudden vertical assault used against enemies.

rites.name: Mistanum
rites.text: A fighter parries an incoming strike and then answers it by lashing out with a ring of sharp edges that spread in every direction. The technique rewards perfect timing with a sudden, sweeping counter.

rites.name: Nonia
rites.text: A reflexive knack that lets a wielder sometimes slip aside from an incoming blow by rolling out of its path without being told to. It appears in two separate chronicles of the same world.

rites.name: Lanernus
rites.text: A fighter spins with twin shimmering blades to rush at an opponent. The strike ends with a rising slash as the two blades join into one.

rites.name: Reorasum
rites.text: A learned technique that heightens the strength of whoever practices it. Warriors use it to make their blows hit harder.

rites.name: Rinanum
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a striker launches an opponent into the air while continuing a sequence of blows on the ground. It lets the user keep an enemy airborne for further attacks.

rites.name: Taurelum
rites.text: A practice that lets a wielder refill the gauges that power their special strikes. It comes in a lesser and a greater form.

rites.name: Tiarolles
rites.text: A holy technique that lets a wielder join forces with a royal ally to unleash bursts of radiant light while whirling in a spin.

rites.name: Tantolia
rites.text: A technique of overwhelming shadow that a wielder can call forth during combat. It appears in a dark-hued fighting art practiced within the world's warring circles.

rites.name: Serorus
rites.text: A dormant trait that wakes when a bearer's life wanes, doubling the lessons drawn from each foe struck down. It stirs sooner in some lineages than in others, needing a deeper wound in certain bloodlines to rouse.

rites.name: Nalirnes
rites.text: A defensive technique that lets a fighter stop an ongoing chain of strikes mid-sequence. It works when a guarding skill is readied and a specific button is pressed after releasing the directional input.

rites.name: Orosales
rites.text: A short forward leap a fighter uses to slip past incoming blows. While tumbling through it, the user cannot be harmed, and gaining experience lets the leap carry farther.

rites.name: Orosor
rites.text: A defensive craft that lets a practitioner drawing back further after successfully deflecting a blow. The recoil lets them gain distance from the strike.

rites.name: Niseornum
rites.text: A maneuver in which a wielder who has spun around a large foe then hurls it outward, sending it crashing into nearby opponents.

rites.name: Orenastanum
rites.text: A learned technique that lengthens the time a shared strike can be held once it is unleashed. It requires a small reserve of drawn energy to be set in place before use.

rites.name: Sauntum
rites.text: A learned craft that appears in a tale of two tellings. It is a trick of shaping and amplifying one's own gift.

rites.name: Amaurornum
rites.text: A learned talent that lets its bearer call upon a particular command without first meeting its usual conditions. It can be layered several times over to strengthen what it grants.

rites.name: Niantes
rites.text: A fighter rides a falling stone from the heavens together with their companions and smashes it down onto the ground. The impact is a striking attack used in combat.

rites.name: Rinteorium
rites.text: A rider crouches atop a loyal companion's back and charges into foes, leaving a frosty trail in the wake of the rush.

rites.name: Orosteosor
rites.text: A set of special techniques that let a practitioner take on the shape of a different monstrous creature. It exists only within one particular version of the work.

rites.name: Cenor
rites.text: A two-part strike performed in succession, one blow from the right followed by one from the left. Practitioners usually use each half separately, saving the pairing for a special rush.

rites.name: Vaunium
rites.text: A bearer strikes by tearing open shadowy gates and bursting through them with a blade, then slams the ground to raise a blinding pillar of light. A stronger variant hurls dark fire orbs that halt a foe in place.

rites.name: Coraullium
rites.text: A ring-dancer's technique where a wielder rolls sideways across the ground, scorching any foe struck along the way. It offers no shield of safety while the body turns.

rites.name: Mianum Serostum
rites.text: A bound book of arcane lore that a sorcerer can wield in battle. It can be enhanced into a stronger form.

rites.name: Valenor
rites.text: A defensive craft where a fighter catches an incoming blow and turns it into a lifting throw that sends the attacker up into the air. It is taught to apprentices of duelling halls.

rites.name: Orausium
rites.text: A fighter hurls a volley of dark, blade-shaped energy at a single foe. The technique strikes the target repeatedly with many piercing shards.

rites.name: Telentiles
rites.text: A protective craft that halts the countdown meter whenever its bearer is wounded. It keeps the timer frozen during harm so the bearer can continue acting.

rites.name: Viantarus
rites.text: A fighter's technique that lengthens a ground strike sequence by one additional blow. Stacking several copies of this technique keeps adding more blows to the chain.

rites.name: Cereosium
rites.text: A practitioner lunges forward a short distance while a ring of fire spins rapidly around them. The motion pairs a quick dash with a swirling blaze.

rites.name: Telalor Ceornia
rites.text: A wandering gift that rewards its bearer with one point of growth for every footfall taken on foot. Running, leaping, or other motion earns nothing. Only one such gift can be held by a person.

rites.name: Taulantus
rites.text: A practitioner's technique that draws a single foe toward them as if by a hidden pull, then hurls it into surrounding enemies on impact.

rites.name: Corallia
rites.text: A combat technique in which the wielder cuts through an opponent and leaves behind a brilliant flash of light. It was first taught in the wider world of its origin.

rites.name: Telaularum
rites.text: A fiery strike technique that a wielder performs in a combat arts library. Its older name was Scorch Charge, and it is recorded among the forms of the arts.

rites.name: Mentialum
rites.text: A fighter forms a huge blazing sphere in front of themselves, then strikes it skyward so that smaller flames pour back down onto the foes below. It may set a target alight or knock it staggering.

rites.name: Neonia
rites.text: A fighter lifts a foe into the air, then leaps after them and strikes them back down when the timing is right. The downward blow deals extra harm.

rites.name: Mauloses
rites.text: A bearer reshapes the sacred blade into a heavy mallet, striking foes with forceful blows. The change gives the wielder crushing strikes that smash into enemies.

rites.name: Rauntum
rites.text: A combined maneuver in which a spinning turn is followed by a biting strike. Its two halves can also be performed separately, apart from a rapid multi-hit sequence.

rites.name: Nentum
rites.text: A learned technique that heightens the force of a final decisive strike. It can be layered several times over, so each added measure drives the blow even harder.

rites.name: Mauleontus
rites.text: A practiced evasive maneuver that lets a fighter slip out of harm by sinking into the darkness cast on the ground. It is a skill passed between those who train in shadowy arts.

rites.name: Nintium
rites.text: A practitioner calls up a whirling column of wind around their body. The spinning air turns aside harm and shatters any barrier it strikes.

rites.name: Tirastanum
rites.text: A craft that stretches the span of time during which a sequence of linked strikes can be carried on. It lets a practitioner keep a combination flowing for a longer stretch before it breaks.

rites.name: Tanintor
rites.text: A second name for a movement-type rite that appears in one deck only. It can be called upon solely by a bearer while a particular bond is active.

rites.name: Neostiarus
rites.text: A healing enhancement that amplifies how much life is restored by mending spells. It can be drawn as a single card or fitted into a set of several charms for a stronger effect.

rites.name: Seriarnum
rites.text: A dark-edged power technique that appears in the Union engine's special attacks. It is a practice used by the wielders of the fighting arts.

rites.name: Cisteranum
rites.text: A practitioner of a mobile craft spins flat through the air while moving, striking everything within reach in a sweeping arc. It is a maneuver chained into fluid, acrobatic movement.

rites.name: Orontium
rites.text: A practiced skill where a fighter and a companion spirit blink in turn around a foe, striking again and again from every side.

rites.name: Cisium
rites.text: A practiced defensive art lets a warrior turn a successful parry into a burst of energy. The burst sends nearby enemies flying.

rites.name: Valirarnia
rites.text: A fighter leaps onto a cask and rolls it into foes, striking them again and again while the cask stays in contact with its target.

rites.name: Relantanum
rites.text: A passive craft that lets a wielder answer incoming strikes on their own. When the matching counter-techniques are primed, the craft triggers them without any deliberate command from the user.

rites.name: Valiasanum
rites.text: A fighter leaps into the sky and spins through the air in a somersault that strikes several foes at once. It appears in more than one training-hall tradition of combat.

rites.name: Villausor
rites.text: A learned technique that heightens the harm a wielder deals through strikes of a certain elemental kind. Several layers of it can be stacked to amplify its effect further.

rites.name: Viarnontium
rites.text: A learnable technique that lets a wielder turn aside incoming strikes. It is taught through the practice of a rare craft.

rites.name: Veorium
rites.text: A bond that lets a wielder swiftly call a loyal ally to the field whenever a companion has fallen. The summoning happens at once, turning a lost battle into a fresh stand.

rites.name: Telinor
rites.text: A recurring sword art tied to a wielder named in the record. The user strikes an opponent three times in quick succession, tracing a crossing pattern, and a stronger version lets the user leap in close before the strikes.

rites.name: Valarneores
rites.text: A craft where two known skills are fused into a new technique within a practitioner's repertoire. Certain binding stones can add a lasting trait to the fused skill, and rare outcomes sometimes arise from the fusion itself.

rites.name: Maulostes
rites.text: A self-acting craft that refills a bearer's ammunition the moment their supply runs dry. It works without any command from the user.

rites.name: Ameollum
rites.text: A learned craft that keeps a strike sequence running even when a blow goes wide. Practitioners can chain motions freely, even when no foe stands before them.

rites.name: Amillia
rites.text: A defensive craft where a wielder breaks their protective ward after a successful parry, hurling the shards outward to strike every foe nearby.

rites.name: Lolanum
rites.text: A fighter's technique that can be fitted onto certain arms through a sigil ring or a tuned unit. While the wielder's life force is fully intact, each strike always knocks foes off balance.

rites.name: Corosanium
rites.text: A fighting technique in which the wielder launches a clenched fist forward through the air at a foe. The strike deals harm when it lands.

rites.name: Oriastium
rites.text: A closing technique that strengthens the final casting left of any spell, even when only one remains. It makes a last incantation hit harder than the caster's usual power.

rites.name: Teolianium
rites.text: A fighting technique in which the wielder calls forth seven shining blades that fall from above to strike down foes.

rites.name: Telenarnes
rites.text: A combat art in which the wielder strikes foes with claws made of shadow. It lets the user rend enemies using gloomy, clawed energy.

rites.name: Sanum
rites.text: A dark transformation that a wielder of shadowy heart can take on freely, gaining swiftness and feeding a hungry blade with gloom. It is worn by several figures who share a sleek, similar suit.

rites.name: Amastellus
rites.text: A fiery technique that a fighter can unleash in the course of combat. It is one of the moves used in a dueling card-based battle system.

rites.name: Sirnium
rites.text: A remembered technique of forceful detonation that appears among the practiced arts of the realm. It is known to the wielders who learn it.

rites.name: Corisus
rites.text: A learned habit that lets a traveler's restorative tonics be drunk on their own once vitality runs thin. The ability is set in place beforehand and fires without any conscious command.

rites.name: Miarum
rites.text: A practiced craft in which a wielder raises towering columns of radiant light that burn anything standing beneath them. The columns strike foes and cause harm to whoever they catch.

rites.name: Valorus
rites.text: A combat craft in which the user hurls successive waves of toxic globs at foes. Each blob bursts on contact to spread its venom across the targets.

rites.name: Coreria
rites.text: A reflex technique that lets a wielder instantly shift into their most powerful battle stance during a moment of danger. It works only when the user is under pressure and needs to act quickly.

rites.name: Veonaulor
rites.text: A defensive craft that must be bound to a rolling evasion technique to function. It turns aside incoming strikes during a roll, though it fails against foes who answer a blocked blow with an unstoppable counter.

rites.name: Coroserus
rites.text: A practitioner snares a distant adversary with a looped cord and reels themselves swiftly toward the target. The method lets a skilled wielder close distance in an instant.

rites.name: Teostianium
rites.text: A knack that makes objects fall from foes more often. Carrying several copies of it multiplies the effect, boosting the chance of rewards.

rites.name: Cistialles
rites.text: A dark-element spell that conjures a pulling orb, dragging nearby foes, floating pickups, and loose objects toward its center. The stronger the casting, the larger and more forceful the orb becomes, and creatures caught inside steadily lose health.

rites.name: Leostiarnor
rites.text: A tactical trick used within a sparring arena during group contests. Once activated, the next harm the user takes is reduced to a fixed small value.

rites.name: Sontiarnus
rites.text: A learned attunement that lets a bearer regain their inner reserve faster while striking foes. Stronger versions of the attunement sharpen the refilling even more.

rites.name: Mausium
rites.text: A protective craft that keeps its bearer from being clouded by fog-like afflictions. It guards the mind against the dimming haze that spreads through the air.

rites.name: Taullor
rites.text: A ritual technique that calls forth a shadowy surge of power during combat. It is used as a special attack by warriors who wield its strike.

rites.name: Oranentum
rites.text: A winged dive in which the wielder charges straight into a foe. It lets the user strike an opponent head-on with a swift rush.

rites.name: Corarnum
rites.text: A craft that quietly swaps a companion into the empty place of one who has fallen. The replacement arrives on its own, without any command from the wielder.

rites.name: Meollum
rites.text: A fighter who is struck while airborne answers with a swift riposte before landing. It works much like a recovery technique that lets the user steady themselves in midair.

rites.name: Saurnor
rites.text: A mid-air technique in which a fighter hurls their body into a spinning drill attack, striking an opponent while already caught in an aerial sequence of blows.

rites.name: Serornia
rites.text: A quiet technique that drains a wielder's measured strengths down to nothing. It leaves the user's vital numbers reset to zero until the effect is removed.

rites.name: Teriarnum
rites.text: A bond-craft that quickens a called companion's inner reserve, granting it more moments and strikes within a single struggle.

rites.name: Cornum
rites.text: A three-stage combat maneuver performed by a dream creature. It strikes with a piercing jab, then a slicing cut, then a biting finish, and each stage can also be used on its own.

rites.name: Orasilium
rites.text: A fluid traversal craft that lets its wielders glide across surfaces, leap high, and strike foes mid-motion when they touch certain features of the land. Practitioners are wrapped in a glowing violet haze with trailing lights.

rites.name: Serintium
rites.text: A combat technique in which a warrior leaps into the air and strikes downward through an opponent. It appears among the special moves wielded in the wider arena of battle.

rites.name: Telauranum
rites.text: A set of finishing techniques in which a warrior strikes foes with glowing spheres of arcane energy. The spheres burst on contact and deal damage drawn from pure magic rather than physical force.

rites.name: Taures
rites.text: A passive power that lets its bearer vanish from harm and reappear elsewhere whenever a blow would land. It is granted as the first gift of a linked spirit-bond once that bond is raised to its initial rank.

rites.name: Santernum
rites.text: A fighter spins into a sweeping kick that cuts through foes. It is a technique practiced by those who wield icy force in battle.

rites.name: Tolliranum
rites.text: A defensive technique a fighter raises when an ally is struck. A rival duelist was also seen wielding it against a foe in a later struggle.

rites.name: Valeontanum
rites.text: A combat technique that is newly introduced to a fighting order. Practitioners use it as a special strike drawn from the depths.

rites.name: Nintium Telaunarnor
rites.text: A combat technique that lets a fighter strike foes so they are sent upward into the air. It is a skill that a user may draw on to launch opponents off the ground.

rites.name: Tares
rites.text: A flowering radiance technique that appears in a combat-focused realm, unleashing a dazzling burst of light as a special attack.

rites.name: Tiarneontum
rites.text: A timed defensive technique in which a fighter stops an incoming blow an instant before it lands, turning the block into a stronger counterstrike. It rewards precise reflexes over raw force.

rites.name: Seralium
rites.text: A learned defensive art that a wielder unlocks after mastering a bonded linking technique. Once gained, it sometimes causes incoming spellfire to be turned aside without any deliberate effort from the user.

rites.name: Veones
rites.text: A protective craft that fully shields its wielder from afflictions that cloud the senses or alter the body's condition. It keeps the bearer clear-minded against such hindrances.

rites.name: Neoles
rites.text: A combat craft that lets a warrior strike repeatedly while moving in nearly any direction. It replaces an older counter-slash technique.

rites.name: Seornium
rites.text: A practiced maneuver that lets a wielder, while sliding through the air, push foes aside. It is a technique taught to skilled combatants.

rites.name: Listeolum
rites.text: A healing craft that lets a practitioner mend one companion's wounds and cleanse their lingering afflictions. It is a gentle, focused art used in the middle of hard fights.

rites.name: Valosium
rites.text: A restorative technique that lets a wielder mend their vitality and refill their inner reserve by striking the right moment when a signal appears.

rites.name: Vontia
rites.text: A passive craft that refills a wielder's reserve of mana whenever they absorb harm. Heavier injuries return more of that reserve, and in another form it recharges a focus meter instead.

rites.name: Valostes
rites.text: A finishing strike that sometimes sets a foe alight, causing lingering burn damage. It also detonates volatile charges it touches, since they react violently to flame.

rites.name: Ameostalum
rites.text: A swift strike technique that a fighter can unleash in the middle of a clash. It is taught through the craft of a newer generation of combatants.

rites.name: Oreostilor
rites.text: A combat craft in which a fighter strikes repeatedly from the air in a rapid flurry of attacks. It is one of the special techniques wielded by warriors in the realm.

rites.name: Telesinia
rites.text: A practiced maneuver in which the wielder hurls a rapid volley of shadowy blades toward foes. It is a technique passed among skilled combatants.

rites.name: Oreollor
rites.text: A practiced technique that lets a fighter's closing strike occasionally hurl a foe skyward. It is a concept of combat craft known to wandering duelists.

rites.name: Rianostum
rites.text: A radiant striking art wielded by fighters in an invented realm of gathering arts. It lets a warrior unleash a dazzling blade-based assault within their combat repertoire.

rites.name: Corastor
rites.text: A bearer may drift freely through open air as if carried by the wind. The gift works only in one faraway isle and during a few fierce trials against monstrous foes.

rites.name: Cilles
rites.text: A timed rhythm of consecutive takedowns that multiplies the gathered life-essence. A sealed foe must fall first to begin it, and marked creatures can keep the sequence alive without adding anything themselves.

rites.name: Naurneosia
rites.text: A restorative craft that clears all lingering afflictions from a practitioner's body. Glowing motes drift around the user and rise upward as an amber glow surrounds them.

rites.name: Seralauntes
rites.text: A defensive maneuver that a warrior performs right after a successful parry. The fighter slams a weapon into the ground, releasing a ringing burst of force that rolls outward and knocks back nearby foes.

rites.name: Orilones
rites.text: A bound craft tied to a twin-edged weapon that reroutes any shift into a second shape toward one of two opposing forms. Solo use still lets the bearer reach a separate peak state.

rites.name: Mentor Serenes
rites.text: A stacking craft that shortens how long each strike-card takes to ready again in a fighter's deck. Several layers of it can be gathered by fusing certain cards together with a fleeting crystal.

rites.name: Cernaullor
rites.text: A bonus craft that raises the odds of rewards appearing from shared linking exchanges. Those who learn it find that the tokens returned to them are more often generous.

rites.name: Tentum
rites.text: A culinary knack that helps a cook earn top marks more readily when preparing meals alongside a small helper. Carrying several copies of the knack strengthens its effect.

rites.name: Neollum
rites.text: A transformation technique that a wielder can call upon while holding certain specific weapons. It changes the user's form into a protective state.

rites.name: Ciarnines
rites.text: A bearer reshapes a sword into a broad guard that turns aside blows and answers them with sharp counterstrikes. The guard can also be hurled like a discus at distant foes.

rites.name: Leolum
rites.text: A combat art in which a fighter unleashes a fierce burst of fire against an enemy. It is one of the special strikes practiced by warriors in this invented realm.

rites.name: Telausilor
rites.text: A fighter answers an incoming blow by plunging downward in a sudden kick aimed at an enemy standing some distance away. It turns an enemy's attack into a diving strike.

rites.name: Corentum
rites.text: A practitioner gathers hostile foes inside floating spheres of shimmering film. The spheres can be popped to trap or strike those caught within.

rites.name: Rialor
rites.text: A practiced technique that lets its wielder loose a rapid volley of projectiles toward a foe. It is a combat art drawn from the user's own skill.

rites.name: Amaullum
rites.text: A protective craft that shields its wielder completely from harm. It is a learned technique rather than a physical object.

rites.name: Tastes Tania
rites.text: A combat technique in which a wielder wraps a weapon in swirling air and throws it at foes. The weapon then strikes its targets with rushing force.

rites.name: Laneornus
rites.text: A practiced skill lets a wielder hang suspended in open air for a short spell after leaping. It grants brief hovering that lets the user adjust position before gravity pulls them back down.

rites.name: Seriantarus
rites.text: A practitioner gathers inner energy over a span of stillness and then releases it forward as a single hurled bolt. The method was first taught in a later age of wandering duelists.

rites.name: Tiasteror
rites.text: A fighting art in which the practitioner hurls an opponent skyward by striking with a great spinning boring tool. The strike sends foes soaring into the air.

rites.name: Leonor
rites.text: A fighter vanishes and reappears around a foe several times in quick succession, striking with each arrival. The movement keeps the opponent surrounded and off balance.

rites.name: Leneornor
rites.text: A practiced technique that reshapes a bearer's weapon into a spinning boring tool, letting them charge straight through foes.

rites.name: Telantosus
rites.text: A fighter hurls a weapon in a looping orbit around their own body, striking every nearby enemy several times. It is a technique used in combat to hit surrounding foes.

rites.name: Cantelum
rites.text: A mid-tier battle technique that two fighters can draw on when their attacks are fueled by flame or frost. Striking through a specific kind of command gives it life.

rites.name: Mastisia
rites.text: A fighter curls into a rolling sphere and sends it hurtling toward foes. The sphere may burst into a blast when it strikes.

rites.name: Amontausor
rites.text: A combat technique in which a wielder conjures a swarm of shimmering phantom edges that strike alongside their real weapon. It appears among the special moves available to fighters in the wider Union arts.

rites.name: Amauneoles
rites.text: A maneuver performed in a shared battle gathering. It lets an unlikely ally strike with a fighter's force.

rites.name: Tires
rites.text: A bearer can chain strong spells together in quick succession without pause. Doing so, however, prevents the closing blasts that normally end a spell sequence.

rites.name: Valenium
rites.text: A swift burst of movement that lets the wielder race across ground faster when held. It grants resistance to storm-lightning but leaves the user open to certain strikes.

rites.name: Leontosus
rites.text: A glide-technique that lets a runner launch into a short aerial dash while sprinting across ground. Stronger practitioners stretch the leap farther, and it serves both as a quick escape and as a swift way to travel.

rites.name: Miasor Meosiallus
rites.text: A cold technique that hurls a shard of ice able to turn mid-flight. It tracks down several foes in turn and strikes each one through the body.

rites.name: Rinesus
rites.text: A trader's knack that makes coins, healing motes, and energy sparks tumble more often from fallen foes. Carrying several copies of the knack stacks the luck, and a lesser and greater tier boost the healing a mote restores.

rites.name: Narnum Valistus
rites.text: A shadowed fire-ball technique hurled at a chosen foe by several wielders. In some forms it can dazzle an opponent when it strikes.

rites.name: Cianus
rites.text: A bewildering blow that leaves foes muddled and unsure of their footing. It is a technique a fighter can call upon to strike in a way that scrambles the enemy's wits.

rites.name: Amises
rites.text: A fighting art in which a wielder leaps high and strikes the ground below with a massive hammer. It is used as a downward smashing attack.

rites.name: Orinteostia
rites.text: A passive craft that quickens the gathering of a bearer's inner power whenever harm is struck while their reserve of spirit is mending. Carrying several copies of this craft strengthens its effect, though certain rival enchantments can blunt it.

rites.name: Sarniastor
rites.text: A learned technique that strengthens restorative vials of arcane essence, so each draught returns an extra measure of spellcasting energy to the user.

rites.name: Siarum
rites.text: A fighter wraps the body in a sheath of frost and spins outward, striking every nearby enemy with a cold, whirling blow.

rites.name: Valentiria
rites.text: A practiced trick of slipping aside from a blow while leaving a copy of oneself behind in the same spot. The copy hangs for a moment before fading away.

rites.name: Serallum
rites.text: A combat technique in which the wielder wraps a weapon in radiance and strikes in a rapid barrage, finishing by raising columns of shining light. It is named after a cosmic body whose pull is so strong that nothing can escape it.

rites.name: Tialia
rites.text: A reflexive surge that lets a bearer swiftly awaken their peak transformation when cornered. It is called upon in moments of desperate need.

rites.name: Saurnia
rites.text: A combat maneuver that lets a fighter rush toward a foe at speed. It is triggered by pressing a button in the middle of a combo.

rites.name: Cilia
rites.text: A craft that lengthens how long a bonded summoning call lasts. It stretches the time a shared companion-command remains active for its wielder.

rites.name: Oriases Cauneornum
rites.text: A fighting technique in which the wielder sends foes flying away and then strikes them with a hurled burst of force. It is a combat art used against enemies.

rites.name: Selia Taunor
rites.text: A special technique introduced in a later installment of a fantasy saga, used as a special attack by the wielder. It is a combat art that belongs to the set of special attacks.

rites.name: Launirnium
rites.text: A combat maneuver where a warrior leaps skyward and drives a weapon into the ground. The impact releases a shockwave that harms foes gathered nearby.

rites.name: Maureoles
rites.text: A swift blade technique that appears in a fictional world's combat tradition. It is a close-quarters strike used by skilled fighters.

rites.name: Veosellanum
rites.text: A chance-driven craft that lets a practitioner bestow the effect of a lot drawn at random from a set of granted gifts. It is practiced in a maze-like underground warren.

rites.name: Vorium
rites.text: A combat maneuver in which the wielder swipes sharply with the claw on their right hand. It forms one stage of a longer flurry of clawed strikes.

rites.name: Mastes
rites.text: A defensive technique that lets a fighter block every blow after the first when enemies strike in quick succession. It turns a rapid flurry of attacks into a chance to hold firm.

rites.name: Centum
rites.text: A technique that appears in the Union circle of the stars. It is one of the special strikes a wielder can unleash in battle.

rites.name: Carnium
rites.text: A practitioner wraps their body in luminous energy and dashes forward to strike at foes. The technique is a close-range skill drawn from a shared craft of focused radiance.

rites.name: Orilosor
rites.text: A fighting method in which a wielder uses two sacred blades together to block incoming strikes from every side. It lets the user stand firm against attacks arriving from any direction.

rites.name: Laustiarnus
rites.text: A practiced maneuver in which the wielder cuts through a foe and releases a sudden surge of shadowy energy. It is counted among the special strikes a warrior can perform.

rites.name: Telarum
rites.text: A practiced striking art that lets a wielder hurl a sharp wedge of wind at distant foes. In one sporting contest it is paired with a second strike to form a double blow.

rites.name: Maustintium
rites.text: A evasive strike technique that lets the wielder slip aside and unleash a sweeping counter-blow, wounding foes who stand close by.

rites.name: Teleornes
rites.text: A sudden burst of shadowy force that a wielder can unleash in combat. It appears as a technique within a fighting system.

rites.name: Amiasor
rites.text: A tuned fortune-current that a fighter can call upon during a clash. It raises the number of rewards gathered from each victory.

rites.name: Corises Reolliarnia
rites.text: A fighter who is struck skyward can hurl their weapon back at the attacker in mid-air. The strike turns a downward blow into a sudden return volley.

rites.name: Valasum
rites.text: A learned knack that lets its wielder gather more experience from each clash they win. It sharpens growth through the heat of battle.

rites.name: Costeolanum
rites.text: A coordinated maneuver in which two bonded fighters strike together as one. It is performed during the combat trials of the Union circle.

rites.name: Tisonanum
rites.text: A fighter wraps their weapon in flame and charges forward, striking foes with a forceful blow of burning force.

rites.name: Mausum
rites.text: A set of techniques that lock a target's body in place. The user applies them to halt an opponent's movement.

rites.name: Teleostor
rites.text: A practiced technique in which the wielder releases three interwoven columns of radiance that stream forward in a straight line. The columns pierce through whatever they strike, so several foes can be caught at once.

rites.name: Ciallor Sosanum
rites.text: A fighting maneuver in which a wielder follows a rushing strike with a second charged blow that hurls foes airborne. It is used as a combat art within the training halls of the realm.

rites.name: Orosanum
rites.text: A joint maneuver where a wielder works in tandem with an ally to hurl bouncing orbs of light at foes. It is practiced as a cooperative strike.

rites.name: Valeosanum
rites.text: A practiced maneuver in which a fighter hurls a storm of enchanted shafts straight down from above onto foes below. It lets the wielder strike targets directly beneath them.

rites.name: Oreostaunia
rites.text: A combat maneuver where the user leaps into the air while extending sharp spines outward. The leap and the spines together make it a strike that is hard to avoid.

rites.name: Riniarnium
rites.text: A fierce burst technique in which a wielder spins a long spear in tight circles before hurling themselves skyward to strike foes from above. Its ultimate form mirrors the same airborne assault.

rites.name: Oresia Nastilus
rites.text: A defensive craft that drains an opponent's guard into the user's own stance. It appears as a technique practiced by fighters of this world.

rites.name: Relia
rites.text: A practiced maneuver in which the wielder unleashes rapid, piercing pulses that dazzle foes and leave them unable to see clearly.

rites.name: Orolum
rites.text: A learned technique that makes the user's strikes come faster. In one later form it is carried as a lingering effect that quickens every blow.

rites.name: Molarnium
rites.text: A practitioner conjures a long beam of light before them and three smaller beams behind, which turn together with the body as it spins clockwise.

rites.name: Reollanum
rites.text: A fighter gathers pulsing spheres of energy at the tip of a weapon and hurls them to rain a rapid string of small blasts onto foes.

rites.name: Viselium
rites.text: A craft that turns a chosen quantity back the other way, flipping its values so that what was rises into its opposite. It is practiced as a learned technique among those who work with arcane mechanisms.

rites.name: Telases
rites.text: A fighting art in which the wielder plays a weapon like a small stringed instrument, sending waves of sound rippling outward around their body.

rites.name: Valoranum
rites.text: A combat art that lets a wielder loose streams of light which bounce off foes and surfaces in unpredictable paths. The beams keep ricocheting until they strike something new.

rites.name: Corentarus
rites.text: A combat technique that appears in a fantasy realm, where a wielder unleashes a rushing blaze as a special attack.

rites.name: Taullum
rites.text: A glowing technique that lets a fighter unleash a focused blast of light. It appears in a wider arena of combat skills.

rites.name: Veornor
rites.text: A joyful craft in which the wielder scatters bright paper flecks over the air, ensuring their very next strike lands with devastating force.

rites.name: Amaullestor
rites.text: A shared healing art that lets a caster mend the wounds of every companion at once. It draws on bonds between allies to restore their strength together.

rites.name: Valaulia
rites.text: A quiet craft that lets a traveler slowly restore their inner energy while moving on foot. Walking or running steadily refills the reserves of power carried within the body.

rites.name: Valarnus
rites.text: A maneuver where a fighter springs off a vertical surface, twirls toward a foe, and then slams down to send a ripple of force across the ground.

rites.name: Coriareosum
rites.text: A rider crouches upon a companion creature's back and exhales a freezing breath. The move lets the rider strike foes from the mount's back with cold.

rites.name: Nalausor
rites.text: A combined technique that briefly strengthens the wielder's striking force while also hardening their defenses. It is practiced within the wider art of special combat maneuvers.

rites.name: Orisanum
rites.text: A defensive technique that sharpens a fighter's guard for a brief burst. It is practiced as a combat art in an invented realm of wandering duelists.

rites.name: Tastum
rites.text: A practiced craft in which a bearer hurls a sacred blade at a foe, raising the odds that a reward will be granted in return.

rites.name: Coranum Coraunia
rites.text: A bursting technique that lets the wielder rush across a field, striking any foes caught in the path. It is a sudden, overwhelming ability held in reserve for desperate moments.

rites.name: Sauliasum
rites.text: A paired whirlwind technique that appears in the Union χ training halls of a fictional realm. It is a special attack used by fighters working together.

rites.name: Ceontum
rites.text: A swiping strike performed with the off hand. It forms part of a chained combo sequence used in a timed rhythm battle.

rites.name: Coriasium
rites.text: A protective ward that the wielder can raise to resist attacks of a certain elemental nature. Several of these wards can be layered together to strengthen the defense.

rites.name: Neror
rites.text: A practice that lets a caster strike harder with spells as a chain of casts grows longer. Each link in the sequence adds force to the final blow.

rites.name: Coriastus
rites.text: A practitioner spins in a sweeping arc and calls down many pillars of radiant light that strike several foes at once. The surge also mends a portion of the wielder's vitality.

rites.name: Tauntiarnes
rites.text: A combat technique that appears in the invented world of Thessaly Reach. It is used by warriors to enhance their strength and guard.

rites.name: Valantor
rites.text: A bright technique a fighter draws upon in battle, unleashing a blaze of light that strikes foes. It is practiced through a craft shared among wandering duelists.

rites.name: Ciles
rites.text: A practiced movement lets a wielder dash a short way forward wrapped in a shimmering ward. The ward turns aside blows and missiles while the mover advances.

rites.name: Oresostor
rites.text: A practice that lets a wielder restore their inner reserve of magical energy whenever they endure a blow. The heavier the injury they absorb, the more of that energy flows back into them.

rites.name: Amillanum
rites.text: A practiced knack that lets its bearer mend swiftly after being struck. It lets a wounded wielder recover their strength in a brief span.

rites.name: Rolles
rites.text: A practitioner releases a glowing golden orb of light that seeks out a foe and bursts with harm when it lands. The technique is taught in the wider craft of luminous combat.

rites.name: Tenaranum
rites.text: A practiced craft in which a wielder summons three glowing orbs of crackling storm energy and hurls them at foes.

rites.name: Serenus
rites.text: A fighting craft in which a wielder strikes from beneath an opponent's feet with rays of glowing edge that burst outward in many directions at once.

rites.name: Seosum
rites.text: A practiced technique that lets a fighter loose a volley of shimmering, multicolored orbs upon enemies. It was first recorded in a legendary martial manual.

rites.name: Narnum Amesiror
rites.text: A fighting method where a warrior flings foes skyward in the middle of a flurry of blows. The attacker can then follow the airborne target to continue the assault.

rites.name: Varia
rites.text: A combat art in which the wielder calls down a shower of flaming stones upon foes. It lets a fighter strike many enemies at once from above.

rites.name: Rilleosum
rites.text: A silent craft that a traveler can bind to their gear to stop their companions from growing stronger through deeds. Bearers who carry it keep their first-tier strength and face a harder road.

rites.name: Riantollium
rites.text: A defensive craft in which a fighter holds a shield of steady will against blows from every direction. A successful guard also replenishes a portion of the fighter's inner reserve of focus.

rites.name: Orialus
rites.text: A descending strike a fighter performs from mid-air, cutting downward onto foes below. It is a maneuver used in combat by those who leap into the sky.

rites.name: Solor
rites.text: A protective craft that keeps a practitioner's chosen actions from being held or blocked by rival forces. It is a learned discipline used during contests of will.

rites.name: Sianelor
rites.text: A combat technique in which a bearer hurls a companion spirit wreathed in flame at an opponent. The spirit unleashes a barrage of fire upon the foe.

rites.name: Valialernus
rites.text: A maneuver in which a wielder strikes an opponent from behind. The move is listed among the combat commands of a dream-creature bond.

rites.name: Casorium
rites.text: A wearer's learning quickens in moments of danger, when their strength is low. Each foe struck in such a state yields twice the lessons gained.

rites.name: Sialaustum
rites.text: A fighting technique that lets its user hurl bursts of fireworks at foes. It is a finishing move drawn from the practice of combat arts.

rites.name: Taunirus
rites.text: A learned craft that strengthens a wielder's capacity to endure harm, raising the greatest amount of vitality they can hold. It is taught through lessons passed between practitioners.

rites.name: Seraurus Cinteror
rites.text: A practiced knack that lets a traveler perform certain acts, like casting a charm or drawing on a stored tonic, while still moving on foot.

rites.name: Telauseones
rites.text: A bold martial craft that can be attached to a sky vessel, sharpening its striking force and the rewards it earns until the vessel is struck.

rites.name: Sinor
rites.text: A shaping craft that lets its practitioner take on the form of a drifting blossom. It is practiced as a technique within the wider art of disguise.

rites.name: Orollor
rites.text: A bearer drives a weighted strike downward, sinking force into the foe's body. The blow wounds in proportion to how much vitality the target still holds.

rites.name: Teonostium
rites.text: A fighting maneuver that lifts a foe off the ground with a sudden strike. The attacker then chains a string of blows while the victim hangs in the air.

rites.name: Corernus
rites.text: A two-stage strike performed with a beast's horn. The first blow is followed by a sweeping slice, and each stage can also be used on its own.

rites.name: Monor
rites.text: A combat art in which the wielder strikes foes with beams of light. It lets the user hit enemies from a distance with bright, refracted rays.

rites.name: Canesum
rites.text: A bound craft in which the practitioner calls down a sequence of falling stones from the heavens. Each stone strikes the ground in turn, striking foes below.

rites.name: Coriranum
rites.text: A combat maneuver in which a wielder spins a long blade like a turning vane, striking an opponent several times in quick succession.

rites.name: Niarneostia
rites.text: A furious combat technique that appears in the struggles of a wandering warrior's band. It is a strike launched in a sudden storm of motion.

rites.name: Telintum Moria
rites.text: A cold-burst craft that sends a freezing blast curving after a chosen foe. It strikes the target wherever they try to flee.

rites.name: Maunanum
rites.text: A fighting technique that lets a warrior follow a successful counter with a leaping cut. It rewards precise timing by turning a turned-aside blow into an airborne strike.

rites.name: Cenistia
rites.text: A practitioner drops and spins across the ground in a whirling strike that can leave certain foes temporarily stunned and unable to act.

rites.name: Mauntanum
rites.text: A swift charging maneuver a rider can perform with a creature. The rider urges the beast forward into a rapid rush across open ground.

rites.name: Coriles Teleolus
rites.text: A costly combat technique where the wielder spends a portion of their vitality to unleash a forceful strike. Its burden can also strengthen fragile talents that thrive on low vitality.

rites.name: Amauranum
rites.text: A three-part weapon sequence that strings a downward cut, a sideways cut, and a closing spin or thrust into one flowing attack. Practitioners may use the pieces separately as well.

rites.name: Telalia Tiasus
rites.text: A practiced leaping strike that scatters coin-like tokens whenever it lands. The wielder uses it to gather wealth in the middle of combat.

rites.name: Tollum Miarnelia
rites.text: A gambler's trick in which a wagered die is cast to decide whether a risky move succeeds. Its outcome hangs on a single roll of chance.

rites.name: Maurelor
rites.text: A combat craft that lets a fighter strike with a burst of light. The strike lands in a random manner each time it is used.

rites.name: Niarium
rites.text: A fighting technique in which the wielder spins enormous rotating talons that rip into foes and inflict heavy harm. It is used to strike down enemies in close combat.

rites.name: Telauror
rites.text: A swift technique that lets a fighter glide quickly to the far side of an opponent. It is used as an evasive maneuver in combat.

rites.name: Nisteoria
rites.text: A practitioner calls up three columns of fire that circle around them as they move. Any foe they strike with these burning pillars takes harm.

rites.name: Valelostia
rites.text: A practiced leaping strike in which a wielder springs forward toward a foe. It is a technique drawn from the combat repertoire of the Dreamwardens.

rites.name: Viallor
rites.text: A user and their companion are sealed inside a toxic bubble and hurled into foes. Each strike swells the bubble larger, and when it finally bursts it releases harm onto everything nearby.

rites.name: Vaurnostus
rites.text: A practitioner drives a great spiraling boring-blade forward, lunging across the field to pierce foes. It is a fearsome striking art favored by those who fight with raw forward momentum.

rites.name: Cirnausor
rites.text: A set of drawing-down techniques that lower a foe's guard. The user strips away the target's protective layers, leaving them more open to harm.

rites.name: Ceostes
rites.text: A chilling counterstrike technique that a fighter can call upon during combat. It is used by fighters to answer an enemy's attack with a cold recoil.

rites.name: Costor
rites.text: A combat technique that channels cold into a sweeping strike. It is a special attack practiced by fighters in a shared training tradition.

rites.name: Nestirnium
rites.text: A dreamlike maneuver that appears in a playable companion's repertoire. It is performed as one of the combat commands used by travelers within their shared dream battles.

rites.name: Orellum
rites.text: A combat technique in which a wielder hurls its curved horns one at a time like returning throwing blades. It merges two separate hurling motions into a single flowing maneuver.

rites.name: Corantium
rites.text: A wielder mounts a sphere-shaped companion spirit and rolls into a crowd, knocking foes flat upon impact.

rites.name: Vastisum
rites.text: A spinning maneuver used in a sporting contest, where a creature rotates its body as part of a larger combined action. It belongs to one of the set moves a creature can perform in that contest.

rites.name: Vollenes
rites.text: A practiced craft in which a wielder rides a bound companion spirit as it leaps about, releasing rippling pulses of force with each landing.

rites.name: Orisastium
rites.text: A tactic in which a fighter strikes with the outer hand in a sweeping motion. It forms one stage of a multi-strike sequence used during rapid bursts of combat.

rites.name: Teleolia
rites.text: A practitioner releases a surge of crackling energy that sweeps over nearby enemies, damaging them continuously. It is a technique drawn from the manipulation of charged power.

rites.name: Venium Mones
rites.text: A practiced spell that releases a rippling volley of crackling bolts which drift toward foes and burn them again and again. It is used as a bold combat craft.

rites.name: Cornia
rites.text: A defensive craft where the practitioner, after a successful parry, releases a burst of tiny shards that scatter outward in every direction to strike back at attackers.

rites.name: Cauntum
rites.text: A paired striking maneuver in which a companion joins the wielder to unleash a spinning assault together. It is performed as a shared technique between two allies.

rites.name: Seornolum
rites.text: A quiet reserve that keeps a caster's inner energy from ever running dry. It lets the user keep working their craft through long, grueling days.

rites.name: Seronesium
rites.text: A practiced art that refills a wielder's reserves and resets their charge counter, while also restoring the vitality of every foe nearby alongside the caster.

rites.name: Saseornor
rites.text: A technique that appears in a fictional realm, where a rising column of pressurized water erupts from the ground to strike foes.

rites.name: Vorillum
rites.text: A shaping technique lets the wielder reform a sacred blade into a heavy barrel that hurls glowing orbs of conjured energy at foes.

rites.name: Rastanum
rites.text: A practiced technique that lets a caster sustain a chain of spells while spending less of their inner reserve. It rewards long, unbroken sequences of workings.

rites.name: Orontasia
rites.text: A practiced technique in which the wielder wraps themselves in a flurry of bright and dark beams that strike every foe standing close by.

rites.name: Miarirnus
rites.text: A practiced trick that lets a wanderer spring upward a second time while still hanging in the air. It is a movement technique passed between those who train in agile footwork.

rites.name: Telasor
rites.text: A combat art in which a wielder sweeps a blade through the air to unleash a chilling arc. It appears among the techniques a fighter can call upon in battle.

rites.name: Teoles
rites.text: A combat technique that channels heated force into a sudden blaze. It is wielded as a special attack during battles.

rites.name: Oreornium Seornia
rites.text: A practiced combat art in which the wielder spins through a flurry of strikes and then releases bursts of luminous shot. It is a finishing move for skilled fighters.

rites.name: Niantes Virnallus
rites.text: A glowing rope of light is woven between two spirit beings, and a wielder can skate along it. The technique lets the traveler cross the gap in a single fluid motion.

rites.name: Nalaustum
rites.text: A craft that lets a caster pull the spoils of foes felled by spells straight toward themselves, no matter how far away those foes lie. The loot drifts in on its own.

rites.name: Viaria
rites.text: A shaping craft that reforms a bladed weapon into a heavy striking head. The wielder then batters foes with forceful blows.

rites.name: Loria
rites.text: A defender strikes back right after a successful parry by releasing a radiating volley of glowing shards in every direction. The shards form an angular glyph that resembles a row of sharp teeth.

rites.name: Lerium
rites.text: A piercing technique in which the wielder strikes a foe from every direction at once with beams of both radiance and shadow. It can be used against many enemies in a single flurry.

rites.name: Amauntarnum
rites.text: A shadowy cutting technique that a fighter draws upon in battle. It is one of the special strikes available in a combat system.

rites.name: Cornasanum
rites.text: A defensive craft that lets its wielder raise a shield against blows arriving from every side at once. It is practiced by fighters who need to guard themselves in any direction.

rites.name: Teliastus
rites.text: A dark, freezing technique that a wielder can unleash in combat. It is one of the special attacks taught to those who master the craft.

rites.name: Valenor Sostanum
rites.text: A practitioner spins in place to form a whirling gyre that batters nearby foes. Spinning also releases seeking orbs that spread a hindering affliction, and anyone who steps onto the ring beneath the spinner is left drifting weightless.

rites.name: Coseorium
rites.text: A fighter who is struck and thrown skyward can wrap themselves in a protective ward and surge forward through the air to strike back at the attacker.

rites.name: Vauntinum
rites.text: A practiced strike where the wielder hurls a long blade at a foe, and on contact it drags the target down with a crushing weight.

rites.name: Orontasus
rites.text: A ranged maneuver in which a wielder hurls small airy darts that strike where an opponent is most vulnerable. Some practitioners call it by a separate phrase tied to its follow-up.

rites.name: Larnum
rites.text: A practiced maneuver in which a wielder surges forward while spinning in a rapid, sweeping rotation to strike everything nearby.

rites.name: Oriarnium
rites.text: A swift technique that lets its wielder rapidly refill their ready charges. It is a quick knack for restoring the tools a fighter relies on mid-battle.

rites.name: Coliaria
rites.text: A deceptive craft that bends what observers perceive, first set down in a later account of wanderers. It is practiced as a combat art among those who wield such skills.

rites.name: Corileornus
rites.text: A fighting technique in which the wielder spins in place. It is one of the combat moves a warrior can call upon during battle.

rites.name: Caunium Telinauntum
rites.text: A fighter lifts a foe into the air, then leaps after them and drives them down into the ground. It is a technique for finishing a battle with a sudden plunge.

rites.name: Seroniranum
rites.text: A defender answers a successful parry by releasing a ring of dark shards in every direction. The shards look like snapped glassy tethers and violet hexagonal gems.

rites.name: Liaristum
rites.text: A learned technique that lets the wielder leap far above the usual height, often turning the rise into a spinning flip. Practice can make the leap climb even higher.

rites.name: Valorium Losum
rites.text: A fighter leaps backward and summons three spinning blades of radiant light that pursue foes across the field. The move is a technique passed among duelists.

rites.name: Orarnesium
rites.text: A spinning technique that the wielder unleashes to hurl a burst of jagged frozen fragments outward. It is a finishing move used in combat.

rites.name: Corolaunor
rites.text: A protective craft that shields its wielder from having their movement dragged down by hostile forces. Foes cannot make the bearer move sluggishly.

rites.name: Coreontanum
rites.text: A protective craft that keeps its wearer from being overcome by crackling lightning energy. It shields the body against that charged affliction.

rites.name: Sereostanum
rites.text: A bonded beast-companion is called forth to unleash fiery roars and leap upon foes at the summoner's command.

rites.name: Riarnus
rites.text: A practitioner wraps themselves in a shell of drifting crystal shards, then hurls those shards outward at foes. The technique is closely tied to one particular master of the craft.

rites.name: Valaunes
rites.text: A fighting art in which a practitioner, when hemmed in, summons a host of spiraling borers from the ground beneath foes, sending them bursting skyward.

rites.name: Amiles
rites.text: A protective barrier-craft that a wielder can raise around themselves to shield against incoming harm. It is a learned technique practiced in the realm of arms and battle.

rites.name: Lalor
rites.text: A combat technique that appears in a fictional union-era arena, where a whirling storm of crackling energy is unleashed as a special attack. It belongs to the set of signature moves used by fighters in that world.

rites.name: Nornelum
rites.text: A fighter who is struck aloft can answer back by hurling a flying missile at the attacker. The counter is launched right after the blow sends the fighter into the air.

rites.name: Cinium Ranaustes
rites.text: A craft that cancels an opposing force on contact. It appears as a technique practiced in a fictional world's combat traditions.

rites.name: Vialeorus
rites.text: A combat technique that unleashes a sudden descending burst of sky-born force upon a foe. It is used in the arena of the Union circle.

rites.name: Niaraules
rites.text: A practiced fighting art in which a wielder unleashes a rapid volley of strikes drawn from a hidden stock of tools. It is a trademark move of one gambler-warrior who favors it above all others.

rites.name: Solleornum
rites.text: A protective craft that shields its bearer from being locked in ice or stilled by frost. It keeps the wielder's body moving freely even in bitter cold.

rites.name: Teleonisum
rites.text: A learned technique that quickens how fast a fighter's strikes build up their stored power meter. Practitioners use it to reach their strongest moves sooner in a battle.

rites.name: Veollestia
rites.text: A guarded technique that hardens a fighter's protective stance for a time. It is recorded in the field manuals of the wandering guilds.

rites.name: Teleristum
rites.text: A dangerous sliding maneuver used in a fierce contest of sudden strikes. It belongs to a heavy, bomb-hurling tactic that wears down rivals.

rites.name: Senium
rites.text: A quiet craft that lets a wanderer mend their own vitality simply by moving along the road. The longer they keep walking or running, the more strength returns to them.

rites.name: Laulia
rites.text: A practiced evasive art that lets a fighter slip past danger in several special ways. When a defensive stance shatters, the practitioner can turn the moment into a sharp counterstrike.

rites.name: Teleorium
rites.text: A chance-bending craft that scrambles the worth of a bearer's cards. Each card's value is rolled anew, so the outcome cannot be predicted in advance.

rites.name: Visontus
rites.text: A practiced fighting art in which the wielder unleashes a powerful ring of projectiles that strikes every foe gathered around them.

rites.name: Siasiror
rites.text: A drawing force that lets its bearer gather treasures from any distance without effort. Valuable spoils are pulled toward the user automatically and collected.

rites.name: Ceolanum Taunum
rites.text: A practiced craft that weakens a foe's resistance to arcane force. It lowers the target's ability to withstand spells.

rites.name: Valostes Telolinus
rites.text: A combat technique in which a wielder looses a volley of frost-bound shafts that are followed by a crackling burst of lightning. It is taught within a union of warriors who train together.

rites.name: Tauntes
rites.text: A bold combat technique first introduced in a fictional tradition of arms. It is a special attack that practitioners use to strike with great force.

rites.name: Valornanum
rites.text: A carefree technique that lets its wielder call a gentle fawn-like creature forth to confront foes. The summoned creature drifts toward enemies to unsettle them.

rites.name: Rostor
rites.text: A radiant maneuver that appears in the realm of Union Chi, letting a wielder unleash a dazzling strike of focused power.

rites.name: Carnauntum
rites.text: A protective craft that fully shields its bearer from lingering afflictions and harmful conditions. It lets the wielder move on without being weakened by them.

rites.name: Reonum
rites.text: A practiced strike that calls down a huge spiny gourd, which rebounds off the ground and batters foes around the user.

rites.name: Veolentanum
rites.text: A gliding craft that lets its wielder sweep smoothly across the ground without touching the earth with their feet.

rites.name: Reoserium
rites.text: A coin-bearing craft that turns every reward a wanderer gathers into shining currency. Those who practice it find their winnings always take the form of spendable wealth.

rites.name: Serillontus
rites.text: A fighting art that lets its user perform a chain of attacks by vanishing and reappearing in quick succession. It is taught in several training halls across the valley.

rites.name: Valianintes
