rites.text: A paired technique where a wielder joins with an ally to spin in a sweeping strike, releasing orbs of opposing light and shadow that can inflict a lingering affliction.

rites.name: Oreontanum
rites.text: A practiced maneuver where a wielder spins around a horizontal bar or pillar, striking foes who are lifted into the air. It is a crafted movement taught within the wielder's circle of skilled movers.

rites.name: Sasiallor
rites.text: A combat technique that temporarily swells a fighter's striking force while stripping away the defenses of foes. It appears among the special maneuvers used in the wider arena of this world.

rites.name: Amauntor
rites.text: A combat art in which two fighters coordinate a joined strike, also known as a paired thrust. It appears among the techniques practiced in a particular tactical school.

rites.name: Maullor
rites.text: A practiced craft in which a wielder releases a burst of enchanted projectiles from the tip of their ceremonial blade. It is a technique taught to those who bear such weapons.

rites.name: Tostes
rites.text: A protective craft that keeps foes from catching sight of the wielder. It stops enemies from tracking or seeing the one who uses it.

rites.name: Mesolum
rites.text: A bright technique that releases a storm of blazing sparks to overwhelm foes. It is the trademark craft of a feathered wizard, and its name echoes a dreamlike art spectacle.

rites.name: Teleolernus
rites.text: A gliding technique that lets its wielder dash swiftly past enemies while soaring through the air. It is a mobile skill used to cut through opposing ranks.

rites.name: Varosor
rites.text: A spinning strike that a fighter performs with a carried blade. It can also be linked into a chained sequence of moves used in a duel of skill.

rites.name: Ventiasium
rites.text: A tactic in which the bearer summons many spectral copies that repeatedly rush toward foes. The copies keep charging again and again.

rites.name: Salium
rites.text: A two-part combat art in which the wielder hurls sharp gusts of wind. The strike is split into a right-hand slash and a left-hand slash, which can also be unleashed separately.

rites.name: Tanor
rites.text: A tactic that calls down a falling burst of frost from above to strike foes. It is a special attack used in combat by practitioners of a particular craft.

rites.name: Valeones
rites.text: A combat technique in which the wielder strikes foes again and again with cutting blades of wind. It is used by fighters who favor rapid, repeated slashes.

rites.name: Causanum
rites.text: A practitioner gathers strained energy into a single hurled bolt that bursts outward into a broad explosion on impact. It is a technique for striking many foes at once.

rites.name: Renes
rites.text: A defensive technique that wraps the user in a crackling barrier of storm energy. It appears among the combat arts of a traveling order of fighters.

rites.name: Leornauntia
rites.text: A learned technique that lets its wielder call forth a special command suited to the moment. It is a practiced art passed from one practitioner to the next.

rites.name: Nantollum
rites.text: A user calls up huge shards of frozen crystal that erupt from the ground and hurl foes skyward. The shards strike a marked target wherever it stands and inflict harm.

rites.name: Casium
rites.text: A timing-based defensive craft that lets a fighter parry at the exact instant a blow lands, cancelling the recoil that would normally push them back.

rites.name: Coroniases
rites.text: A practitioner encases themself in a shell of frozen crystal and hurtles downward at foes. The impact strikes with a cold, shattering force.

rites.name: Oriarnia
rites.text: A fighter wraps their weapon in smoldering shadow-flame and hurls it at a foe. The blazing blade streaks across the field to strike the enemy.

rites.name: Lialus
rites.text: A set of powerful final techniques that a wielder can unleash in battle. Each one delivers a devastating strike that often comes with a striking visual effect.

rites.name: Telosum
rites.text: A shared tactic practiced by allied companions that lets them perform joint strikes more frequently. Each partner's readiness signal builds faster when they work together.

rites.name: Nillia
rites.text: A practiced maneuver in which a wielder raises a guard to send ripe fruit bursting outward in every direction. It is taught as a fighting technique.

rites.name: Valorus Meosaullus
rites.text: A combat art in which a fighter lands a blow on foes while drawing back some of their own vitality. The practitioner recovers health with each strike.

rites.name: Laurianum
rites.text: A bright-and-shadow striking method that a fighter can unleash in a rush of motion. It was first introduced in a fictional tournament saga.

rites.name: Rillestor
rites.text: A stackable enchantment that lengthens how long a special spellbound command stays ready for use. Several copies can be fitted together to strengthen its effect.

rites.name: Lelor
rites.text: A practiced craft that lets a caster spend less of their inner reserve when calling upon arcane forces. It makes each working cheaper to sustain.

rites.name: Cenes
rites.text: A practitioner gathers a sphere of crushing weight that drags nearby foes inward. When they strike the ground, the sphere bursts apart in a blast.

rites.name: Siarnesanum
rites.text: A swift technique that appears in the world of the Union, striking with sudden force. It is recorded as a practice that warriors can use in combat.

rites.name: Valoses
rites.text: A joint maneuver in which a wielder and a sturdy companion combine their momentum to charge together at foes. The pair surge forward as one, striking enemies with the combined force.

rites.name: Rasolum
rites.text: A shimmering technique that appears in a fictional realm's arts of combat. Practitioners use it to strike with rippling, echoing motion.

rites.name: Rontastium
rites.text: A fighter gathers force into their body and then launches themselves forward in a sudden rush. It is a move used to close distance quickly.

rites.name: Aminiantus
rites.text: A rare inner gift that rouses a sleeping spirit from its slumber. Only a few beings still carry it, and misuse of it can strip the gift away from its bearer.

rites.name: Serestia Leostanes
rites.text: A practiced technique that lets a fighter shatter an opponent's guard no matter how strong that guard is. It ignores the defensive value a foe has built up.

rites.name: Taustes
rites.text: A fighter flings a heavy blade so it bounces between surfaces, striking several foes in quick succession. The technique turns one throw into a sweep across a crowd.

rites.name: Rallum
rites.text: A joint strike in which a companion combines with the user to pelt foes with a barrage of icy blows. It is performed as a cooperative maneuver during battle.

rites.name: Amiallus
rites.text: A dance-based fighting art in which a warrior moves in rhythm with a companion spirit. Each held pose releases a burst of musical energy that strikes nearby foes.

rites.name: Valesia
rites.text: A combat technique that is introduced as part of a larger contest of skill. It is one of the special attacks a fighter can learn and use in battle.

rites.name: Rarestanum
rites.text: A tactic strong foes use to escape a chain of repeated strikes. Their rising tally of struck blows eventually triggers a sudden counterblow or a swift vanishing away from the attacker.

rites.name: Amollianium
rites.text: A dreamer's strike delivered through a curved crest on a creature's head. It is one of the moves linked into a sequence of striking blows in a rushing contest.

rites.name: Coroserus Amarus
rites.text: A bladed-horn maneuver a beast uses to strike with its crown. It forms part of a chained combo in a later sporting contest.

rites.name: Ameolus
rites.text: A combat art in which the wielder strikes an opponent again and again with edges of frost. Each stroke leaves a cold blade that cuts at foes.

rites.name: Tineontia
rites.text: A whirling technique in which a wielder spins a blade in a rapid circle to strike every foe nearby. It appears as one of the special moves available to fighters in the arena.

rites.name: Reonus Valilaustor
rites.text: A tactic in which a wielder forces a rival to scatter the cards of their prepared arts. The rival must let go of the stored techniques they had gathered.

rites.name: Mallontium
rites.text: A practitioner halts the flow of time for a brief moment and surges forward, striking a foe several times before the moment resumes.

rites.name: Seronanum Tallum
rites.text: A learned technique that lets a practitioner refill a charging meter while casting bound strikes. It keeps focus replenished during the act of channeling.

rites.name: Coroles
rites.text: A coordinated technique that a wielder can use in combat to unleash a special attack. It appears in a newer form of the craft, rising from a practice of blending the arts of several disciplines.

rites.name: Ceolus Amistalus
rites.text: A defensive technique in which a fighter braces to shield an allied familiar from incoming harm while building up its linked power meter.

rites.name: Ceosternus
rites.text: A charging maneuver used by dream-born creatures to strike forward with their head. It is one of the commands a companion can perform in combat.

rites.name: Ceostus
rites.text: A maneuver where a fighter whirls around an upright pillar or shaft, sending foes flying into the air. It is a move from the flow-style combat of the drifting duelists.

rites.name: Coriantia
rites.text: A airborne striking craft in which the practitioner swings a massive mallet down onto foes while hovering overhead. It is taught among aerial fighters of the rising trade cities.

rites.name: Tastiasia
rites.text: A combat maneuver that lets a fighter swing a blade in a sweeping sideways arc. It also forms one link in a chained striking sequence.

rites.name: Orilarium
rites.text: A secondary force that clings to certain blows which strike several times in succession. It rides alongside the blow's main force and adds to each strike.

rites.name: Laustisor
rites.text: A fighter's downward cut delivered with a blade, a quick strike that drives toward the ground. It is also one link in a chained sequence of moves.

rites.name: Ameostium
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a wielder hurls their blade at an opponent to inflict harm. The strike is made by casting the weapon across the distance rather than holding it in close combat.

rites.name: Virnostia
rites.text: A bolt of crackling storm energy that a wielder calls down to strike an opponent. It was once known by an older, heavenly-themed title before a later revision renamed it.

rites.name: Amirneres
rites.text: A rising strike in which the wielder drives upward into a foe, sending it flying into the air. It is a craft taught among duelists who favor vertical pressure.

rites.name: Lausanum
rites.text: A technique that unleashes a rapid barrage of shadowy flame. It was introduced as a newly learned skill for a wielder in a fantasy realm.

rites.name: Amases
rites.text: A restorative craft that mends the wielder's vitality each time a surge of a final technique lands. Fewer blows in the sequence return a greater share of strength per strike.

rites.name: Masium Viasolanum
rites.text: A practiced technique that lets the user spring upward and leap into the air. It is a basic movement skill taught to fighters across the realm.

rites.name: Amaunum
rites.text: A launched volley of falling-star shafts that rains down from above on enemies. It is a special strike that a wielder can unleash in battle.

rites.name: Ciantus Mollium
rites.text: A bright, flaring technique that a wielder releases in a sudden burst of light. It appears as one of the special moves a fighter can call upon in battle.

rites.name: Tesaurnor
rites.text: A shared pair-technique in which two allied wanderers combine their strikes into one joint assault. It lets the two partners act as a single unit in battle.

rites.name: Sanus
rites.text: A bright gift of learning that doubles the lessons a wanderer gains each time a foe falls. It is a craft carried by those who fight for growth.

rites.name: Naullium
rites.text: A fiery technique that is used in combat. It belongs to a set of special attacks, and it is wielded by those who train in the arts of the flame.

rites.name: Sontia
rites.text: A volatile charge of gathered arcane energy that is hurled to unleash a sudden burst. It is a technique a warrior can call upon in battle.

rites.name: Amornases
rites.text: A joint ferocious technique that two allies can unleash together. Its fiery momentum carries them both into a shared surge of striking force.

rites.name: Amoses
rites.text: A downward aerial strike technique that a fighter performs to crash onto foes from above. It is recorded as a standard combat maneuver used in the realm's arena duels.

rites.name: Neollia Vaseollor
rites.text: A paired technique in which two fighters join forces with a partner to unleash two spinning strikes, one of radiant light and one of shadow.

rites.name: Ceralum
rites.text: A practitioner calls forth a gloom that spreads like fog around them. The technique draws on shadowed power to conjure this murky veil.

rites.name: Lostor
rites.text: A craft that lets a practitioner call upon their greatest sorcery more frequently. It amplifies the frequency of the wielder's most powerful spell-commands.

rites.name: Valerum
rites.text: A defensive technique that appears in the invented realm of Lorvaine. Its practitioners use it to harden themselves against incoming harm.

rites.name: Seostanum
rites.text: A fiery technique that rolls outward in repeated bursts of heat. It first appeared in a recent, newer art of combat.

rites.name: Valeosus
rites.text: A fighter's technique that pairs a spinning evasive roll with a cutting strike. It hurts foes it touches while carrying the user clear of incoming blows.

rites.name: Salestor
rites.text: A combat maneuver in which the fighter spins in a wide arc, striking every enemy gathered around them. It lets a warrior clear a crowd in a single motion.

rites.name: Corus
rites.text: A practiced technique that lets a wielder begin a contest of drawn tokens using whichever token they hold next, no matter its worth. It is a trick favored by tacticians and gamblers.

rites.name: Neontellor
rites.text: A hollow-hunting technique that raises the harm a wielder deals to the empty husks of the unbound. It amplifies every blow aimed at such creatures.

rites.name: Tintor Tantaullus
rites.text: A learned technique that a wielder can perform through practiced skill. It is recorded as having been newly taught to its practitioners.

rites.name: Orausarum
rites.text: A bright striking art that a wielder uses to unleash a dazzling sword-based technique in combat. It belongs to the wider repertoire of special strikes practiced by fighters.

rites.name: Nianum
rites.text: A fighter wraps a weapon in biting cold and hurls it at foes. Those it strikes may be locked in place by frost.

rites.name: Nollium
rites.text: A technique that appears in the world of the Sundering Veil, where a fighter draws upon a gentle falling force to strike foes. It is taught in the training halls of the wandering troupes.

rites.name: Corinum Telasteosor
rites.text: A practiced maneuver in which the wielder conjures duplicate shadows that charge again and again at foes. It is a technique rather than a creature or place.

rites.name: Tausium
rites.text: A practiced maneuver that lets a fighter roll clear of harm and then, almost at once, turn that evasion into a counterstrike. It bridges retreat and renewed attack in a single fluid motion.

rites.name: Serirnanum Vollanum
rites.text: A tempest-craft technique that unleashes a sudden burst of crackling storm energy. It is used in the Union arts of this invented world.

rites.name: Tantia Corauntisum
rites.text: A spinning technique in which the user hurls great rotating claws of frost that rip into foes and wound them. It is a craft of cold and motion.

rites.name: Amalleores
rites.text: A learned craft that turns every small restorative spark gathered by the user into a larger one, each worth five units of inner energy.

rites.name: Aminaullum
rites.text: A charged strike technique that a fighter can unleash in combat. It appears within a particular fighting system.

rites.name: Cilles Voniarnor
rites.text: A user wraps their body in a sheet of cold crystal and launches into a sweeping aerial rush. Anything struck by the dash takes harm from the frozen force.

rites.name: Valisernum
rites.text: A swift charging maneuver that a fighter performs to close distance and strike an enemy in a single burst of motion.

rites.name: Seraustor
rites.text: A combat technique in which fire spreads outward from a fighter's strike, carried through the battlefield in the wake of the blow.

rites.name: Riasus Nostia
rites.text: A swift surging technique that a fighter can unleash in a battle-dance. It appears among the special maneuvers of the combat arts taught in the Union circles.

rites.name: Masteolus
rites.text: A fighter lifts an opponent skyward, then spins into a whirling strike that flings them even higher. The move drives foes upward through a rotating gust.

rites.name: Amaurium
rites.text: A practice that lets a bearer hand over rewards they cannot use to companions travelling beside them. The gifts pass directly to allies who can make use of them.

rites.name: Calestanum
rites.text: A protective craft that shields its bearer from being dazed and left unable to act. It keeps the wielder's senses steady when blows or shocks would otherwise leave them reeling.

rites.name: Ameornium Milleornia
rites.text: A drifting, hollow force that clings to travelers' footwear and slows their steps. It is tied to a binding effect that sticks the wearer to the ground.

rites.name: Sastaunium
rites.text: A fighter spins through the air to hurl foes upward, then strikes them again and again while they hang aloft.

rites.name: Teliaror Vorum
rites.text: A learned knack that quickens how fast a practitioner gathers their store of skill-points. It sharpens the craft of anyone who has trained in it.

rites.name: Lerastum
rites.text: A joint maneuver where a wielder and their companion spirit together fire a heavy cannon at foes. It is a coordinated strike drawn from the pair's bond.

rites.name: Telistia
rites.text: A fighter leaps skyward, vanishes to appear above a foe, then strikes downward while a storm of heavy polearms falls around them.

rites.name: Oreontus
rites.text: A glowing trinket that its bearer can use to call a royal ruler to join the group during a field skirmish. The ruler answers the call and fights alongside the companions.

rites.name: Valornes
rites.text: A charging strike in which the wielder hurls their whole body into foes, and flames burst from the crown of horns during the collision.

rites.name: Riasia
rites.text: A sticky golden technique that hurls a heavy glob of amber syrup, which bursts apart into a swarm of smaller drops that scatter toward foes.

rites.name: Saullum
rites.text: A fighting technique that lets its user unleash rapid, flurrying attack combos. It is a learned skill wielded in quick successive strikes against foes.

rites.name: Cisor
rites.text: A practiced craft in which a wielder releases a flurry of crackling sky-bolts that seek out foes on their own. The bolts keep scorching the targets they strike.

rites.name: Leonor Vianaustus
rites.text: A companion's inner charm that automatically restores a fallen ally to their feet the moment their vitality runs out. It is a quiet safeguard granted to those who travel alongside the wielder.

rites.name: Coriantor Ameolenium
rites.text: A coordinated maneuver in which a fighter drives foes together and closes in alongside allies. It lets a group pull scattered opponents into one place for a combined strike.

rites.name: Ameosellus
rites.text: A fighting art in which the practitioner spins vertically and drives a whirling strike downward onto an enemy beneath them.

rites.name: Nausium
rites.text: A combat technique in which the wielder shapes their spears into a winged serpent that unleashes a focused gust at a foe. It is the trademark art of a single renowned spear-warrior.

rites.name: Ameontus Teosastium
rites.text: A leaping strike that lands three blows in quick succession. Only one particular wielder is able to perform this maneuver.

rites.name: Veleonium Cenanum
rites.text: A practitioner hurls a bolt of crackling energy straight at foes, and the strike jolts any enemies standing close by when it lands.

rites.name: Varium
rites.text: A combined technique that gathers three wielders' force into one strike. It appears in several forms and is used during the heat of battle.

rites.name: Solausor
rites.text: A practiced technique that lets a wielder freeze foes in place for a short while, stopping their movements until the effect wears off.

rites.name: Contium
rites.text: A glimmering technique that lets its wielder draw vitality out of foes. The practitioner siphons life force from targets to restore their own health.

rites.name: Lialus Amornaustor
rites.text: A practiced maneuver in which the wielder calls forth seven hued crystals that strike down into foes. Each gem lands with its own force against the target.

rites.name: Ceosium
rites.text: A joint technique that lets two companions combine their strength into one swift, shared strike. It is performed together by a pair of allies working in harmony.

rites.name: Serinasium
rites.text: A bound craft in which a wielder hurls a volley of frozen shards that veer mid-flight, seeking out several foes and piercing through each one in turn.

rites.name: Teosor Villum
rites.text: A combat maneuver where a fighter glides low along the ground and then finishes with a spinning strike that launches enemies upward. It serves as a follow-up move that turns a sliding attack into an aerial blow.

rites.name: Leorniantes
rites.text: A fighting technique where a wielder spins their weapon while launching a cascade of bursting sparks toward foes. It is a showy maneuver that scatters enemies with fiery blasts.

rites.name: Coriarinia
rites.text: A tactic in which a fighter strikes an unaware foe from hiding. It is used as a technique within a dream-based combat system.

rites.name: Rontanum
rites.text: A fighting art in which the wielder strikes an opponent with rapid whirling blows. It is taught as a combat maneuver among trained duelists.

rites.name: Nesaullus
rites.text: A learned bonus that a fighter can gain to strengthen strikes carrying a certain elemental force. Several of these bonuses can be stacked together for greater effect.

rites.name: Teosus Ninor
rites.text: A rapid technique in which the wielder unleashes a swarm of quick strikes that disrupt an opponent's movements.

rites.name: Valonum
rites.text: A practiced technique that lets a fighter end a chain of strikes with a finishing blow that shatters foes. It succeeds most of the time when used.

rites.name: Valaunus
rites.text: A fighter slides low across the ground and then turns that momentum into a whirling strike. It is a combat maneuver that chains a glide directly into a spin.

rites.name: Mialanum
rites.text: A combined strike in which a hair-bound companion hurls three allies from a long braid onto foes below. The attack pairs a lone fighter with two partners and two others, sending them crashing down on their targets.

rites.name: Seosarium
rites.text: A fighter wraps their body in crackling storm energy, then leaps and spins to strike every enemy nearby. The blow hits with a lightning-based force.

rites.name: Vaustisia
rites.text: A learned technique that lets its wielder pass a lasting condition onto companions nearby. It is one of the magic commands practiced by those who fight beside allies.

rites.name: Telestium
rites.text: A short-lived technique that lets a fighter draw on a surge of force to strike harder for a brief moment. Users learn several forms of this burst to heighten their attacks.

rites.name: Tellum
rites.text: A practiced caster hurls three quick blasts of flame in rapid succession at foes. Each burst strikes hard enough to stagger the targets and scorch them with fiery harm.

rites.name: Orasanum
rites.text: A forceful technique that hurls foes backward through the air. The user can also drain the strength of those struck by the blow.

rites.name: Raulium
rites.text: A practitioner gathers a shimmering aura that steadily wears away at nearby foes, then releases a burst that hurls them scattering in every direction.

rites.name: Telonintes
rites.text: A defensive technique that lets a fighter survive a finishing barrage with a single point of vitality left. It works only when the fighter still has more than one point remaining beforehand, and it proves especially valuable against relentless foes.

rites.name: Viastus
rites.text: A practitioner wraps their body in crackling storm energy and spins outward, striking every enemy nearby with a jolt of lightning.

rites.name: Orintes
rites.text: A combat technique that appears in the Union χ special attacks, letting a wielder surge with heightened force for a brief moment.

rites.name: Serialanum Amaneostes
rites.text: A combat maneuver where a fighter joins forces with an ally to launch up to three blazing orbs at foes, dealing harm on impact.

rites.name: Taustasum
rites.text: A combat maneuver in which the user strikes an enemy with protruding horn-like projections. It forms one segment of a larger flurry of blows.

rites.name: Mernilus
rites.text: A fighter whirls a long bladed staff like a turning mill and charges at a foe. The spinning rush may leave the target stunned or otherwise harmed.

rites.name: Rernum Veles
rites.text: A rolling charge technique that lets a fighter tumble forward into foes. It is used as a combat maneuver in close battle.

rites.name: Valorus Rauses
rites.text: A practiced technique that drags an area's foes into sluggish motion, dulling their steps and blows within a set reach. It spreads its slowing hush across everything nearby.

rites.name: Telinor Volia
rites.text: A swift technique that lets a fighter unleash a rapid barrage of blade strokes while suspended in the air. It is performed mid-leap to overwhelm foes before they can react.

rites.name: Valernor
rites.text: A practiced art in which a wielder conjures several elemental spheres and unleashes them in sequence: a burst of flame, a spinning gale, a shard of frost, and a final lightning strike. It belongs to one particular caster.

rites.name: Cernaunium
rites.text: A fighter spins with a sudden burst when surrounded by foes, tearing through their armor and guard. It is a tactic known only to a single school of combat.

rites.name: Orausanum
rites.text: A learned technique of drawing forth a gleaming, aged luster from one's craft. It is used as a special maneuver in combat.

rites.name: Mirentor
rites.text: A fighting maneuver that a warrior performs during combat. It lets the user rise swiftly into the air to strike at foes above the ground.

rites.name: Telaunes Rentes
rites.text: A practiced technique that lets a fighter briefly heighten their striking power for a short span. It is drawn from a battle art taught among wandering duelists.

rites.name: Teostus
rites.text: A signature volley technique in which a wielder fires a rapid barrage of projectiles into unstable rifts, letting them rain down upon foes. Only a select pair of gunmen are known to master it.

rites.name: Teliastanum
rites.text: A channeled reserve of tidal force that a wielder gathers to greatly strengthen their watery and icy strikes. It makes every drenching or frosting blow hit far harder.

rites.name: Mellus
rites.text: A practitioner leaps high into the air and then drops down onto foes, releasing a blast on impact. It is a technique found within a sealed underground maze.

rites.name: Nallia
rites.text: A dormant spark that lets a wandering spirit refuse to fall when a single blow would otherwise end it. Any being carrying at least two units of life keeps one unit left after such a strike.

rites.name: Lentanum Nineostia
rites.text: A practitioner unleashes a rippling cascade of lightning bolts that strike both forward and behind them. Metal barriers placed between the bolts and the ground halt the strikes before they land.

rites.name: Tasiantanum
rites.text: A tactic that lets a wielder call down a gathered orb of force upon foes. It appears among the battle techniques of a rising order of duelists.

rites.name: Serillia Amillaria
rites.text: A fighter leaps skyward and then surges forward through the air, driving straight through an opponent. The maneuver is a rushing thrust executed mid-jump.

rites.name: Corontanum
rites.text: A practiced evasive maneuver where the wielder slips in a rapid arc to reappear behind a foe at the instant its strike would land. It turns a blow aside and gives the fighter an opening to counter.

rites.name: Serastelium
rites.text: A combat art in which the wielder dashes a short way wrapped in crackling lightning. Foes struck by the charge are left dazed.

rites.name: Ceollinor
rites.text: A shared discharge technique where allies combine their charge to shock opponents. Lining up glowing markers triggers a burst that works best in arena contests.

rites.name: Lialarus
rites.text: A combat maneuver in which the user glides low across the ground while unleashing a volley of projectiles at an opponent. The slide also carries the user clear of incoming harm.

rites.name: Seonanum
rites.text: A practitioner summons a storm of enormous clenched fists that pound a group of enemies again and again. Each blow hurls the foes aside and inflicts harm.

rites.name: Taullanum
rites.text: A fighter wraps their body in crackling storm energy and slides across the field to strike foes at a distance. It is a quick technique for reaching enemies who stand far away.

rites.name: Serollernia
rites.text: A practiced maneuver in which a bearer and their companion spirit draw foes inward and then cast them back out. It is used during joint combat.

rites.name: Serontes Vistium
rites.text: A mystic force that bends the flow of moments, letting a caster slow or reverse events. It grants a protective effect that undoes harm done to its bearer.

rites.name: Telauntus Reornestes
rites.text: A fighter releases a rapid volley of serpentine bolts shot from the tip of their weapon. The strike is a practiced technique within the combat arts of the realm.

rites.name: Ameosialum
rites.text: A bearer calls forth a cluster of hovering charges that drift toward foes, striking and dazing them on contact.

rites.name: Sollium
rites.text: A practiced art that lets a wielder send foes away from the battlefield in an instant. The rival combatants simply disappear from the open ground around them.

rites.name: Telauntor
rites.text: A timed strike technique in which the wielder taps at the precise moment to land three falling blows. Matching sigils revealed by the blows yields rewards.

rites.name: Serirum Amanium
rites.text: A dark maneuver that lets a fighter hurl a cutting blade made of compressed wind. In a rapid-strike sequence it forms part of a paired slashing combo.

rites.name: Ventium Orastollium
rites.text: A flowing strike technique that lifts a fighter into the air during combat. It appears among the special attacks used by warriors in this world.

rites.name: Ciria
rites.text: A swift combat maneuver that lets a fighter rush toward an opponent in a sudden burst and strike, inflicting harm on impact.

rites.name: Raustolium
rites.text: A glowing armory technique that calls down forked energy strikes which fan outward in every direction. The blast annihilates all targets in sight and floods the surroundings with brilliant white light.

rites.name: Liastauntia
rites.text: A coordinated strike sequence used by a beast in a rush-style contest. The creature performs it only after entering its fury state.

rites.name: Orarnontes
rites.text: A fighter leaps onto the back of a companion beast and drives forward in a spinning charge that batters every foe in its path.

rites.name: Oranes Valirus
rites.text: A fighter whirls a long crystal blade in a tight turn and releases a volley of glowing bolts that strike foes around them. It is a combat maneuver of spinning force and radiant shots.

rites.name: Coriranum Vollum
rites.text: A practiced craft that lets its wielder loose rapid pulses of sound that travel faster than the air can carry them. The pulses ripple outward and strike with surprising force.

rites.name: Cantesium
rites.text: A tiered craft of conjuring rotating rings of drifting light shards that wound foes. Practitioners call forth ever larger and stronger versions of the same ring.

rites.name: Centistes
rites.text: A ritual call that summons a sea singer, who leaps through the earth beside the caster and releases a stream of water spheres whose shape depends on how well the caster times the leap.

rites.name: Amoneontus
rites.text: A tricky fire-based maneuver that appears in a rhythm of gathered warriors' tactics. It catches foes off guard with a sudden blaze.

rites.name: Riarnium Tornus
rites.text: A tactic of striking an opponent with a sudden lash of a long, sticky appendage. It appears among the combat arts practiced by the wandering duelists of the eastern marsh.

rites.name: Oriasia
rites.text: A closing technique introduced in a late-era union of wielders, drawing on a shared bond to unleash a final strike. It belongs to the arsenal of the craft that binds fighters together.

rites.name: Amesteonium
rites.text: A tactic in which a wielder pairs with two companions and hoists the heavier one as a battering ram, driving them headlong into foes.

rites.name: Coraunor
rites.text: A practitioner's blade releases a volley of glowing azure projectiles toward foes. The strikes arrive from the tip of the weapon in rapid bursts.

rites.name: Mostus Telilum
rites.text: A fighter drives forward at a foe with a rushing charge that strikes hard. The move lets its wielder crash into an enemy and deal harm.

rites.name: Teliastium
rites.text: A gathered-allies technique that makes a combined strike always available as a prompt at the opening of a clash. It lets the wielder call on companions the moment a battle begins.

rites.name: Varnaures
rites.text: A joint technique in which three companions combine their power to call down a radiant column of light. The blazing pillar swallows every foe nearby.

rites.name: Corostor Amintum
rites.text: A fighter wraps a weapon in crackling sky-fire and springs upward to strike foes with a heavy, electrified blow. It is a leaping technique of combat.

rites.name: Meostes
rites.text: A bearer can strike foes from a great distance. The technique is valuable against slippery, hard-to-pin-down creatures that hide from ordinary blows.

rites.name: Seniallus
rites.text: A practiced knack for flinging foes or loose objects through the air with a taut cord of force. It lets a wielder hurl things across a distance with a single swift motion.

rites.name: Orantanum
rites.text: A practitioner can surge forward in a straight rush, striking every foe lined up along the path. It is a craft found within the depths of a winding maze.

rites.name: Naulanum
rites.text: A shared combined maneuver that two allies can perform together in battle. It is built around one partner drawing an opponent's attention while the other strikes.

rites.name: Lanosor
rites.text: A practiced technique in which the user fires a beam of focused light into the ground, causing a column of radiance to rise from the strike point. It is one of the strikes that can be paired with a blast of energy.

rites.name: Leosanum
rites.text: A fighter wraps themselves in crackling lightning and rolls clear of danger, shocking any foes they strike along the way. Its protective window is briefer than that of a plain evasive tumble.

rites.name: Telanaurnes
rites.text: A technique that appears in the struggle for a cosmic keyring of fate. Practitioners gain it as a special art within the wider realm of combat.

rites.name: Ameria Laurnistor
rites.text: A protective craft that keeps its bearer from being overcome by sudden involuntary bursts. It shields the user against that particular affliction, leaving them free to act.

rites.name: Nontastium
rites.text: A combat maneuver that lets a fighter follow a gliding dash through a shadowed path with a downward overhead cut. It is used only when the dash has landed cleanly.

rites.name: Siaror
rites.text: A ranged strike technique that fires a crackling bolt of storm energy at a foe. It appears among the special attacks a fighter can call upon in battle.

rites.name: Teoranum Seriasum
rites.text: A bonded companion and its wielder move together in a rhythmic routine, and each held pose releases a pulse of music-charged force that strikes nearby foes.

rites.name: Vialaurnor
rites.text: A learned technique that lets its wielder call upon a storm-bound command without first fulfilling its usual conditions. It can be layered several times over to strengthen its effects.

rites.name: Rontor Nolleosanum
rites.text: A whirling gale-technique that a fighter unleashes in combat. It appears as one of the special attacks available to practitioners of the craft.

rites.name: Launum
rites.text: A practiced maneuver that lets a fighter vanish upward and call down a ring of gleaming edges that plunge onto a foe below.

rites.name: Ceria
rites.text: A practitioner gathers momentum by sliding along a fixed track, then vanishes into a short leap that lands beside a chosen foe and strikes with a single cut.

rites.name: Ternes Nostia
rites.text: A hurled strike technique in which the wielder flings a sacred blade at a foe, dealing damage when it lands. A later version of the craft replaces it with a different move.

rites.name: Veoranum
rites.text: A joint craft where two allies combine their efforts to unleash a chilling spell that freezes foes in place.

rites.name: Millaunia
rites.text: A spinning maneuver with a weapon that whirls the wielder into a rising storm of air. Anything caught in the gust is battered and flung aside.

rites.name: Calistium
rites.text: A fighting maneuver in which a wielder slams an opponent with a spinning wheel-like motion. It appears in a stylized combat tradition of the invented realm.

rites.name: Nauntor
rites.text: A practiced knack that lets its wielder coax coins loose from foes during a strike. Enemies sometimes shed their hoard when struck by the user.

rites.name: Vareonor
rites.text: A practiced craft that marks a foe so that, after a short delay, the marked creature bursts apart and harms those standing close around it.

rites.name: Naurnillor
rites.text: A learned technique that a wielder can call upon within a clash of arms. It is a craft used during combat, drawing on the strength of the one who performs it.

rites.name: Amistus
rites.text: A coined maneuver that a practitioner uses in combat to strike with a spinning, shadowy sweep. It appears within a set of special attacks in a dark martial tradition.

rites.name: Amintaullus
rites.text: A practiced stance a fighter strikes after a win, which grants extra growth in proportion to the last gains made in that place.

rites.name: Reostum
rites.text: A practiced maneuver in which a wielder hurls their blade at a foe and instantly appears beside it, scattering glittering motes in their wake.

rites.name: Nantum
rites.text: A combat style that lets a practitioner unleash a surge of crackling sky-fire against foes. It is taught as a fighting technique that channels storm energy through the body.

rites.name: Collernes
rites.text: A fighter charges crackling energy into their weapon and plunges downward at foes. The move is a sudden aerial strike powered by lightning.

rites.name: Ameranum
rites.text: A practiced maneuver in which a fighter seizes hold of an allied companion and whirls around in a wide circular arc. It is a technique passed among traveling duelists.

rites.name: Serosor Sauror
rites.text: A fighting technique that lets a warrior unleash a rapid, overwhelming chain of strikes. It copies the flowing sequence of blows used by an older martial art.

rites.name: Coria
rites.text: A moving craft where a wielder rides their weapon across the water like a board, striking foes that come within reach of the glide.

rites.name: Oreoranum
rites.text: A whirling maneuver performed in a fighting-style collection. It is a combat technique that is used as a special attack by warriors.

rites.name: Saullantium
rites.text: A fighter wraps a weapon in crackling sky-fire and then brings it down hard upon an enemy's skull. The strike carries the sharp burn of lightning.

rites.name: Sallisor
rites.text: A combat maneuver in which a wielder and their companion spirit launch projectiles that halt foes in place. It lets the pair freeze enemies mid-motion so they can be struck.

rites.name: Maustiasia
rites.text: A cutting technique practiced by fighters in the wider realm. It is one of the special strikes that wielders can call upon in combat.

rites.name: Lausteontia
rites.text: A quiet craft that stretches the lingering effects of a companion's helping charms, so their blessings persist for a longer span. It is a skill practiced by those who tend allies in the field.

rites.name: Eliorlora
rites.text: Eliorlora is the concept of a hidden current of memory that runs beneath the walls of Alaimeinora, a principle the orders of the Walled Age treated as the source of every first crossing. Its teachers held that a bound thing can still remember what it was before the wall was raised. Its scholars speak of it as the quiet mind of the groves.

rites.name: Teleoristes
rites.text: A transformation that a wielder unlocks after reaching the second stage of either shadow or radiant attunement. It lets them mirror the combat technique of a rival fighter.

rites.name: Serellia
rites.text: A learned technique that strengthens a closing strike the longer a chain of blows lasts. In some forms, every successive blow in the chain grows heavier as the sequence goes on.

rites.name: Reones
rites.text: A tactic that adds one more strike to a chain performed while airborne. It opens easier entry to aerial maneuvers and pairs well with a related booster, and it costs a small charge to carry.

rites.name: Teniastum
rites.text: A tactic that drains a participant's tally when a contest concludes. It is a manoeuvre applied during a trial of skill, weighing against the one who performs it.

rites.name: Nenus Raurentia
rites.text: A maneuver that lets a wielder sweep through open air and then plunge forward to strike foes below. It is a finishing move performed mid-flight.

rites.name: Valeontor
rites.text: A fighter's technique that builds strength with every blow landed while suspended in the air. Extending the sequence with a further flourish makes the closing strike hit harder still.

rites.name: Amolanum
rites.text: A linked power that grows stronger once a run of repeated strikes reaches its peak. Afterward, each blow delivers extra harm to foes.

rites.name: Risteolor
rites.text: A combat technique that lets its wielder land decisive strikes with every basic blow. It turns ordinary attacks into precise, devastating hits.

rites.name: Senoles
rites.text: A dream-born maneuver that a companion creature carries out as a lunging strike. It belongs to the set of techniques used in the dreaming realms.

rites.name: Ameolia
rites.text: A combat maneuver used in a digital battle against a mirrored copy of a hero's shadow creature. It is performed only during the later stages of the fight, when the copy takes on an opposing form.

rites.name: Veostellum
rites.text: A fighter's exclusive technique that unleashes a fierce chain of rapid blows against foes. Skillful timing during flashing cues lets the attacker add four extra strikes to the sequence.

rites.name: Verniasor
rites.text: A reckless drive that stops a fighter from unleashing their final blow while they gather energy. It keeps them striking in endless flurries until their reserve of power is refilled.

rites.name: Mianum
rites.text: A dazzling defensive technique introduced in a newer tale of wielders. It is a practiced art that a user draws upon in battle to unleash a barrage of radiant force.

rites.name: Seraullanum
rites.text: A shadowed transformation that a hero can call upon, drawing in two companions alongside him. It spends all of his accumulated power reserves and reflects the lingering gloom still held within his spirit.

rites.name: Seranolor
rites.text: A targeting craft used in certain moments while traveling through two separate storylines. It is practiced during these moments to advance the tale.

rites.name: Neollia
rites.text: A fighter spins a long crystal blade in a whirl and hurls a rapid volley of blocky shards toward an opponent. It is a combat technique used to strike foes from range.

rites.name: Valeres
rites.text: A combined bearing that fuses two earlier stances into one, weighing bodily might and sorcery equally. It is awakened when a long-lost companion is found again in a ruined stronghold.

rites.name: Amiastus
rites.text: A borrowed power that pulls vitality out of a foe and feeds it back into the wielder. It appears across several related adventures in its tale.

rites.name: Senausia
rites.text: A wielder's blade rapidly transforms into several different weapon shapes, each granting new powers. The change is triggered by a quick command after landing enough strikes, and it also tints the wielder's garments.

rites.name: Coriallum
rites.text: A knack that makes favorable opportunities signal themselves more often during battle. Wielders notice more moments when a lucky turn is ready to be seized.

rites.name: Coreonanum
rites.text: A combat technique that a fighter uses to finish a fierce rush of attacks in a single decisive strike.

rites.name: Maulles
rites.text: A solitary battle discipline that needs no companions to awaken. It draws on a wielder's own former self and costs a fair measure of inner strength to call forth.

rites.name: Teleolanum
rites.text: A bearer learns special attunements that let them reshape into a stronger state, aided by their allies. The gift is bound to a garment granted at a tower of study.

rites.name: Corineollum
rites.text: A combat technique that a wielder performs in a fearless surge, first introduced in a later chapter of an invented tale of heroes. It turns courage into a forceful strike.

rites.name: Toneria
rites.text: A ranged technique in which the wielder looses arrows of ice that zigzag through the air and curve toward their targets. It is used during rail-shooting sequences in a digital realm.

rites.name: Teliania
rites.text: A combat technique that unleashes a sudden burst of force during battle. It appears in a fighting tradition practiced by warriors of a distant realm.

rites.name: Orires
rites.text: A craft wielded by a sea-touched warrior that draws restorative tokens from foes using a pulling force. It works like a sibling technique that hurls foes together, but instead it yanks out their healing essence.

rites.name: Vernianum
rites.text: A learned knack that lets its bearer call upon a frost-based command freely, without first meeting the usual conditions. It can be layered onto itself several times to strengthen its effect.

rites.name: Oresia
rites.text: A bound ability carried by a lab-born companion that multiplies the reward gathered after each defeated foe. It is a basic skill that a wielder can unlock early in their training.

rites.name: Villia
rites.text: A fighter's technique that lets them leap during a chain of strikes. The leap interrupts the sequence and carries the attacker into a new motion.

rites.name: Orania
rites.text: A learned knack that lets companions bond faster during their drills. It raises the closeness, cheer, and small boosts they gain from practice toys.

rites.name: Valaurnines
rites.text: A tumbling sidestep where the performer rolls sideways across the ground in a wheel motion. It grants lasting protection from harm during the movement, unlike a simple quick dodge or slide.

rites.name: Nelles
rites.text: A closing technique used by a wandering warrior, who spins twice to unleash a whirl of strikes before crashing down with a heavy overhead blow. A companion spirit can perform only the final strike.

rites.name: Ternes
rites.text: A learnable technique that a fighter can attach to their combat routine. Once bound in, it makes the striking motions recover more swiftly between blows.

rites.name: Narnum
rites.text: A volatile burst technique that a fighter can ready for use in battle. It takes a modest reserve of stored energy to prepare before it can be unleashed.

rites.name: Leseoria
rites.text: A defensive technique that lets a fighter who has just stopped an incoming blow follow it with a swift riposte. It rewards precise timing with an immediate strike back.

rites.name: Veontus
rites.text: A coordinated maneuver in which one fighter triggers an effect that spreads to companions. The benefit flows outward from the user to nearby allies.

rites.name: Orialanum Sialor
rites.text: A channeled spell-swiftness that lets casters unleash incantations in rapid succession. Its wielder can stack the gift several times, so that prepared workings return to readiness far sooner.

rites.name: Senanum
rites.text: A combat maneuver that appears in a dream-battle system. Within a rhythm-style sequence, it is chained together with two other moves to form a combo.

rites.name: Tanornus
rites.text: A dancer-warrior's technique where she spins in a slender pose while releasing several bursts of radiant force at her foes.

rites.name: Serarnanum
rites.text: A combat method that heightens the odds that the following strike lands with exceptional force. It is applied during a battle to sharpen the next blow.

rites.name: Sernium
rites.text: A combat maneuver a fighter can perform in a modern arena setting. It unleashes a sudden burst of force that strikes foes in a single decisive blow.

rites.name: Seraullosor
rites.text: A repeated barrage technique in which the user strikes enemies again and again with blazing orbs of flame.

rites.name: Raullares
rites.text: A bearer's reserve of spirit refills whenever harm lands upon them. Carrying several copies of this craft makes the refill stronger, and heavier wounds return more.

rites.name: Leoses
rites.text: A linked calling that lets a wielder summon a brawny giant to stack glowing blocks, then smash them so that the blasts scorch nearby foes.

rites.name: Telosium
rites.text: A combat art in which the wielder conjures a floating orb overhead that releases bolts of lightning spreading out in every direction.

rites.name: Vaulentus
rites.text: A bonded fighting technique that lets two allies unite their strength into one combined strike. It draws on a shared rhythm between the partners.

rites.name: Centanum Amelaustum
rites.text: When a caster spends more mana than they hold, a pale rose reserve takes over and slowly empties, during which no spellwork is possible. Once it runs dry, the usual reserve returns and spells work again.

rites.name: Telernistia
rites.text: A combat technique where the wielder hurls a weapon at a foe, striking with cold energy. It can be assembled by combining one frost token with two strike tokens, and it hits more often the farther away the target stands.

rites.name: Neoranum
rites.text: A practice that lets a wielder refill a charged reserve faster while restoring their inner energy. It speeds the buildup of ready tactical power during recovery.

rites.name: Tilanum
rites.text: A reflexive defensive technique that appears in two separate tales of a wandering dreamer's journeys. It lets a fighter guard without being told to.

rites.name: Valares
rites.text: A soaring method that lets a traveler ride currents of air across open skies. It moves faster than running and can also be used to slip away from danger.

rites.name: Sontes
rites.text: A set of closing techniques performed by a wind-wielding swordsman in a played adventure. They let the fighter finish off an opponent with a rush of gusting, airborne strikes.

rites.name: Amalestes
rites.text: A radiant technique that a fighter draws on in a fierce battle. It is one of the special strikes performed in a dramatic combat style.

rites.name: Nallum
rites.text: A fighter parries an incoming strike and answers it at once with a rapid burst of blows. Only one warrior in the lineage of Zarvane masters knows how to perform it.

rites.name: Naullus
rites.text: A learned technique that lets a fighter glide sideways through the air during a chain of aerial strikes. It works only when the companion skill of gliding is also held.

rites.name: Amauntes
rites.text: A transformative power that a wielder unlocks after reconciling with an inner counterpart at a deep-seated sanctum. It draws on two companions at once and drains five charges of stored energy.

rites.name: Telernum
rites.text: A method that lets a practitioner rewrite the underlying structure of a constructed realm, bending its rules to produce a range of altered effects.

rites.name: Sontillia
rites.text: A surge of ultimate power that lets its wielder raise a shimmering shield of energy and fire beams of light at foes.

rites.name: Teostalum
rites.text: A ritual craft that a wielder performs within a ring of pure intent. It appears in two separate tales of the same saga.

rites.name: Oreosia
rites.text: A practiced maneuver that sends rapid pulses rippling outward, leaving foes dazed and disoriented. Its user can use it to throw enemies into confusion.

rites.name: Vernus
rites.text: A sharpening technique that raises the chance of striking a devastating blow. Stacking more of it strengthens the effect, and in its refined form any strike can land such a blow.

rites.name: Manor
rites.text: A learned technique that lets its wielder always fill a charged gauge with transformation commands. The price is that most markers guiding the wielder's special rides and attractions go dark.

rites.name: Ciastum Orosium
rites.text: A learnable skill that lets a practitioner guard themselves while suspended in the air. It can be acquired through training in two separate storied journeys.

rites.name: Talium
rites.text: A learnable ability that a character can acquire and carry into their practice. It is noted as available in more than one version of the same work.

rites.name: Cirnor
rites.text: A swift movement craft that lets a practitioner glide through the surroundings and reappear directly beside a chosen target.

rites.name: Amillus
rites.text: A craft that draws on starlight to form a tiny collapsing void, crushing a foe and leaving them briefly unable to defend. A related form lifts foes skyward, wearing them down as they drift.

rites.name: Oraristus
rites.text: A combat art in which the wielder hurls a stream of liquefied frost at an opponent over a span of time, wearing them down with steady harm.

rites.name: Neolor
rites.text: A combat technique a wielder can call upon while holding certain specific enchanted weapons. It lets the user strike in rapid, flurrying bursts.

rites.name: Valialantor
rites.text: A practiced maneuver in which a wielder hurls a great fiery missile that bursts apart into a spray of smaller shots. It is used as a finishing technique in combat.

rites.name: Valolanum
rites.text: A ready technique that lets a wielder keep loosing projectiles at a foe without pause. It keeps firing on its own until the wielder decides to stop.

rites.name: Siria
rites.text: A bonus technique a fighter gains after overcoming a rival captain. When unleashed mid-leap, the wielder carves four rapid strokes through the air, rising, sweeping, retreating, then lunging forward.

rites.name: Coraunia
rites.text: A festive technique that appears in a wider world of shared heroes and strange realms. It is a special attack that a fighter can call upon in battle.

rites.name: Tiastarnor
rites.text: A bearer can shift into a elemental stance while holding one of two specific long-bladed relics. The stance is only open to them while wielding those particular relics.

rites.name: Tirum
rites.text: A dreamer's technique that lets a traveler plunge into a glowing inner current. It is used as a move during a fleeting encounter with a dream creature.

rites.name: Valistia
rites.text: A bearer mounts the back of their companion spirit and launches a flurry of shimmering energy duplicates. The method lets the rider strike from a moving perch above the battlefield.

rites.name: Amanteosor
rites.text: A practiced technique that lets a wielder reshape a tiny, self-moving substance into different forms. The substance responds to the user's will and changes shape on command.

rites.name: Corum
rites.text: A restorative maneuver that a dream creature can perform in battle. It is one of the commands available to the creature's partner during a fight.

rites.name: Telanium
rites.text: A restorative craft that channels healing energy into a reserve of stored charge. Practitioners use it to refill a bar of readied techniques each time they mend wounds.

rites.name: Solus
rites.text: A single decisive strike of a blade is performed in a fast, flowing manner. It is a technique newly introduced into a combat art.

rites.name: Valaurnum
rites.text: A tuned enhancement that a vehicle can carry to strengthen its turning maneuvers. Once fitted, it makes the craft spin and roll more effectively.

rites.name: Linanum
rites.text: A practiced technique that quickens how fast a bonding meter gathers its charge. Wielders use it to build up their linked power sooner in battle.

rites.name: Corallanum
rites.text: A bearer releases a blown kiss toward a foe as a striking maneuver. The gesture lands as an attack upon the target.

rites.name: Tarnes
rites.text: A technique that lets a fighter unleash a flaming assault during combat. It is introduced as a newly learned skill for the wielder.

rites.name: Raureollium
rites.text: A user launches a seeking shimmer that seizes a foe, freezing it in place and raising it off the ground. Each further strike on the caught target lifts it higher still.

rites.name: Cinia
rites.text: A bonding craft that lets two wanderers draw strength from a company of spirit companions travelling beside them. It lets the pair call on those allied creatures' gifts during their journeys.

rites.name: Tarnor
rites.text: A combat art in which a practitioner calls down a fine, tainted mist that weakens foes and saps their strength. It leaves enemies afflicted with lingering ailments.

rites.name: Solleror
rites.text: A technique in which the user conjures a ring of glowing orbs around foes, then releases beams that strike them from every side.

rites.name: Ceorus
rites.text: A rapid assault tactic in which a fighter strikes at beasts in quick succession. It was introduced within a newer tale of ancient spirits and shifting realms.

rites.name: Nelausium
rites.text: A technique that is introduced in a single fictional world's special attack system. It calls down a dark, thundering strike.

rites.name: Nialles
rites.text: A practiced technique that lets a wielder call forth several tiny spectral figures to strike at foes. The summoned wisps swarm opponents in quick succession.

rites.name: Serirentes
rites.text: A defensive technique that appears in a fictional combat system, letting a fighter brace for a sudden surge of protection. Its name varies among the practitioners who use it.

rites.name: Telistanum Ranes
rites.text: A joint maneuver in which a fighter leaps skyward and hurls an ally like a heavy projectile into the enemy ranks. It is performed by two companions working together in battle.

rites.name: Telanes
rites.text: A bearer calls forth a small creature who darts about, drawing crackling lines of charged energy that close into a sealed ring filled with lightning.

rites.name: Seriantonus
rites.text: A combat art in which the wielder hurls eleven shining blades of light toward an opponent. It is a forceful strike that overwhelms foes with a rapid volley.

rites.name: Meontostium
rites.text: A fighter hurls an opponent skyward and then drives them back into the earth, striking several foes at once. It is a combat technique used to batter groups of enemies.

rites.name: Amisellor
rites.text: A reckless riding art lets a rider mount a speeding cart and spin wildly, striking anything foolish enough to touch it. Those caught in the whirl suffer harm.

rites.name: Telisarnus
rites.text: A tactic that lets a fighter build up a powerful rush. It is introduced in a later installment of a fantasy saga.

rites.name: Raunum Coreornes
rites.text: A learned technique that lets its bearer call upon a special command without meeting the usual conditions. It can be layered several times over to strengthen its effects.

rites.name: Amillenum
rites.text: A shared strike that occurs when a wielder and their companion spirit hit together at the same moment. The timing fills the companion's bond meter.

rites.name: Siallinanum
rites.text: A fighter's technique that lets the user unleash a closing strike at any moment during a sequence of blows. It turns an ongoing flurry into a decisive finish.

rites.name: Corauria
rites.text: A powerful finishing technique that a fighter can unleash in combat. It is introduced in a later, newer version of the struggle between factions.

rites.name: Naunes
rites.text: A fighter's technique for hitting an enemy while plunging downward through the air. The strike is delivered during the fall itself.

rites.name: Cisaurum
rites.text: A bound craft that keeps a wielder's reload tally from climbing once the wielder has cast a return. The tally stays fixed no matter how many times the practitioner resets.

rites.name: Tillenum
rites.text: A recurring combat technique used by a single fighter. The wielder darts through the air, striking foes again and again with rapid blade slashes.

rites.name: Telauntonus
rites.text: A bearer shapes a metal limb into a huge clenched hand that launches forward to strike foes at a distance. It is a combat craft drawn from living machinery.

rites.name: Meollium
rites.text: A furious spinning strike that a fighter unleashes in a shared-hero battle arena. It is a special technique used during combat.

rites.name: Riallium
rites.text: A combat technique that lets a fighter unleash a dark, mangling strike. It is one of the special attacks used in the world's battles.

rites.name: Mesus
rites.text: A craft that stretches the lingering time of every timed effect by adding what remains of a chosen one. It works only on the sustained commands a practitioner has already set in motion.

rites.name: Serentialus
rites.text: A combat technique in which a fighter unleashes a sudden burst of crackling lightning upon an opponent. It appears as one of the special moves available to practitioners of the craft.

rites.name: Orinanum
rites.text: A coined technique in which a fighter releases glowing rings that spin and strike foes. It was newly introduced to the practice of combat.

rites.name: Amaunium
rites.text: A technique that a fighter introduced in a recent combat art uses to charge forward wrapped in dark flame. It is one of the special attacks taught in the fighting arts of this world.

rites.name: Liaror
rites.text: A tiered affinity that tags most strikes made by fighters and foes alike. Harm depends on the tag and how well the struck creature withstands it, though in one lesser rite the tag decides which lingering affliction takes hold instead.

rites.name: Valelontium
rites.text: A learned craft that turns every small attentive gift into a larger one, each restoring a full measure of inner resolve to the bearer.

rites.name: Oreornium
rites.text: A practiced technique that lets a wielder lock onto foes and draw out their concentrated inner energy through a special strike. The stolen energy is absorbed into the user to strengthen their own power.

rites.name: Corenum
rites.text: A restorative technique that draws on flowing water to revive a wielder's strength. It appears among the special moves available to combatants in its world.

rites.name: Aminum
rites.text: A practitioner draws a tiny-particle barrier that wraps around their body. It blocks blows arriving from every side at once.

rites.name: Corolleres
rites.text: A airborne fighting art in which the practitioner darts through the sky, striking foes with a flurry of quick blows. It lets a warrior unleash rapid assaults while soaring above the battlefield.

rites.name: Ameonia
rites.text: A fighter leaps skyward, then crashes down in a steep dive that releases a rippling blast, siphoning life force from enemies caught in its reach.

rites.name: Orarum
rites.text: A joint combat technique where a fighter and an ally call down burning stones from the heavens onto foes, dealing heavy harm to enemies caught beneath.

rites.name: Miarnum
rites.text: A technique that reshapes a wielder's blade into a spinning bore, letting them charge forward and pierce into foes.

rites.name: Cauntores
rites.text: A shadowy projectile technique that is performed as a special attack in a combat-focused world. It is one of the many forceful moves a fighter can call upon during battle.

rites.name: Mauntes
rites.text: A sudden forceful dash that a gifted fighter performs during combat. It is a maneuver used by a dream-linked warrior in a stylized battle.

rites.name: Nornelus
rites.text: A violent spinning windstorm that a fighter can unleash as a special technique in battle. It appears in the combat arts of the wider world.

rites.name: Seriranum
rites.text: A paired combat technique in which two fighters bind their strikes together. One fighter hurls the other through a warping, headlong rush that batters an opponent again and again.

rites.name: Tauntirnor
rites.text: A practiced technique that lets its user draw on their skills more frequently by cycling through them faster. It sharpens how quickly a wielder can ready their techniques again.

rites.name: Orallus
rites.text: A reckless technique that lets a skilled traveler bowl into foes while gliding at great speed, striking anything caught in the path of the rush.

rites.name: Vasintum
rites.text: A paired striking technique that unleashes a ringing wave of force through the air. It appears within a fighting art practiced by a band of wandering duelists.

rites.name: Collaror
rites.text: A combat technique that lets its wielder launch a rapid burst of bubbles toward chosen foes. It is used as a link attack that can strike several targets in quick succession.

rites.name: Coraurium
rites.text: A striking maneuver that a dream creature performs during combat, using a swinging blow delivered from its left side to batter foes.

rites.name: Reornanum
rites.text: A combat technique that appears in the strategy-style battle system of a fictional role-playing realm. Users unleash a forceful, wind-driven strike.

rites.name: Seraullum
rites.text: A technique that strengthens the fluid, flowing strikes of a wielder. It lets each sweeping movement hit with greater force.

rites.name: Nellia
rites.text: A spinning dive technique that lets the wielder hurl themselves through the air toward foes again and again. Each plunge carries the user in a sudden leap at a chosen target.

rites.name: Serintium Amintus
rites.text: A coin-altering craft that turns every small currency reward into a larger one worth ten units. It makes each payout far more valuable to its wielder.

rites.name: Orarnum
rites.text: A practiced craft in which the wielder calls down a sequence of twelve shafts of radiant light that strike a foe one after another from overhead.

rites.name: Orelum
rites.text: A focused technique that lets a practitioner fire a beam of concentrated light at an opponent. It is a ranged strike drawn from raw energy.

rites.name: Menum
rites.text: A fiery technique that a warrior can unleash in combat. It is used as one of the special attacks available in a modern battle system.

rites.name: Neontalor
rites.text: A practitioner conjures a shard of frozen crystal that hangs motionless in the air. When a foe draws near, the shard shatters outward in a burst of cold.

rites.name: Vinium
rites.text: A joint technique where two allies combine their bond and unleash a flurry of attacks shaped like wings made of shared recollections, striking the foe from every side.

rites.name: Valeolor
rites.text: A combat technique that appears in the lore of an invented realm of struggle. It was once known by a different name before its present one took hold.

rites.name: Oriniantium
rites.text: A swift lunging maneuver that lets a fighter strike a nearby foe past their defenses while keeping their own guard raised. It is practiced as a refined combat art.

rites.name: Volanum
rites.text: A dormant inner power is reclaimed by its rightful bearer from within a rival's stored essence. The act restores what was once lost and sealed away.

rites.name: Coreonentor
rites.text: A protective talent that surfaces within a traveler in a dream-like realm of memories. It belongs to a set of abilities carried by those who wander through recollections.

rites.name: Toseornus
rites.text: A coordinated aerial strike in which a companion joins the wielder in the sky to assault foes mid-flight. It is performed as a shared technique between two allies.

rites.name: Seontiasia
rites.text: A special technique that is performed in a joyful combat art. It is used by fighters in a modern-day tournament of heroes.

rites.name: Cinteorus
rites.text: A joint whirling strike that a fighter performs alongside an ally, sweeping through the enemies gathered around them. It is a shared maneuver built on close teamwork.

rites.name: Tisanum
rites.text: A dreaded technique that a user can call upon in battle. It is one of the special strikes first introduced in a recent cycle of the saga.

rites.name: Amenia
rites.text: A combat technique that appears within a modern dueling tradition. It is a special attack practitioners can unleash in battle.

rites.name: Amiasteonum
rites.text: A combat art in which the user strikes with crackling sky-fire, delivering a sudden blow that lands before the enemy can react.

rites.name: Rallus
rites.text: A joint maneuver in which two allies launch one of their number downward onto a foe along a path of frozen rail. It is performed alongside a companion in a shared assault.

rites.name: Serialanum
rites.text: A technique that a fighter can use to unleash a special attack in a clash. It belongs to a newer tradition of combat arts.

rites.name: Amestia
rites.text: A technique that lets a wielder fire a focused beam of light. It is a move drawn from a playful creature's repertoire.

rites.name: Caulor Corinus
rites.text: A combat maneuver that lets a fighter launch upward into the air during battle. It is used as a movement and attack technique within a particular style of fighting.

rites.name: Vianeontum
rites.text: A technique that lets its user cast a status effect on the enemies around them. It is a command drawn from a bond of companionship.

rites.name: Rosum
rites.text: A movement craft that lets a wanderer drift smoothly across short gaps and ledges without extra effort. Runners can climb sheer surfaces that shimmer faintly by sprinting straight at them, and can leap higher while gliding.

rites.name: Mintium
rites.text: A combat technique recorded in a crystal-linked battle codex. It appears among the special maneuvers used by the dual-hearted warriors of the Union.

rites.name: Vaustoranum
rites.text: A technique in which a traveler slips through the dream-world's folds to reappear elsewhere. It appears as one of the dreamers' moves in the Dream Eater world.

rites.name: Valeonus Coriastasor
rites.text: A defensive technique that drains an opponent's guard into a protective ward. It is a learned maneuver used in combat.

rites.name: Miarnoria
rites.text: A flying ring of shimmering energy that a fighter can hurl at foes during a battle. It is a special technique used in combat.

rites.name: Oraurialia
rites.text: A fiery combat method that a fighter can call upon during battle. It belongs to the modern arts of skilled warriors.

rites.name: Coralliria
rites.text: A practitioner projects a shining beam of light that carries them across distant spaces. The beam lets the caster pass through regions that would otherwise be out of reach.

rites.name: Amaunia
rites.text: A shared tactic in which a wielder and a companion fire projectiles together from a first-person view. It lets the pair strike foes at a distance.

rites.name: Teleosium
rites.text: A practitioner in dive-state spins two beams of light around their body. The beams circle outward, striking whatever surrounds the caster.

rites.name: Lenia
rites.text: A technique that appears in a modern-era combat art, where a wielder performs a swift strike. It is a recognized move drawn from the broader fighting tradition of the setting.

rites.name: Telostales
rites.text: A bearer's card-casting recovers faster once their life force drops low. The effect speeds up the time between one summoned strike and the next.

rites.name: Tirnus
rites.text: A practiced technique that lets a wielder call forth a small, cheerful helper bearing a card-shaped key. The helper releases a sudden burst of radiant light across the battlefield.

rites.name: Valilenus
rites.text: A practiced technique that lets a wielder restock their ammunition while still moving. It keeps a fighter mobile and never forces a pause in motion.

rites.name: Ceosaunum
rites.text: A practitioner races swiftly along level beams and taut cables by sliding along them. The skill lets a traveler cross narrow overhead paths at great speed.

rites.name: Amesirnium Vianirnia
rites.text: A combat technique that drains an opponent's protective strength, leaving them open to harm. It is known by several alternate names in the field.

rites.name: Orentia
rites.text: A diving maneuver that a wielder performs by striking downward at a creature's vulnerable points. It is used to break an opponent's defenses through a precise plunging assault.

rites.name: Ronaures
rites.text: A reflex technique that keeps a wielder locked in their recording-glass mode even when struck. Stumbling from a blow does not pull them out of the device's viewing state.

rites.name: Lasestanum
rites.text: A combat technique that appears in the battle arts of a certain fighting tradition. It is used as a special attack in play.

rites.name: Niastilum
rites.text: A tactic in which a wielder sets loose a flurry of small shifting blocks that gather around a foe. It appears in the realm of a particular stellar tale.

rites.name: Tirnium
rites.text: A harnessed crackle of lightning is focused into a narrow beam that a fighter releases in battle. It appears as one of the special strikes practitioners can call upon.

rites.name: Coreoses
rites.text: A glittering volley of focused light beams that a fighter unleashes in rapid succession. It is a special technique practiced in the arena of the Union circle.

rites.name: Coriasor
rites.text: A set of practiced techniques that lets a fighter replicate another charm's special strike. When the copied slot is empty, the fighter instead performs a plain strike, and the copy draws on the charm's own strength and energy cost.

rites.name: Rosor
rites.text: A learned technique that strengthens a wielder's arcane energy. It lets the user channel stronger spells than before.

rites.name: Niallarium
rites.text: A spinning maneuver performed by a dream-bound companion in a fantasy realm. It is one of the moves that such companions can use in combat.

rites.name: Taurnelum
rites.text: A combat technique that appears in a fictional union-based battle system. It is used as a special attack by fighters in that setting.

rites.name: Miastor
rites.text: A fighter drops into a quick sideways glide straight behind their own body, slipping past incoming blows. The glide finishes with a whirling cut aimed at nearby foes.

rites.name: Telareosor
rites.text: A practiced maneuver that lets a fighter blink across the field and dart at foes again and again. It is performed as a flurry of rapid lunges.

rites.name: Viror
rites.text: A learned maneuver of coordinated force that a creature can unleash in battle. It appears as one of the techniques available to fighters who train in the art.

rites.name: Tentanum
rites.text: A practiced technique that strengthens the force of thrown or launched strikes. It boosts the power of projectile attacks like hurled blasts and flung volleys.

rites.name: Ronor
rites.text: A bladed maneuver that a wielder performs during combat. It appears among the special attacks available to fighters in a larger struggle.

rites.name: Amernium Coreostirus
rites.text: A flashing technique that appears in a combat-oriented realm of light and heart. It lets a fighter unleash a sudden burst of brilliant energy during battle.

rites.name: Loseontes
rites.text: A user vanishes into a streak of energy in the direction they dodge, then reappears at the streak's far end a moment later. The trail's color and feathery residue change with the user's form.

rites.name: Siantistium
rites.text: A shared tactic that lengthens how long companions can keep a joint strike command ready. It lets allies stay coordinated in battle for a longer window.

rites.name: Valoles
rites.text: A learned skill that lets its bearer call upon a special command without meeting the usual conditions. It can be stacked several times over to strengthen its effects.

rites.name: Lilor
rites.text: A practitioner calls down a sequence of glowing star-shards that strike foes in rapid succession. It is a technique wielded in combat to hammer enemies with a volley of celestial blasts.

rites.name: Ceontialor
rites.text: A coined maneuver that a dream-bound companion can perform in a dreaming battle. It is one of several commands its wielder may call upon during a fight.

rites.name: Mistus
rites.text: A quick evasive maneuver that lets a fighter tumble swiftly clear of danger. It also grazes foes caught along the path of the roll.

rites.name: Telosanes
rites.text: A tricky technique that surfaces in a tale of shifting realms. It is a special maneuver practiced in the middle of battle.

rites.name: Orastialles
rites.text: A combat maneuver where a fighter draws a foe into their own mouth and then expels them outward. It serves as a way to swallow and hurl back an opponent.

rites.name: Calonus
rites.text: A joint maneuver in which a wielder allies with companions, unleashes a thunderous bellow that dazes foes, and then hurls a smaller partner into the stunned crowd.

rites.name: Serornus
rites.text: A swift technique where a wielder skates through the air over a long stretch while flowing through a fluid movement style. It is performed in motion, carrying the user far and fast across open space.

rites.name: Restaullia
rites.text: A defensive maneuver that lets a fighter parry attacks coming from the front while slowing the build-up of a charged gauge. It is practiced as a tactical craft among duelists.

rites.name: Meoranum
