rites.text: A practitioner sidesteps danger by dissolving into the chosen direction and reforming as a rushing smear at the destination. They then whirl their weapon outward, striking all foes close by.

rites.name: Teleornus
rites.text: A combat technique that appears in the battle arts of a modern-era fighting realm. It is a special attack that strengthens its user for a short while.

rites.name: Tentus
rites.text: A combat technique that is introduced in a modern-era arena contest. It lets a fighter break open an opponent's shadow to strike.

rites.name: Corestanum Sores
rites.text: A signature strike technique that serves as the main form of combat power for a wielder. Each sigil bearing its own token grants a distinct version of this powerful strike.

rites.name: Leoliastum
rites.text: A practiced maneuver in which a fighter swings around a fixed post and then follows the arc with a spinning strike delivered while standing still.

rites.name: Tornauses
rites.text: A sudden rush of charged force that a fighter can call upon during a clash. It belongs to a set of trained maneuvers used by wielders in the field.

rites.name: Coriarnus Marnanum
rites.text: A bouncing maneuver where the practitioner rebounds from a vertical surface. It opens the way to further fluid aerial movements.

rites.name: Oresalium
rites.text: A combat technique that is triggered when a specific arrangement of two or three stored tokens is played. Users gain access to it by gaining experience, advancing through events, collecting tokens, or opening hidden caches.

rites.name: Valentosia
rites.text: A practiced maneuver that lets a fighter open a web of small rifts and strike from every side at once. It is a technique passed among skilled duelists.

rites.name: Sauntes
rites.text: A practitioner's technique that fires a beam of light starting near the caster and stretching outward. It can be used as one of several strikes within a combined beam attack.

rites.name: Selor
rites.text: A relaxing technique in which the user spins slowly while soaking in a heated bath. It is performed as a move that a character can use.

rites.name: Corillium
rites.text: A fighter in a fluid, gliding stance lunges downward at a foe, unleashing a rapid burst of strikes during the plunge.

rites.name: Ceornus
rites.text: A practiced maneuver that freezes the flow of time around foes, letting the wielder strike a rapid sequence while slipping through space. It is a technique known to fighters who study the bending of moments.

rites.name: Rellostus
rites.text: A practitioner releases a beam of light that sweeps in a curve around them. It can be chained together with a separate blast technique as one of its strikes.

rites.name: Rolus
rites.text: A combat technique that appears in a battle system, where a user's strength is boosted while the defense of a foe is drained.

rites.name: Tallus
rites.text: A combat maneuver in which a fighter swings from a fixed post and then follows the swing with a spinning strike aimed upward. It lets the user chain two motions into one fluid attack.

rites.name: Serollanum Orallium
rites.text: A combat technique that lets a fighter draw on a surge of strength and guarding force at once. It appears as a special move in an ongoing battle-focused contest of skill.

rites.name: Oriasus Sillia
rites.text: A dazzling technique that a fighter unleashes in a clash of spirits. It belongs to a set of special strikes used in a single arena-based combat contest.

rites.name: Maustus
rites.text: A combat maneuver that appears in a modern-era fighting system. It is used as a special attack by fighters who have learned it.

rites.name: Ameliarnium
rites.text: A tender technique that appears in a shared-hearts dreamworld. It belongs to the special moves a fighter can unleash in that realm.

rites.name: Orollium
rites.text: A swift technique that appears in a fictional realm's combat arts. It is a special attack practiced by fighters in that world.

rites.name: Sasirnia
rites.text: A deceptive combat maneuver that appears in the world of this account. It is a fighting technique practiced by those who wield its tactics.

rites.name: Nines
rites.text: A combat art in which a fighter drives forward through the air on swift strikes. It belongs to a set of fighting styles practiced in a fantasy world.

rites.name: Corilles
rites.text: A practiced maneuver that lets its wielder vanish across the battlefield and strike a foe several times in rapid bursts. It appears within a newer variant of a longer combat art.

rites.name: Valeontium Ceorontium
rites.text: A combat technique that appears in the Union Chi tournament arena, where a fighter wields the darkness cast behind them. It is recorded as a special strike used by fighters in that setting.

rites.name: Rises
rites.text: A combat technique that appears in a modern-era fighting arena, drawing strength out of an opponent. It is used as a special attack by warriors trained in the arena.

rites.name: Misestor
rites.text: A combat art in which the wielder releases brilliant streams of light that streak toward chosen foes. It is a technique of the ranged striking kind.

rites.name: Elaeriel
rites.text: Elaeriel is a crystalline sigil-engine that the mages of Alaimeinora bind to a wielder's will, granting them tiers of inscribed techniques that unlock as their training deepens. In its highest manifestation it can unmake a fallen star's mantle of ash and drive a wave of resonance across the surrounding sky.

rites.name: Elaliomwen
rites.text: Elaliomwen is a concept in the Alaimeinora omniverse, a resonance-bound scheme of attunement in which a practitioner fuses a chosen focus into a repeatable working and then carries the lasting trait it grants. Once that working is mastered, the trait persists independently of the focus, and it can be stacked for greater effect.

rites.name: Alairla
rites.text: Alairla is a concept of arcane command-weaving in the realm of Alaimeinora, where a mind's chosen rites are inscribed into a lattice of resonant glyphs before they may be invoked. Two inscribed rites that sit side by side can fuse into a stronger rite, and the lattice grants bonus tempo or reach to the rites it holds. Its power grows with its use, so the oldest lattices can reshape whole regions.

rites.name: Ryenna
rites.text: Ryenna is an arcane command-sigil forged in Alaimeinora's third age, a sealed card of stored power that a bearer can draw from a shared deck. Each drawn sigil unleashes its bound magic and then rests for a span set by its depth. Its deepest form can unmake a world's worth of stone in a single cast.

rites.name: Lyalae
rites.text: Lyalae is a tethering ritual of the Arcane realm, in which a wanderer binds a fragment of their will to a companion so that the bond can be drawn upon from afar. Each new bond kindles a pale silver sigil on the wrist, and the bonded ally answers with a single borrowed surge of strength when the link is called. The bond fades with use and must be renewed through shared hardship.

rites.name: Oriema
rites.text: Oriema is a quiet ward of Alaimeinora's arcane circles, a gathered reservoir of gentle restoratives that lends its vigor to whoever bears its sigil in the field. Its keepers claim the ward can be tuned to surge defensively when a bearer falters, though such surges are rare and seldom recorded.

rites.name: Elaeneth
rites.text: Elaeneth is a sealed resonance-engine of the Arcane realm, a lattice of humming crystal that stores the echoes of sworn oaths and releases them as ability-pulses. Its keepers may attach or detach these pulses at will by touching the glyph of the pulse, sorting them into three chords: strike, stride, and shield. Its deepest chord can briefly tear open the grip of gravity itself.

rites.name: Lyalenna
rites.text: Lyalenna is a bound resonance woven into the Arcane powers of Alaimeinora, an echo of a sealed concept that answers only to those who have deepened their inner tuning. Each Lyalenna sings two attunements, and a bearer may call on them only while the lattice of their own will is in harmony with it, unlocking a new voice each time their resonance matures.

rites.name: Ilyannae
rites.text: Ilyannae is a resonant ward-sigil that flares whenever a bearer's chant reaches the seventh stanza, wrapping the caster in a shimmering lattice that sharpens every strike into a bright, pressurized spear of force. Tested in the Cinder Vaults of Morrow, its finisher once split a sealed bell-tower in a single breath, leaving the stones suspended in mid-air for seven heartbeats before they fell.

rites.name: Alaeniometh
rites.text: Alaeniometh is a sealed fracture-script woven through the lattice of Alaimeinora, a chant-bound discipline that lets a wielder briefly overwrite a bounded region of reality with a repeatable, timed correction. Its practitioners must recharge their resonance from shards called lumen-seeds, and each correction stabilizes a locale only for as long as the sealing holds.

rites.name: Mienna
rites.text: Mienna is a storm-binding concept in Alaimeinora's Arcane realm, a whirling vortex of woven gale and ember that gathers foes into its spiral before a final sweeping crescent cut. Its circling is fragile, and any interruption shatters the vortex and leaves the caster exposed.

rites.name: Alaennara
rites.text: Alaennara is a sworn-warden of the Lantern Hollows, a tutelary spirit who answers to the ringing of brass bells rather than to any ruler. Those who wear her sigil learn to slip through danger by turning the body's last reflex into a shoulder-first surge that scatters whatever stands in the path.

rites.name: Miarys
rites.text: Miarys is a concept in the Arcane realm of Alaimeinora, a kindled ember-flame that a student-mage learns to call from the marrow of their own breath during the third age of the sixth era. It is taught as the rite a kindled apprentice earns after standing firm against two shadow-wardens of the ash-fields.

rites.name: Nuanilla
rites.text: Nuanilla is a veiled arcane instrument of the Alaimeinora omniverse, a silver lattice that a warden of the E6 age forges from borrowed dreams to hold one coordinated strike in reserve. Its draw demands the entire reservoir of its bearer's spirit, so it can be loosed only when a chosen companion stands ready and the warden's own strength is untouched.

rites.name: Eluarwen
rites.text: Eluarwen is a crown-bearing warden of the Arcane realm of Alaimeinora, who channels the memory of a fallen star-vault into a single devastating release. Her signature act is a spiraling descent of sealed light that lasts only a breath but splits the sky above a valley.

rites.name: Ryilemiel
rites.text: Ryilemiel is a luminous sphere of stored incantation, a crystallized spell that hums in the palm until its bearer releases the words it holds. Its drifting light answers to the caster's wit rather than their stamina, and it can burn, freeze, or shock whole groups of foes in one sweep while slipping past armor.

rites.name: Eleinarora
rites.text: Eleinarora is a bound weave of sung resonance that a mage's voice anchors onto a chosen target, so every spell after it bends toward that mark like iron filings drawn to a lodestone. Its keepers grow the anchor slowly, and only at the twelfth turn of their training does the thread hold firm enough to carry across the field.

rites.name: Ilyiluarae
rites.text: Ilyiluarae is a concept of arcane momentum, a gliding strike that a wielder earns only after learning to sprint across the open lands of Alaimeinora. Its spinning charge gathers the running body's motion into a single sweeping blow that opens battles where ground is wide and foes are many.

rites.name: Ilyalae
rites.text: Ilyalae is a mental lens ritual of the Arcane realm, through which a practitioner reads the reserve of vital force held within any living being and the stresses hidden in its structure. Its adepts can sense the fraying points of foes and the hidden lines of weakness that a rival carries beneath their guard. The lens itself draws almost nothing from the caster, though its focus can be amplified to pierce across vast distances.

rites.name: Eliramora
rites.text: Eliramora is a Sentinel-Lattice of drifting glass spires that hum above the Veil of Ossuary Dusk, its resonance tuned to the heartbeats of nearby wardens. When a warden's focus-well runs low, the spires fall silent, and the lattice draws life from the nearest living thing to restore its song.

rites.name: Alaannora
rites.text: Alaannora is a battle discipline of the Arcane realm, practiced by wanderers who let their weapons fill with stored resonance until a shift in form is triggered. Each practitioner unlocks shared forms alongside one signature stance that only they can master. The forms let fighters channel raw magic or flow through martial combinations at will.

rites.name: Ryellirae
rites.text: Ryellirae is a concept of arcane flight in Alaimeinora, a rush of sky-wind that a practitioner gathers into the soles of the feet and releases as a long, pressing dive. It is taught at the third age of the E6 era by the wind-keepers of the high terraces, who measure a student's progress by how far a single breath can carry them.

rites.name: Alairla
rites.text: Alairla is a rising-arc sigil-blade technique of the Alaimeinora powers tradition, drawn from the sorcerer-wardens who lift foes off the ground with a single consecrated hook of light. It is cast from a low sweep and carries the caster's full resolve upward through the target. Practitioners learn it only after breaking the two guardian spirits that guard the wardens' reliquary.

rites.name: Silimora
rites.text: Silimora is a shimmering silver pendant-engine worn by the wardens of Alaimeinora's Arcane realm, able to borrow the momentum of anything it touches and loop it into bursts of force. Its wielders learn to chain these bursts into graceful, rolling arcs that toss massive weights across the sky. Old tales claim a single well-timed loop once tore a moon's orbit slightly off course.

rites.name: Orialiel
rites.text: Orialiel is a resonant lattice of woven moonlight that the Arcane scholars of Alaimeinora classify as a concept rather than a being. In the third age of the E6 era, practitioners invoke it to lift and cradle objects in bubbles of shimmering air that drift like lanterns over the river markets.

rites.name: Elimionae
rites.text: Elimionae is a dark-aura concept in the Alaimeinora omniverse, a barrier of hollowed arcane force that bends incoming assaults back toward their source. Its wielders can use it defensively, then unleash the stored recoil as a crushing counter. Mastery of the barrier's timing separates those who survive its rebound from those it swallows.

rites.name: Silarora
rites.text: Silarora is a shadowed wellspring that drinks at the hidden discord of living minds, turning the restless into hollowed wanderers. Its tides are said to pull whole valleys into a quiet dusk that never lifts. It is worshipped in the Alaimeinora by those who believe every ending must return to where it began.

rites.name: Siliomilora
rites.text: Siliomilora is an arcane concept in the Alaimeinora omniverse: a permit of hollow silver etched with grammar-runes that lets a bearer weave spells inside the mirrored lattice of the Glass Archive. Within that lattice, a single Siliomilora can channel the stored resonance of the archive's oldest vaults into one sudden surge.

rites.name: Oriarliomae
rites.text: Oriarliomae is a radiant current woven into the arcane fabric of Alaimeinora, a light that the realm's oldest scholars claim persists even where all hope seems extinguished. Its bearers can turn a single flicker of that glow into a sweeping tide that burns away the shadows of entire valleys.

rites.name: Nuara
rites.text: Nuara is a bound ember-spirit of the Arcane realm, who grows in strength by attuning to a chosen wielder and unlocking veins of hidden sigils across her inner lattice. Her presence can rewrite the flow of nearby mana, letting allies cast with borrowed strength or shield their bodies from hostile spells.

rites.name: Oriileirla
rites.text: Oriileirla is a conceptual lattice of inscribed sigil-tiles that a mage slots into a shared resonance grid to shape spells during a working. Its tiles are never consumed by a casting, and the grid's cohesion can be recharged from reservoirs of stored starlight known as cinderwells.

rites.name: Elaerinora
rites.text: Elaerinora is a veil-tide spirit of Alaimeinora's drowned archipelago, able to wrap itself in a shell of living brine and loose a homing torrent that drags enemies into its sea-glass depths. Its strongest tide can collapse the seabed beneath a fleet and swallow whole reefs in a single surge.

rites.name: Cilaria
rites.text: A swirling technique of gathered shadow that a wielder unleashes in battle. It was first introduced to practitioners in a recent chronicle of the realm.

rites.name: Naureolanum
rites.text: A cosmic technique that appears in a realm of sundered heroes. It is a volley of glittering force wielded by those who fight with spirit and starlight.

rites.name: Terus
rites.text: Terus is the concept of the branching-point in Alaimeinora, the moment when a single thread of fate forks into three futures that the Library then shelves as separate outcomes. It is felt most keenly in the groves and young kingdoms of the first sovereign's age, where a single choice can split a harvest into three different years.
